    67	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    68	// Pure decision logic (unit-tested, no network)
    69	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70	
    71	/**
    72	 * BSC block cadence changed with the Lorentz/Maxwell upgrades (measured
    73	 * ~0.45s on 2026-08-18, not the historical 3s), so blocks-per-year is
    74	 * extrapolated from two observed block timestamps instead of assumed.
    75	 */
    76	export function deriveBlocksPerYear(
    77	  latestTimestamp: bigint,
    78	  olderTimestamp: bigint,
    79	  blockSpan: number,
    80	): number {
    81	  const elapsed = Number(latestTimestamp - olderTimestamp);
    82	  if (elapsed <= 0 || blockSpan <= 0) {
    83	    throw new Error(`cannot derive block cadence: elapsed=${elapsed}s span=${blockSpan}`);
    84	  }
    85	  return Math.round((YEAR_SECONDS * blockSpan) / elapsed);
    86	}
    87	
    88	/** Venus quotes a WAD-scaled per-block rate; simple APR (rate * blocks) in bps. */
    89	export function venusApyBps(supplyRatePerBlock: bigint, blocksPerYear: number): number {
    90	  return (Number(supplyRatePerBlock) / Number(WAD)) * blocksPerYear * 10_000;
    91	}
    92	
    93	/**
    94	 * Aave v3 currentLiquidityRate is the annualized APR in RAY (per-second
    95	 * compounding semantics). At ~2% the APY/APR gap is ~2 bps, far inside the
    96	 * 50 bps hysteresis, so APR is used as APY.
    97	 */
    98	export function aaveApyBps(currentLiquidityRate: bigint): number {
    99	  return (Number(currentLiquidityRate) / Number(RAY)) * 10_000;
   100	}
   101	
   102	export function chooseFirstVenue(venusBps: number, aaveBps: number): 'venus' | 'aave' {
   103	  return aaveBps > venusBps ? 'aave' : 'venus';
   104	}
   105	
   106	/** Venue as the chain sees it; a position in both venues resolves to the larger. */
   107	export function detectVenue(venusUnderlyingWei: bigint, aaveATokenWei: bigint, dustWei: bigint): Venue {
   108	  const inVenus = venusUnderlyingWei > dustWei;
   109	  const inAave = aaveATokenWei > dustWei;
   110	  if (inVenus && inAave) return venusUnderlyingWei >= aaveATokenWei ? 'venus' : 'aave';
   111	  if (inVenus) return 'venus';
   112	  if (inAave) return 'aave';
   113	  return 'none';
   114	}
   115	
   116	export interface RotationInput {
   117	  venue: 'venus' | 'aave';
   118	  venusBps: number;
   119	  aaveBps: number;
   120	  betterStreak: number;
   121	  hysteresisBps?: number;
   122	  requiredStreak?: number;
   123	}
   124	
   125	export interface RotationDecision {
   126	  action: 'hold' | 'rotate';
   127	  target: 'venus' | 'aave';
   128	  edgeBps: number;
   129	  nextStreak: number;
   130	}
   131	
   132	/**
   133	 * Rotate only when the other venue beats the current by more than the
   134	 * hysteresis on this check AND on the previous one (streak of 2); the streak
   135	 * resets the moment the edge falls back inside the hysteresis band.
   136	 */
   137	export function decideRotation(input: RotationInput): RotationDecision {
   138	  const hysteresis = input.hysteresisBps ?? HYSTERESIS_BPS;
   139	  const required = input.requiredStreak ?? REQUIRED_STREAK;
   140	  const other: 'venus' | 'aave' = input.venue === 'venus' ? 'aave' : 'venus';
   141	  const currentBps = input.venue === 'venus' ? input.venusBps : input.aaveBps;
   142	  const otherBps = other === 'venus' ? input.venusBps : input.aaveBps;
   143	  const edgeBps = otherBps - currentBps;
   144	
   145	  if (edgeBps > hysteresis) {
   146	    const nextStreak = input.betterStreak + 1;
   147	    if (nextStreak >= required) {
   148	      return { action: 'rotate', target: other, edgeBps, nextStreak: 0 };
   149	    }
   150	    return { action: 'hold', target: input.venue, edgeBps, nextStreak };
   151	  }
   152	  return { action: 'hold', target: input.venue, edgeBps, nextStreak: 0 };
   153	}
   154	
   155	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   156	// Chain reads
   157	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   158	
   159	interface Rates {
   160	  venusBps: number;
   161	  aaveBps: number;
   162	  blocksPerYear: number;
   163	  venusRatePerBlock: string;
   164	  aaveLiquidityRate: string;
   165	}
   166	
   167	async function readRates(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<Rates> {
   168	  const latest = await ctx.publicClient.getBlock();
   169	  const span = 5000;
   170	  const older = await ctx.publicClient.getBlock({
   171	    blockNumber: latest.number - BigInt(span),
   172	  });
   173	  const blocksPerYear = deriveBlocksPerYear(latest.timestamp, older.timestamp, span);
   174	
   175	  const [venusRate, reserve] = await Promise.all([
   176	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   177	      address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   178	      abi: vTokenAbi,
   179	      functionName: 'supplyRatePerBlock',
   180	    }),
   181	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   182	      address: AAVE_POOL,
   183	      abi: aavePoolAbi,
   184	      functionName: 'getReserveData',
   185	      args: [USDT.address],
   186	    }),
   187	  ]);
   188	
   189	  return {
   190	    venusBps: venusApyBps(venusRate, blocksPerYear),
   191	    aaveBps: aaveApyBps(reserve.currentLiquidityRate),
   192	    blocksPerYear,
   193	    venusRatePerBlock: venusRate.toString(),
   194	    aaveLiquidityRate: reserve.currentLiquidityRate.toString(),
   195	  };
   196	}
   197	
   198	interface Position {
   199	  walletUsdtWei: bigint;
   200	  venusUnderlyingWei: bigint;
   201	  aaveATokenWei: bigint;
   202	  chainVenue: Venue;
   203	}
   204	
   205	async function readPosition(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<Position> {
   206	  const self = ctx.account.address;
   207	  const [walletUsdtWei, venusUnderlyingWei, reserve] = await Promise.all([
   208	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   209	      address: USDT.address,
   210	      abi: erc20Abi,
   211	      functionName: 'balanceOf',
   212	      args: [self],
   213	    }),
   214	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   215	      address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   216	      abi: vTokenReadAbi,
   217	      functionName: 'balanceOfUnderlying',
   218	      args: [self],
   219	    }),
   220	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   221	      address: AAVE_POOL,
   222	      abi: aavePoolAbi,
   223	      functionName: 'getReserveData',
   224	      args: [USDT.address],
   225	    }),
   226	  ]);
   227	  const aaveATokenWei = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   228	    address: reserve.aTokenAddress,
   229	    abi: erc20Abi,
   230	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   231	    args: [self],
   232	  });
   233	  return {
   234	    walletUsdtWei,
   235	    venusUnderlyingWei,
   236	    aaveATokenWei,
   237	    chainVenue: detectVenue(venusUnderlyingWei, aaveATokenWei, DUST_WEI),
   238	  };
   239	}

   245	async function ensureAllowance(
   246	  ctx: AgentContext,
   247	  spender: `0x${string}`,
   248	  amountWei: bigint,
   249	): Promise<void> {
   250	  const current = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   251	    address: USDT.address,
   252	    abi: erc20Abi,
   253	    functionName: 'allowance',
   254	    args: [ctx.account.address, spender],
   255	  });
   256	  if (current >= amountWei) return;
   257	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   258	    address: USDT.address,
   259	    abi: erc20Abi,
   260	    functionName: 'approve',
   261	    args: [spender, amountWei],
   262	    account: ctx.account,
   263	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   264	  });
   265	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   266	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`approve reverted: ${hash}`);
   267	  ctx.log({ event: 'approve', spender, amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals), txHash: hash });
   268	}
   269	
   270	async function supplyVenus(ctx: AgentContext, amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   271	  await ensureAllowance(ctx, VENUS_VUSDT, amountWei);
   272	  const { result, request } = await ctx.publicClient.simulateContract({
   273	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   274	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   275	    functionName: 'mint',
   276	    args: [amountWei],
   277	    account: ctx.account,
   278	  });
   279	  if (result !== BigInt(0)) throw new Error(`venus mint would fail with code ${result}`);
   280	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({ ...request, chain: ctx.walletClient.chain });
   281	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   282	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`venus mint reverted: ${hash}`);
   283	  ctx.log({
   284	    event: 'supply',
   285	    venue: 'venus',
   286	    amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals),
   287	    txHash: hash,
   288	  });
   289	}
   290	
   291	async function withdrawVenus(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<void> {
   292	  // Redeeming the full vToken balance (not redeemUnderlying) exits exactly,
   293	  // leaving no interest-accrual dust behind.
   294	  const vTokenBalance = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   295	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   296	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   297	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   298	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   299	  });
   300	  if (vTokenBalance === BigInt(0)) {
   301	    ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw-skip', venue: 'venus', reason: 'no vToken balance' });
   302	    return;
   303	  }
   304	  const { result, request } = await ctx.publicClient.simulateContract({
   305	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   306	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   307	    functionName: 'redeem',
   308	    args: [vTokenBalance],
   309	    account: ctx.account,
   310	  });
   311	  if (result !== BigInt(0)) throw new Error(`venus redeem would fail with code ${result}`);
   312	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({ ...request, chain: ctx.walletClient.chain });
   313	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   314	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`venus redeem reverted: ${hash}`);
   315	  ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw', venue: 'venus', vTokens: vTokenBalance.toString(), txHash: hash });
   316	}
   317	
   318	async function supplyAave(ctx: AgentContext, amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   319	  await ensureAllowance(ctx, AAVE_POOL, amountWei);
   320	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   321	    address: AAVE_POOL,
   322	    abi: aavePoolAbi,
   323	    functionName: 'supply',
   324	    args: [USDT.address, amountWei, ctx.account.address, 0],
   325	    account: ctx.account,
   326	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   327	  });
   328	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   329	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`aave supply reverted: ${hash}`);
   330	  ctx.log({
   331	    event: 'supply',
   332	    venue: 'aave',
   333	    amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals),
   334	    txHash: hash,
   335	  });
   336	}
   337	
   338	async function withdrawAave(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<void> {
   339	  // maxUint256 tells the pool to withdraw the full aToken balance including
   340	  // interest accrued in the same block.
   341	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   342	    address: AAVE_POOL,
   343	    abi: aavePoolAbi,
   344	    functionName: 'withdraw',
   345	    args: [USDT.address, maxUint256, ctx.account.address],
   346	    account: ctx.account,
   347	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   348	  });
   349	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   350	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`aave withdraw reverted: ${hash}`);
   351	  ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw', venue: 'aave', txHash: hash });
   352	}
   353	
   354	async function supplyTo(ctx: AgentContext, venue: 'venus' | 'aave', amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   355	  if (venue === 'venus') await supplyVenus(ctx, amountWei);
   356	  else await supplyAave(ctx, amountWei);
   357	}
   358	
   359	function recordMove(ctx: AgentContext): void {
   360	  const now = Date.now();
   361	  const dayAgo = now - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
   362	  const moves = ctx.state.get<number[]>('moves', []).filter((t) => t > dayAgo);
   363	  ctx.state.set('moves', [...moves, now]);
   364	}
   365	
   366	function movesToday(ctx: AgentContext): number {
   367	  const dayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
   368	  return ctx.state.get<number[]>('moves', []).filter((t) => t > dayAgo).length;
   369	}

   371	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   372	// Agent module
   373	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   374	
   375	export const yieldAgent: AgentModule = {
   376	  name: 'yield',
   377	  category: 'yield',
   378	  tickIntervalMs: 21_600_000,
   379	
   380	  async tick(ctx) {
   381	    const halted = ctx.breakers.isHalted();
   382	    if (halted.halted) {
   383	      ctx.log({ event: 'tick-skip', reason: `halted: ${halted.reason}` });
   384	      return;
   385	    }
   386	
   387	    const rates = await readRates(ctx);
   388	    const position = await readPosition(ctx);
   389	
   390	    const storedVenue = ctx.state.get<Venue>('venue', 'none');
   391	    const venue = position.chainVenue;
   392	    if (venue !== storedVenue) {
   393	      ctx.log({ event: 'venue-reconciled', stored: storedVenue, chain: venue });
   394	      ctx.state.set('venue', venue);
   395	    }
   396	
   397	    const base = {
   398	      venue,
   399	      venusApyBps: rates.venusBps,
   400	      aaveApyBps: rates.aaveBps,
   401	      blocksPerYear: rates.blocksPerYear,
   402	      venusRatePerBlock: rates.venusRatePerBlock,
   403	      aaveLiquidityRate: rates.aaveLiquidityRate,
   404	      walletUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.walletUsdtWei, USDT.decimals),
   405	      venusUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.venusUnderlyingWei, USDT.decimals),
   406	      aaveUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.aaveATokenWei, USDT.decimals),
   407	    };
   408	
   409	    if (venue === 'none') {
   410	      const deployableWei = position.walletUsdtWei - RESERVE_WEI;
   411	      if (deployableWei <= DUST_WEI) {
   412	        ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'unfunded', deployable: fromBaseUnits(
   413	          deployableWei > BigInt(0) ? deployableWei : BigInt(0),
   414	          USDT.decimals,
   415	        ) });
   416	        return;
   417	      }
   418	      const target = chooseFirstVenue(rates.venusBps, rates.aaveBps);
   419	      if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('enter', 2)) {
   420	        ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'enter-capped', target });
   421	        return;
   422	      }
   423	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'enter', target, amount: fromBaseUnits(deployableWei, USDT.decimals) });
   424	      await supplyTo(ctx, target, deployableWei);
   425	      ctx.state.set('venue', target);
   426	      ctx.state.set('betterStreak', 0);
   427	      recordMove(ctx);
   428	      return;
   429	    }
   430	
   431	    const decision = decideRotation({
   432	      venue,
   433	      venusBps: rates.venusBps,
   434	      aaveBps: rates.aaveBps,
   435	      betterStreak: ctx.state.get<number>('betterStreak', 0),
   436	    });
   437	    ctx.state.set('betterStreak', decision.nextStreak);
   438	
   439	    if (decision.action === 'hold') {
   440	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'hold', edgeBps: decision.edgeBps, betterStreak: decision.nextStreak });
   441	      return;
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('rotate', 1)) {
   445	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'rotate-capped', target: decision.target, edgeBps: decision.edgeBps });
   446	      return;
   447	    }
   448	
   449	    ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'rotate', from: venue, to: decision.target, edgeBps: decision.edgeBps });
   450	    if (venue === 'venus') await withdrawVenus(ctx);
   451	    else await withdrawAave(ctx);
   452	    ctx.state.set('venue', 'none');
   453	
   454	    const walletAfterWei = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   455	      address: USDT.address,
   456	      abi: erc20Abi,
   457	      functionName: 'balanceOf',
   458	      args: [ctx.account.address],
   459	    });
   460	    const deployableWei = walletAfterWei - RESERVE_WEI;
   461	    if (deployableWei <= DUST_WEI) {
   462	      ctx.log({ event: 'rotate-abort', reason: 'nothing to redeploy after withdraw', wallet: fromBaseUnits(walletAfterWei, USDT.decimals) });
   463	      return;
   464	    }
   465	    await supplyTo(ctx, decision.target, deployableWei);
   466	    ctx.state.set('venue', decision.target);
   467	    recordMove(ctx);
   468	  },
   469	
   470	  async status(ctx) {
   471	    const [rates, position] = await Promise.all([readRates(ctx), readPosition(ctx)]);
   472	    const venue = position.chainVenue;
   473	    const positionWei =
   474	      venue === 'venus' ? position.venusUnderlyingWei
   475	      : venue === 'aave' ? position.aaveATokenWei
   476	      : BigInt(0);
   477	    const edgeBps =
   478	      venue === 'venus' ? rates.aaveBps - rates.venusBps
   479	      : venue === 'aave' ? rates.venusBps - rates.aaveBps
   480	      : Math.abs(rates.aaveBps - rates.venusBps);
   481	    return {
   482	      venue,
   483	      positionUsdt: fromBaseUnits(positionWei, USDT.decimals),
   484	      venusApyBps: rates.venusBps,
   485	      aaveApyBps: rates.aaveBps,
   486	      edgeBps,
   487	      betterStreak: ctx.state.get<number>('betterStreak', 0),
   488	      movesToday: movesToday(ctx),
   489	      halted: ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted,
   490	    };
   491	  },
   492	};

    13	export const RANGE_PCT = 0.05;
    14	export const OUT_OF_RANGE_EXIT_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;
    15	export const DAY_MS = 24 * 3600 * 1000;
    16	export const WEEK_MS = 7 * DAY_MS;
    17	export const MAX_REBALANCES_PER_WEEK = 4;
    18	export const MIN_SWAP_NOTIONAL_USD = 1;
    19	/* Below this per-leg value the pool mint computes zero liquidity and reverts. */
    20	export const MIN_MINT_LEG_USD = 0.05;
    21	
    22	/** ln(1 + pct) / ln(1.0001), floored: 5% -> 487 ticks. */
    23	export function pctToTickDelta(pct: number): number {
    24	  return Math.floor(Math.log(1 + pct) / Math.log(1.0001));
    25	}
    26	
    27	/** Lower bound snaps down, upper snaps up, so the current tick stays strictly inside. */
    28	export function snapRange(
    29	  currentTick: number,
    30	  tickDelta: number,
    31	  tickSpacing: number,
    32	): { tickLower: number; tickUpper: number } {
    33	  const tickLower = Math.floor((currentTick - tickDelta) / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
    34	  const tickUpper = Math.ceil((currentTick + tickDelta) / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
    35	  return { tickLower, tickUpper };
    36	}
    37	
    38	/** Uniswap-style position activity: lower inclusive, upper exclusive. */
    39	export function isInRange(currentTick: number, tickLower: number, tickUpper: number): boolean {
    40	  return currentTick >= tickLower && currentTick < tickUpper;
    41	}
    42	
    43	/** Out-of-range timer: starts on first out-of-range tick, resets on re-entry. */
    44	export function nextOutSince(
    45	  inRange: boolean,
    46	  prevOutSince: number | null,
    47	  now: number,
    48	): number | null {
    49	  if (inRange) return null;
    50	  return prevOutSince ?? now;
    51	}
    52	
    53	export function shouldRebalance(
    54	  outSince: number | null,
    55	  now: number,
    56	  thresholdMs: number = OUT_OF_RANGE_EXIT_MS,
    57	): boolean {
    58	  return outSince !== null && now - outSince > thresholdMs;
    59	}

    61	export interface RebalanceLeg {
    62	  sell: 'WBNB' | 'USDT';
    63	  amountUnits: number;
    64	  notionalUsd: number;
    65	}
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * One swap that moves inventory to ~50/50 by value: sell half the value gap
    69	 * from the heavy side. Returns null when the gap leg is <= minNotionalUsd.
    70	 */
    71	export function computeRebalanceLeg(
    72	  wbnbUnits: number,
    73	  usdtUnits: number,
    74	  usdtPerWbnb: number,
    75	  minNotionalUsd: number = MIN_SWAP_NOTIONAL_USD,
    76	): RebalanceLeg | null {
    77	  const excessUsd = (wbnbUnits * usdtPerWbnb - usdtUnits) / 2;
    78	  if (!Number.isFinite(excessUsd) || Math.abs(excessUsd) <= minNotionalUsd) return null;
    79	  if (excessUsd > 0) {
    80	    return { sell: 'WBNB', amountUnits: excessUsd / usdtPerWbnb, notionalUsd: excessUsd };
    81	  }
    82	  return { sell: 'USDT', amountUnits: -excessUsd, notionalUsd: -excessUsd };
    83	}
    84	
    85	export function pruneWindow(timestamps: number[], now: number, windowMs: number): number[] {
    86	  const cutoff = now - windowMs;
    87	  return timestamps.filter((t) => t > cutoff);
    88	}
    89	
    90	/** Both pool tokens are 18 decimals, so the raw ratio needs no decimal scaling. */
    91	export function sqrtPriceX96ToUsdtPerWbnb(sqrtPriceX96: bigint, wbnbIsToken0: boolean): number {
    92	  const token1PerToken0 = (Number(sqrtPriceX96) / 2 ** 96) ** 2;
    93	  return wbnbIsToken0 ? token1PerToken0 : 1 / token1PerToken0;
    94	}
    95	
    96	export function formatWholeUnits(amount: number): string {
    97	  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) {
    98	    throw new Error(`cannot format non-positive amount: ${amount}`);
    99	  }
   100	  return amount
   101	    .toFixed(12)
   102	    .replace(/0+$/, '')
   103	    .replace(/\.$/, '');
   104	}

   110	/*
   111	 * Probed 2026-08-18 with tsx + viem readContract on https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com:
   112	 *   NPM.factory() -> 0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865 (matches expected factory)
   113	 *   NPM.WETH9()  -> 0xbb4CdB9CBd36B01bD1cBaEBF2De08d9173bc095c (WBNB, matches TOKENS_BSC)
   114	 */
   115	const POSITION_MANAGER = '0x46A15B0b27311cedF172AB29E4f4766fbE7F4364' as const;
   116	const EXPECTED_FACTORY = '0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865';
   117	
   118	/*
   119	 * Pool probes, same date and RPC, factory.getPool(WBNB, USDT, fee):
   120	 *   fee 500  -> 0x36696169C63e42cd08ce11f5deeBbCeBae652050 liquidity 1.19e24 tickSpacing 10
   121	 *   fee 100  -> 0x172fcD41E0913e95784454622d1c3724f546f849 liquidity 8.96e24 tickSpacing 1
   122	 *   fee 2500 -> 0x1401ff943D08a7E098328C1d3a9d388923B115D2 liquidity 2.00e22 tickSpacing 50
   123	 * All three report token0 = USDT, token1 = WBNB. The pool is still resolved at
   124	 * runtime through the verified factory rather than hardcoded.
   125	 */
   126	const POOL_FEE_TIERS = [500, 100, 2500] as const;
   127	
   128	const WBNB = TOKENS_BSC['WBNB']!;
   129	const USDT = TOKENS_BSC['USDT']!;
   130	
   131	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   132	/* ABIs and runtime constants                                          */
   133	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   134	
   135	const NPM_ABI = parseAbi([
   136	  'function factory() view returns (address)',
   137	  'function WETH9() view returns (address)',
   138	  'function mint((address token0, address token1, uint24 fee, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, address recipient, uint256 deadline)) payable returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)',
   139	  'function positions(uint256 tokenId) view returns (uint96 nonce, address operator, address token0, address token1, uint24 fee, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity, uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128, uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1)',
   140	  'function decreaseLiquidity((uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, uint256 deadline)) payable returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)',
   141	  'function collect((uint256 tokenId, address recipient, uint128 amount0Max, uint128 amount1Max)) payable returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)',
   142	  'function balanceOf(address owner) view returns (uint256)',
   143	  'function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) view returns (uint256)',
   144	  'event IncreaseLiquidity(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)',
   145	]);
   146	
   147	const FACTORY_ABI = parseAbi([
   148	  'function getPool(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee) view returns (address)',
   149	]);
   150	
   151	/* PancakeSwap V3 slot0 layout: feeProtocol is uint32 (uint8 on Uniswap V3). */
   152	const POOL_ABI = parseAbi([
   153	  'function liquidity() view returns (uint128)',
   154	  'function tickSpacing() view returns (int24)',
   155	  'function token0() view returns (address)',
   156	  'function slot0() view returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96, int24 tick, uint16 observationIndex, uint16 observationCardinality, uint16 observationCardinalityNext, uint32 feeProtocol, bool unlocked)',
   157	]);
   158	
   159	const MAX_UINT128 = BigInt('0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff');
   160	const USDT_DUST_RESERVE = toBaseUnits('0.1', USDT.decimals);
   161	const WBNB_DUST_RESERVE = toBaseUnits('0.0002', WBNB.decimals);
   162	const PENDING_ORDER_MAX_AGE_MS = 35 * 60 * 1000;
   163	const FILL_POLL_ATTEMPTS = 10;
   164	const FILL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15_000;
   165	const TX_DEADLINE_SECONDS = 600;
   166	
   167	interface PositionState {
   168	  tokenId: string;
   169	  tickLower: number;
   170	  tickUpper: number;
   171	  outSince: number | null;
   172	}
   173	
   174	interface PoolInfo {
   175	  pool: `0x${string}`;
   176	  fee: number;
   177	  tickSpacing: number;
   178	  wbnbIsToken0: boolean;
   179	}
   180	
   181	interface PendingOrder {
   182	  orderUid: string;
   183	  sellSymbol: 'WBNB' | 'USDT';
   184	  sellAmountWei: string;
   185	  preSellBalanceWei: string;
   186	  placedAt: number;
   187	}
   188	
   189	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   190	/* Chain helpers                                                       */
   191	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   192	
   193	function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
   194	  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
   195	}
   196	
   197	function txDeadline(): bigint {
   198	  return BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + TX_DEADLINE_SECONDS);
   199	}
   200	
   201	async function erc20Balance(ctx: AgentContext, token: `0x${string}`): Promise<bigint> {
   202	  return ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   203	    address: token,
   204	    abi: erc20Abi,
   205	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   206	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   207	  });
   208	}
   209	
   210	async function readSlot0(
   211	  ctx: AgentContext,
   212	  pool: `0x${string}`,
   213	): Promise<{ sqrtPriceX96: bigint; tick: number }> {
   214	  const slot0 = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   215	    address: pool,
   216	    abi: POOL_ABI,
   217	    functionName: 'slot0',
   218	  });
   219	  return { sqrtPriceX96: slot0[0], tick: slot0[1] };
   220	}
   221	
   222	async function resolvePool(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<PoolInfo> {
   223	  const cached = ctx.state.get<PoolInfo | null>('poolInfo', null);
   224	  if (cached && cached.pool) return cached;
   225	
   226	  const factory = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   227	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   228	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   229	    functionName: 'factory',
   230	  });
   231	  if (factory.toLowerCase() !== EXPECTED_FACTORY.toLowerCase()) {
   232	    /* Minting through a manager wired to an unknown factory risks the funds. */
   233	    ctx.breakers.halt(`position manager factory mismatch: ${factory}`);
   234	    throw new Error(`position manager factory mismatch: ${factory}`);
   235	  }
   236	
   237	  for (const fee of POOL_FEE_TIERS) {
   238	    const pool = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   239	      address: factory,
   240	      abi: FACTORY_ABI,
   241	      functionName: 'getPool',
   242	      args: [WBNB.address, USDT.address, fee],
   243	    });
   244	    if (pool === zeroAddress) {
   245	      ctx.log({ event: 'pool-probe', fee, result: 'no-pool' });
   246	      continue;
   247	    }
   248	    const liquidity = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   249	      address: pool,
   250	      abi: POOL_ABI,
   251	      functionName: 'liquidity',
   252	    });
   253	    if (liquidity <= BigInt(0)) {
   254	      ctx.log({ event: 'pool-probe', fee, pool, result: 'zero-liquidity' });
   255	      continue;
   256	    }
   257	    const [tickSpacing, token0] = await Promise.all([
   258	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address: pool, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'tickSpacing' }),
   259	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address: pool, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'token0' }),
   260	    ]);
   261	    const info: PoolInfo = {
   262	      pool,
   263	      fee,
   264	      tickSpacing,
   265	      wbnbIsToken0: token0.toLowerCase() === WBNB.address.toLowerCase(),
   266	    };
   267	    ctx.state.set('poolInfo', info);
   268	    ctx.log({ event: 'pool-selected', ...info, liquidity: liquidity.toString() });
   269	    return info;
   270	  }
   271	  throw new Error('no WBNB/USDT PancakeSwap V3 pool with liquidity found');
   272	}
   273	
   274	type PendingStatus = 'none' | 'pending' | 'filled' | 'expired';
   275	
   276	async function checkPendingOrder(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<PendingStatus> {
   277	  const po = ctx.state.get<PendingOrder | null>('pendingOrder', null);
   278	  if (!po) return 'none';
   279	  const token = po.sellSymbol === 'WBNB' ? WBNB : USDT;
   280	  const balance = await erc20Balance(ctx, token.address);
   281	  const pre = BigInt(po.preSellBalanceWei);
   282	  const amount = BigInt(po.sellAmountWei);
   283	  /* Filled when >= 90% of the sell amount left the wallet (fee dust tolerance). */
   284	  const filledThreshold = pre - (amount * BigInt(9)) / BigInt(10);
   285	  if (balance <= filledThreshold) {
   286	    ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', null);
   287	    ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-order-filled', orderUid: po.orderUid });
   288	    return 'filled';
   289	  }
   290	  if (Date.now() - po.placedAt > PENDING_ORDER_MAX_AGE_MS) {
   291	    ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', null);
   292	    ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-order-stale-cleared', orderUid: po.orderUid });
   293	    return 'expired';
   294	  }
   295	  return 'pending';
   296	}
   297	
   298	async function findMintedTokenId(ctx: AgentContext, logs: Log[]): Promise<bigint> {
   299	  const events = parseEventLogs({ abi: NPM_ABI, logs, eventName: 'IncreaseLiquidity' }).filter(
   300	    (l) => l.address.toLowerCase() === POSITION_MANAGER.toLowerCase(),
   301	  );
   302	  const first = events[0];
   303	  if (first) return first.args.tokenId;
   304	  ctx.log({ event: 'mint-event-parse-miss', fallback: 'tokenOfOwnerByIndex' });
   305	  const balance = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   306	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   307	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   308	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   309	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   310	  });
   311	  if (balance <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error('mint receipt has no IncreaseLiquidity and owner holds no NPM tokens');
   312	  return ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   313	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   314	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   315	    functionName: 'tokenOfOwnerByIndex',
   316	    args: [ctx.account.address, balance - BigInt(1)],
   317	  });
   318	}
   319	
   320	async function tryMint(ctx: AgentContext, info: PoolInfo): Promise<void> {
   321	  const pending = await checkPendingOrder(ctx);
   322	  if (pending === 'pending') {
   323	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-deferred', reason: 'ophis-order-pending' });
   324	    return;
   325	  }
   326	
   327	  const [wbnbBal, usdtBal, slot0] = await Promise.all([
   328	    erc20Balance(ctx, WBNB.address),
   329	    erc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   330	    readSlot0(ctx, info.pool),
   331	  ]);
   332	  const availWbnb = wbnbBal > WBNB_DUST_RESERVE ? wbnbBal - WBNB_DUST_RESERVE : BigInt(0);
   333	  const availUsdt = usdtBal > USDT_DUST_RESERVE ? usdtBal - USDT_DUST_RESERVE : BigInt(0);
   334	  const price = sqrtPriceX96ToUsdtPerWbnb(slot0.sqrtPriceX96, info.wbnbIsToken0);
   335	  const wbnbUnits = Number(fromBaseUnits(availWbnb, WBNB.decimals));
   336	  const usdtUnits = Number(fromBaseUnits(availUsdt, USDT.decimals));
   337	
   338	  if (wbnbUnits * price < MIN_MINT_LEG_USD || usdtUnits < MIN_MINT_LEG_USD) {
   339	    ctx.log({
   340	      event: 'mint-skipped',
   341	      reason: 'insufficient-leg',
   342	      wbnbUnits,
   343	      usdtUnits,
   344	      usdtPerWbnb: price,
   345	    });
   346	    return;
   347	  }
   348	  if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('mint', 3)) {
   349	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-skipped', reason: 'daily-mint-cap' });
   350	    return;
   351	  }
   352	
   353	  const { tickLower, tickUpper } = snapRange(slot0.tick, pctToTickDelta(RANGE_PCT), info.tickSpacing);
   354	  const wallet = new ChassisOphisWallet(ctx.account, ctx.publicClient, ctx.walletClient);
   355	  try {
   356	    await wallet.ensureErc20Allowance(USDT.address, POSITION_MANAGER, availUsdt);
   357	    await wallet.ensureErc20Allowance(WBNB.address, POSITION_MANAGER, availWbnb);
   358	
   359	    const amount0Desired = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? availWbnb : availUsdt;
   360	    const amount1Desired = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? availUsdt : availWbnb;
   361	    const token0 = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? WBNB.address : USDT.address;
   362	    const token1 = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? USDT.address : WBNB.address;
   363	
   364	    const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   365	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   366	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   367	      functionName: 'mint',
   368	      args: [
   369	        {
   370	          token0,
   371	          token1,
   372	          fee: info.fee,
   373	          tickLower,
   374	          tickUpper,
   375	          amount0Desired,
   376	          amount1Desired,
   377	          amount0Min: BigInt(0),
   378	          amount1Min: BigInt(0),
   379	          recipient: ctx.account.address,
   380	          deadline: txDeadline(),
   381	        },
   382	      ],
   383	      account: ctx.account,
   384	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   385	    });
   386	    const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   387	    if (receipt.status !== 'success') {
   388	      ctx.log({ event: 'mint-reverted', txHash: hash });
   389	      return;
   390	    }
   391	    const tokenId = await findMintedTokenId(ctx, receipt.logs);
   392	    const position: PositionState = {
   393	      tokenId: tokenId.toString(),
   394	      tickLower,
   395	      tickUpper,
   396	      outSince: null,
   397	    };
   398	    ctx.state.set('position', position);
   399	    ctx.log({
   400	      event: 'minted',
   401	      txHash: hash,
   402	      tokenId: position.tokenId,
   403	      tickLower,
   404	      tickUpper,
   405	      currentTick: slot0.tick,
   406	      wbnbUnits,
   407	      usdtUnits,
   408	    });
   409	  } catch (err) {
   410	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-failed', error: String(err) });
   411	  }
   412	}
   413	
   414	async function exitPosition(ctx: AgentContext, pos: PositionState): Promise<boolean> {
   415	  const tokenId = BigInt(pos.tokenId);
   416	  try {
   417	    const position = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   418	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   419	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   420	      functionName: 'positions',
   421	      args: [tokenId],
   422	    });
   423	    const liquidity = position[7];
   424	    if (liquidity > BigInt(0)) {
   425	      const decreaseHash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   426	        address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   427	        abi: NPM_ABI,
   428	        functionName: 'decreaseLiquidity',
   429	        args: [
   430	          {
   431	            tokenId,
   432	            liquidity,
   433	            amount0Min: BigInt(0),
   434	            amount1Min: BigInt(0),
   435	            deadline: txDeadline(),
   436	          },
   437	        ],
   438	        account: ctx.account,
   439	        chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   440	      });
   441	      const decreaseReceipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: decreaseHash });
   442	      if (decreaseReceipt.status !== 'success') {
   443	        ctx.log({ event: 'decrease-liquidity-reverted', txHash: decreaseHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   444	        return false;
   445	      }
   446	      ctx.log({ event: 'decrease-liquidity', txHash: decreaseHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   447	    }
   448	    const collectHash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   449	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   450	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   451	      functionName: 'collect',
   452	      args: [
   453	        {
   454	          tokenId,
   455	          recipient: ctx.account.address,
   456	          amount0Max: MAX_UINT128,
   457	          amount1Max: MAX_UINT128,
   458	        },
   459	      ],
   460	      account: ctx.account,
   461	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   462	    });
   463	    const collectReceipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: collectHash });
   464	    if (collectReceipt.status !== 'success') {
   465	      ctx.log({ event: 'collect-reverted', txHash: collectHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   466	      return false;
   467	    }
   468	    ctx.log({ event: 'collected', txHash: collectHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   469	    return true;
   470	  } catch (err) {
   471	    ctx.log({ event: 'exit-failed', tokenId: pos.tokenId, error: String(err) });
   472	    return false;
   473	  }
   474	}
   475	
   476	async function rebalanceInventory(ctx: AgentContext, info: PoolInfo): Promise<void> {
   477	  const [wbnbBal, usdtBal, slot0] = await Promise.all([
   478	    erc20Balance(ctx, WBNB.address),
   479	    erc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   480	    readSlot0(ctx, info.pool),
   481	  ]);
   482	  const price = sqrtPriceX96ToUsdtPerWbnb(slot0.sqrtPriceX96, info.wbnbIsToken0);
   483	  const leg = computeRebalanceLeg(
   484	    Number(fromBaseUnits(wbnbBal, WBNB.decimals)),
   485	    Number(fromBaseUnits(usdtBal, USDT.decimals)),
   486	    price,
   487	  );
   488	  if (!leg) {
   489	    ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-swap-skipped', reason: 'imbalance-under-min-notional' });
   490	    return;
   491	  }
   492	  const sellToken = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? WBNB : USDT;
   493	  const buyToken = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? USDT : WBNB;
   494	  const sellAmount = formatWholeUnits(leg.amountUnits);
   495	  const preSellBalance = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? wbnbBal : usdtBal;
   496	
   497	  const wallet = new ChassisOphisWallet(ctx.account, ctx.publicClient, ctx.walletClient);
   498	  const result = await executeOphisSwap(
   499	    wallet,
   500	    {
   501	      sellToken: sellToken.address,
   502	      buyToken: buyToken.address,
   503	      sellAmount,
   504	      slippageBps: 100,
   505	    },
   506	    {},
   507	  );
   508	  const pendingOrder: PendingOrder = {
   509	    orderUid: result.orderUid,
   510	    sellSymbol: leg.sell,
   511	    sellAmountWei: toBaseUnits(sellAmount, sellToken.decimals).toString(),
   512	    preSellBalanceWei: preSellBalance.toString(),
   513	    placedAt: Date.now(),
   514	  };
   515	  ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', pendingOrder);
   516	  ctx.log({
   517	    event: 'ophis-swap-submitted',
   518	    orderUid: result.orderUid,
   519	    explorerUrl: result.explorerUrl,
   520	    sellToken: sellToken.symbol,
   521	    buyToken: buyToken.symbol,
   522	    sellAmount,
   523	    notionalUsd: leg.notionalUsd,
   524	    minBuyAmount: result.minBuyAmount,
   525	    enrollmentWarning: result.enrollmentWarning ?? null,
   526	  });
   527	
   528	  for (let i = 0; i < FILL_POLL_ATTEMPTS; i += 1) {
   529	    await sleep(FILL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
   530	    const status = await checkPendingOrder(ctx);
   531	    if (status !== 'pending') return;
   532	  }
   533	  ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-fill-poll-timeout', orderUid: result.orderUid });
   534	}
   535	
   536	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   537	/* Agent module                                                        */
   538	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
   539	
   540	export const lpRangeAgent: AgentModule = {
   541	  name: 'lp-range',
   542	  category: 'rebalancing',
   543	  tickIntervalMs: 600_000,
   544	
   545	  async tick(ctx) {
   546	    if (ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted) {
   547	      ctx.log({ event: 'tick-skipped', reason: 'halted' });
   548	      return;
   549	    }
   550	    const info = await resolvePool(ctx);
   551	    const pos = ctx.state.get<PositionState | null>('position', null);
   552	
   553	    if (!pos) {
   554	      await tryMint(ctx, info);
   555	      return;
   556	    }
   557	
   558	    const now = Date.now();
   559	    const slot0 = await readSlot0(ctx, info.pool);
   560	    const inRange = isInRange(slot0.tick, pos.tickLower, pos.tickUpper);
   561	    const outSince = nextOutSince(inRange, pos.outSince, now);
   562	    if (outSince !== pos.outSince) {
   563	      ctx.state.set('position', { ...pos, outSince });
   564	    }
   565	    ctx.log({
   566	      event: 'range-check',
   567	      tokenId: pos.tokenId,
   568	      currentTick: slot0.tick,
   569	      tickLower: pos.tickLower,
   570	      tickUpper: pos.tickUpper,
   571	      inRange,
   572	      outSinceMs: outSince === null ? null : now - outSince,
   573	    });
   574	
   575	    if (!shouldRebalance(outSince, now)) return;
   576	
   577	    const weekly = pruneWindow(ctx.state.get<number[]>('rebalanceTimes', []), now, WEEK_MS);
   578	    if (weekly.length >= MAX_REBALANCES_PER_WEEK) {
   579	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-skipped', reason: 'weekly-cap', rebalancesThisWeek: weekly.length });
   580	      ctx.state.set('rebalanceTimes', weekly);
   581	      return;
   582	    }
   583	    if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('rebalance', 2)) {
   584	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-skipped', reason: 'daily-cap' });
   585	      return;
   586	    }
   587	
   588	    /* Committed: count it even if a later step fails, so caps stay conservative. */
   589	    ctx.state.set('rebalanceTimes', [...weekly, now]);
   590	    ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-start', tokenId: pos.tokenId, currentTick: slot0.tick });
   591	
   592	    const exited = await exitPosition(ctx, pos);
   593	    if (!exited) return;
   594	    ctx.state.set('position', null);
   595	
   596	    try {
   597	      await rebalanceInventory(ctx, info);
   598	    } catch (err) {
   599	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-swap-failed', error: String(err) });
   600	    }
   601	    /* Re-mint defers to the next tick when the Ophis order has not filled yet. */
   602	    await tryMint(ctx, info);
   603	  },
   604	
   605	  async status(ctx) {
   606	    const now = Date.now();
   607	    const pos = ctx.state.get<PositionState | null>('position', null);
   608	    const weekly = pruneWindow(ctx.state.get<number[]>('rebalanceTimes', []), now, WEEK_MS);
   609	    let currentTick: number | null = null;
   610	    try {
   611	      const info = await resolvePool(ctx);
   612	      currentTick = (await readSlot0(ctx, info.pool)).tick;
   613	    } catch {
   614	      currentTick = null;
   615	    }
   616	    const halted = ctx.breakers.isHalted();
   617	    return {
   618	      tokenId: pos?.tokenId ?? null,
   619	      tickLower: pos?.tickLower ?? null,
   620	      tickUpper: pos?.tickUpper ?? null,
   621	      currentTick,
   622	      inRange:
   623	        pos && currentTick !== null ? isInRange(currentTick, pos.tickLower, pos.tickUpper) : null,
   624	      outSinceMinutes:
   625	        pos?.outSince != null ? Math.round((now - pos.outSince) / 60000) : null,
   626	      rebalancesToday: pruneWindow(weekly, now, DAY_MS).length,
   627	      rebalancesThisWeek: weekly.length,
   628	      halted: halted.halted,
   629	    };
   630	  },
   631	};

     1	# @altananetwork/x402-server
     2	
     3	Seller-side x402/B402 payments for agents that charge per request.
     4	
     5	Put `guard()` in front of any HTTP route and it becomes a paid capability:
     6	unpaid requests get a 402 challenge; requests carrying a valid `X-PAYMENT`
     7	header are settled **on-chain, immediately** and passed through.
     8	
     9	Payable out of the box by:
    10	
    11	- **BNB Agent Studio agents** (`bag x402 trust <your-url>` → `bag x402 buy`) —
    12	  they sign EIP-3009 `TransferWithAuthorization` on $U (United Stables).
    13	- **Altana SDK agents** (`fetchWithX402` / the MCP `x402_request` tool) —
    14	  smart-account session keys signing the B402 permit2-exact rail (ERC-1271).
    15	- Anything else speaking the B402 v2 wire (CAIP-2 networks, `scheme:"exact"`,
    16	  `extra.assetTransferMethod`).
    17	
    18	## Usage
    19	
    20	```ts
    21	import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
    22	import { bsc } from "viem/chains";
    23	import { createX402Merchant, U_TOKEN, USDT_BSC } from "@altananetwork/x402-server";
    24	
    25	const merchant = createX402Merchant({
    26	  chainId: 56,
    27	  payTo: "0xYourAltanaSmartAccount",          // where earnings land
    28	  price: 200_000_000_000_000_000n,            // 0.2 per call (18 dec)
    29	  minPrice: 50_000_000_000_000_000n,          // clamp floor
    30	  maxPrice: 2_000_000_000_000_000_000n,       // clamp ceiling
    31	  rails: [
    32	    { rail: "eip3009", token: U_TOKEN[56] },  // Studio buyers
    33	    { rail: "permit2-exact", token: USDT_BSC, spender: facilitator.address }, // Altana/B402 buyers
    34	  ],
    35	  resource: "https://api.example.com/audit",
    36	  facilitator: privateKeyToAccount(process.env.FACILITATOR_KEY),  // settler EOA (gas only)
    37	  rpcUrl: "https://bsc-dataseed.binance.org",
    38	  chain: bsc,
    39	});
    40	
    41	Bun.serve({
    42	  port: 8080,
    43	  async fetch(req) {
    44	    const { response, receipt } = await merchant.guard(req);
    45	    if (response) return response;             // 402 (challenge or rejection)
    46	    return Response.json({ data: await doTheWork(), tx: receipt.txHash });
    47	  },
    48	});
    49	```
    50	
    51	## How settlement works
    52	
    53	| Rail | Buyer signs | Settled via | Verified by |
    54	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
    55	| `eip3009` | `TransferWithAuthorization` ($U) | `token.transferWithAuthorization(bytes)` | the token contract |
    56	| `permit2-exact` | `PermitWitnessTransferFrom` (any Permit2-approved token) | `Permit2.permitWitnessTransferFrom` | Permit2 |
    57	
    58	The facilitator account only broadcasts and pays gas — funds move directly
    59	from the payer to `payTo`. The recipient is **bound into the buyer's
    60	signature** (EIP-3009 `to` / the permit2 `Witness`), so a compromised
    61	facilitator key cannot redirect earnings.
    62	
    63	Off-chain checks run first (token, amount within `[minPrice, maxPrice]`,
    64	recipient, expiry, signature). Checker-restricted smart accounts (Altana
    65	session keys answer `isValidSignature` only to their approved checker) defer
    66	the signature check to the settling contract — an invalid signature reverts
    67	the settlement, and the request is refused. Replay is impossible: EIP-3009
    68	nonces and the Permit2 nonce bitmap burn on-chain.
    69	
    70	## Verified end-to-end
    71	
    72	`tests/e2e/fork-x402-server.ts` runs both buyer families against a real
    73	BNB-mainnet fork (genuine $U, USDT and Permit2 bytecode): Studio-envelope
    74	eip3009 settlement, Altana session-key permit2-witness settlement, and replay
    75	refusal. Run it with `bun run fork:x402-server` from `tests/e2e`.

FILE node_modules/.pnpm/@altananetwork+x402-server@0.2.0_@types+react@19.2.18_@wagmi+core@3.6.4_@types+react@19_ca3fd455aaaa7c094df0c0b0af270986/node_modules/@altananetwork/x402-server/dist/merchant.js
     1	import { createPublicClient, createWalletClient, http, } from "viem";
     2	import { buildChallenge } from "./challenge.js";
     3	import { decodeXPayment } from "./decode.js";
     4	import { settlePayment } from "./settle.js";
     5	import { verifyPayment } from "./verify.js";
     6	/**
     7	 * A framework-agnostic x402/B402 merchant: give it your price, your payout
     8	 * address, and a funded facilitator key; put `requirePayment` in front of any
     9	 * paid route. Payable by BNB Agent Studio buyers (`bag x402 buy`), Altana
    10	 * `fetchWithX402` buyers, and anything else speaking the B402 v2 wire.
    11	 */
    12	export function createX402Merchant(opts) {
    13	    const publicClient = createPublicClient({
    14	        chain: opts.chain,
    15	        transport: http(opts.rpcUrl),
    16	    });
    17	    const walletClient = createWalletClient({
    18	        account: opts.facilitator,
    19	        chain: opts.chain,
    20	        transport: http(opts.rpcUrl),
    21	    });
    22	    // In-process replay guard so one authorization can't settle twice in a race;
    23	    // the on-chain nonce is the durable source of truth.
    24	    const seen = new Set();
    25	    const challengeBody = () => buildChallenge(opts);
    26	    async function requirePayment(xPaymentHeader) {
    27	        if (!xPaymentHeader)
    28	            return { status: 402, body: challengeBody() };
    29	        let decoded;
    30	        try {
    31	            decoded = decodeXPayment(xPaymentHeader);
    32	        }
    33	        catch (e) {
    34	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `invalid X-PAYMENT: ${e.message}` } };
    35	        }
    36	        const verdict = await verifyPayment(decoded, opts, {
    37	            // ERC-1271/ERC-6492-capable verification: smart-account payers welcome.
    38	            verifySignature: (args) => publicClient.verifyTypedData(args),
    39	            // Checker-restricted accounts (Altana session keys) defer to settlement.
    40	            isContract: async (address) => {
    41	                const code = await publicClient.getCode({ address });
    42	                return code != null && code !== "0x";
    43	            },
    44	        });
    45	        if (!verdict.ok) {
    46	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `payment rejected: ${verdict.reason}` } };
    47	        }
    48	        const nonceKey = decoded.rail === "eip3009"
    49	            ? `3009:${decoded.payer}:${decoded.authorization.nonce}`
    50	            : `p2:${decoded.payer}:${decoded.permit.nonce}`;
    51	        if (seen.has(nonceKey)) {
    52	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: "payment rejected: replayed authorization" } };
    53	        }
    54	        seen.add(nonceKey);
    55	        try {
    56	            const settled = await settlePayment(decoded, opts, { wallet: walletClient, public: publicClient });
    57	            return {
    58	                status: 200,
    59	                receipt: { ...settled, payer: decoded.payer, amount: decoded.amount, token: verdict.token, rail: decoded.rail },
    60	            };
    61	        }
    62	        catch (e) {
    63	            seen.delete(nonceKey); // let an honest retry through (e.g. RPC hiccup)
    64	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `settlement failed: ${e.message}` } };
    65	        }
    66	    }
    67	    /** Fetch-API sugar: returns null when paid (proceed), or a Response to send. */
    68	    async function guard(request) {
    69	        // b402 buyers send the envelope under PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; ours sends both.
    70	        const result = await requirePayment(request.headers.get("X-PAYMENT") ?? request.headers.get("PAYMENT-SIGNATURE"));
    71	        if (result.status === 200)
    72	            return { response: null, receipt: result.receipt };
    73	        return {
    74	            response: new Response(JSON.stringify(result.body), {
    75	                status: 402,
    76	                headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    77	            }),
    78	        };
    79	    }
    80	    return { challengeBody, requirePayment, guard };
    81	}

     1	import { buildEip3009TypedData, buildPermit2TypedData, buildPermit2WitnessTypedData, } from "@altananetwork/sdk";
     2	import { effectivePrice } from "./challenge.js";
     3	function matchRail(cfg, d) {
     4	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
     5	        return cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "eip3009" &&
     6	            (d.token === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ||
     7	                r.token.address.toLowerCase() === d.token.toLowerCase()));
     8	    }
     9	    return cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "permit2-exact" && r.token.address.toLowerCase() === d.token.toLowerCase());
    10	}
    11	/**
    12	 * Verify a decoded payment against the merchant config — token/amount/payTo/
    13	 * expiry business rules first (cheap), then the cryptographic signature.
    14	 * Settlement is the on-chain source of truth for nonce replay; this function
    15	 * makes sure only payments worth broadcasting reach it.
    16	 */
    17	export async function verifyPayment(d, cfg, opts) {
    18	    const now = BigInt(opts.now ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
    19	    if (d.chainId != null && d.chainId !== cfg.chainId) {
    20	        return { ok: false, reason: `wrong chain: payment is for ${d.chainId}, merchant is on ${cfg.chainId}` };
    21	    }
    22	    const rail = matchRail(cfg, d);
    23	    if (!rail) {
    24	        return { ok: false, reason: `token ${d.token} is not offered on any configured rail` };
    25	    }
    26	    const token = rail.token;
    27	    const price = effectivePrice(cfg);
    28	    if (d.amount < price) {
    29	        return { ok: false, reason: `amount ${d.amount} below the quoted price ${price}` };
    30	    }
    31	    if (cfg.maxPrice != null && d.amount > cfg.maxPrice) {
    32	        return { ok: false, reason: `amount ${d.amount} above maxPrice ${cfg.maxPrice}` };
    33	    }
    34	    let typedData;
    35	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
    36	        const a = d.authorization;
    37	        if (a.to.toLowerCase() !== cfg.payTo.toLowerCase()) {
    38	            return { ok: false, reason: `payTo mismatch: authorization pays ${a.to}, merchant is ${cfg.payTo}` };
    39	        }
    40	        if (BigInt(a.validBefore) <= now)
    41	            return { ok: false, reason: "authorization expired (validBefore in the past)" };
    42	        if (BigInt(a.validAfter) >= now)
    43	            return { ok: false, reason: "authorization not yet valid (validAfter in the future)" };
    44	        typedData = buildEip3009TypedData({
    45	            chainId: cfg.chainId,
    46	            token: token.address,
    47	            name: token.name,
    48	            version: token.version,
    49	            from: a.from,
    50	            to: a.to,
    51	            value: BigInt(a.value),
    52	            validAfter: BigInt(a.validAfter),
    53	            validBefore: BigInt(a.validBefore),
    54	            nonce: a.nonce,
    55	        });
    56	    }
    57	    else {
    58	        const p = d.permit;
    59	        if (rail.rail !== "permit2-exact" || p.spender.toLowerCase() !== rail.spender.toLowerCase()) {
    60	            return { ok: false, reason: `permit spender ${p.spender} is not the configured settler` };
    61	        }
    62	        if (BigInt(p.deadline) <= now)
    63	            return { ok: false, reason: "permit expired (deadline in the past)" };
    64	        const base = {
    65	            chainId: cfg.chainId,
    66	            token: p.permitted.token,
    67	            amount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount),
    68	            spender: p.spender,
    69	            nonce: BigInt(p.nonce),
    70	            deadline: BigInt(p.deadline),
    71	        };
    72	        if (d.rail === "permit2-witness") {
    73	            if (p.witness.to.toLowerCase() !== cfg.payTo.toLowerCase()) {
    74	                return { ok: false, reason: `payTo mismatch: witness pays ${p.witness.to}, merchant is ${cfg.payTo}` };
    75	            }
    76	            if (BigInt(p.witness.validAfter) >= now) {
    77	                return { ok: false, reason: "permit not yet valid (witness validAfter in the future)" };
    78	            }
    79	            typedData = buildPermit2WitnessTypedData({
    80	                ...base,
    81	                to: p.witness.to,
    82	                validAfter: BigInt(p.witness.validAfter),
    83	            });
    84	        }
    85	        else {
    86	            typedData = buildPermit2TypedData(base);
    87	        }
    88	    }
    89	    let valid = false;
    90	    try {
    91	        valid = await opts.verifySignature({ address: d.payer, signature: d.signature, ...typedData });
    92	    }
    93	    catch {
    94	        valid = false;
    95	    }
    96	    if (!valid && opts.isContract) {
    97	        // Checker-restricted smart accounts can't be pre-verified off-chain; the
    98	        // settlement contract (Permit2 / the token) is the authoritative verifier.
    99	        try {
   100	            valid = await opts.isContract(d.payer);
   101	        }
   102	        catch {
   103	            valid = false;
   104	        }
   105	    }
   106	    if (!valid)
   107	        return { ok: false, reason: "signature verification failed" };
   108	    return { ok: true, rail: d.rail, payer: d.payer, amount: d.amount, token: token.address };
   109	}

     1	import { encodeAbiParameters, encodeFunctionData, keccak256, toHex, } from "viem";
     2	import { PERMIT2_ADDRESS } from "@altananetwork/sdk";
     3	/** FiatTokenV2_2-style EIP-3009 with a `bytes` signature (EOA 65-byte sigs and
     4	 * ERC-1271-aware deployments alike). $U exposes this on both BSC networks. */
     5	const EIP3009_ABI = [
     6	    {
     7	        name: "transferWithAuthorization",
     8	        type: "function",
     9	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    10	        inputs: [
    11	            { name: "from", type: "address" },
    12	            { name: "to", type: "address" },
    13	            { name: "value", type: "uint256" },
    14	            { name: "validAfter", type: "uint256" },
    15	            { name: "validBefore", type: "uint256" },
    16	            { name: "nonce", type: "bytes32" },
    17	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    18	        ],
    19	        outputs: [],
    20	    },
    21	];
    22	const PERMIT2_ABI = [
    23	    {
    24	        name: "permitTransferFrom",
    25	        type: "function",
    26	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    27	        inputs: [
    28	            { name: "permit", type: "tuple", components: [
    29	                    { name: "permitted", type: "tuple", components: [
    30	                            { name: "token", type: "address" },
    31	                            { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
    32	                        ] },
    33	                    { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
    34	                    { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
    35	                ] },
    36	            { name: "transferDetails", type: "tuple", components: [
    37	                    { name: "to", type: "address" },
    38	                    { name: "requestedAmount", type: "uint256" },
    39	                ] },
    40	            { name: "owner", type: "address" },
    41	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    42	        ],
    43	        outputs: [],
    44	    },
    45	    {
    46	        name: "permitWitnessTransferFrom",
    47	        type: "function",
    48	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    49	        inputs: [
    50	            { name: "permit", type: "tuple", components: [
    51	                    { name: "permitted", type: "tuple", components: [
    52	                            { name: "token", type: "address" },
    53	                            { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
    54	                        ] },
    55	                    { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
    56	                    { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
    57	                ] },
    58	            { name: "transferDetails", type: "tuple", components: [
    59	                    { name: "to", type: "address" },
    60	                    { name: "requestedAmount", type: "uint256" },
    61	                ] },
    62	            { name: "owner", type: "address" },
    63	            { name: "witness", type: "bytes32" },
    64	            { name: "witnessTypeString", type: "string" },
    65	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    66	        ],
    67	        outputs: [],
    68	    },
    69	];
    70	/**
    71	 * The witness type-string suffix Permit2 appends to its
    72	 * `PermitWitnessTransferFrom(...,` typehash stub. Must reproduce the exact
    73	 * EIP-712 encoding of `buildPermit2WitnessTypedData` (the B402 permit2-exact
    74	 * digest): referenced types sorted alphabetically after the primary type.
    75	 */
    76	const WITNESS_TYPE_STRING = "Witness witness)TokenPermissions(address token,uint256 amount)Witness(address to,uint256 validAfter)";
    77	const WITNESS_TYPEHASH = keccak256(toHex("Witness(address to,uint256 validAfter)"));
    78	export function witnessHash(to, validAfter) {
    79	    return keccak256(encodeAbiParameters([{ type: "bytes32" }, { type: "address" }, { type: "uint256" }], [WITNESS_TYPEHASH, to, validAfter]));
    80	}
    81	/**
    82	 * Broadcast the payment on-chain from the facilitator wallet and wait for
    83	 * inclusion. Reverts (wrong signature, replayed nonce, insufficient balance)
    84	 * surface as thrown errors — the caller answers 402.
    85	 */
    86	export async function settlePayment(d, cfg, clients) {
    87	    let to;
    88	    let data;
    89	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
    90	        const rail = cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "eip3009");
    91	        if (!rail)
    92	            throw new Error("settle: no eip3009 rail configured");
    93	        const a = d.authorization;
    94	        to = rail.token.address;
    95	        data = encodeFunctionData({
    96	            abi: EIP3009_ABI,
    97	            functionName: "transferWithAuthorization",
    98	            args: [a.from, a.to, BigInt(a.value), BigInt(a.validAfter), BigInt(a.validBefore), a.nonce, d.signature],
    99	        });
   100	    }
   101	    else {
   102	        const p = d.permit;
   103	        const permit = {
   104	            permitted: { token: p.permitted.token, amount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount) },
   105	            nonce: BigInt(p.nonce),
   106	            deadline: BigInt(p.deadline),
   107	        };
   108	        const transferDetails = { to: cfg.payTo, requestedAmount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount) };
   109	        to = PERMIT2_ADDRESS;
   110	        data =
   111	            d.rail === "permit2-witness"
   112	                ? encodeFunctionData({
   113	                    abi: PERMIT2_ABI,
   114	                    functionName: "permitWitnessTransferFrom",
   115	                    args: [
   116	                        permit,
   117	                        transferDetails,
   118	                        d.payer,
   119	                        witnessHash(p.witness.to, BigInt(p.witness.validAfter)),
   120	                        WITNESS_TYPE_STRING,
   121	                        d.signature,
   122	                    ],
   123	                })
   124	                : encodeFunctionData({
   125	                    abi: PERMIT2_ABI,
   126	                    functionName: "permitTransferFrom",
   127	                    args: [permit, transferDetails, d.payer, d.signature],
   128	                });
   129	    }
   130	    const account = clients.wallet.account;
   131	    if (!account)
   132	        throw new Error("settle: facilitator wallet client has no account");
   133	    const txHash = await clients.wallet.sendTransaction({ account, to, data, chain: clients.wallet.chain });
   134	    const receipt = await clients.public.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: txHash });
   135	    if (receipt.status !== "success") {
   136	        throw new Error(`settle: transaction ${txHash} reverted`);
   137	    }
   138	    return { txHash };
   139	}

     1	const ADDR = /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/;
     2	const HEX = /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]+$/;
     3	function asAddress(v, field) {
     4	    if (typeof v !== "string" || !ADDR.test(v)) {
     5	        throw new Error(`X-PAYMENT: missing/invalid address in ${field}`);
     6	    }
     7	    return v;
     8	}
     9	function asHex(v, field) {
    10	    if (typeof v !== "string" || !HEX.test(v)) {
    11	        throw new Error(`X-PAYMENT: missing/invalid hex in ${field}`);
    12	    }
    13	    return v;
    14	}
    15	function asNumeric(v, field) {
    16	    const s = typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : v;
    17	    if (typeof s !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
    18	        throw new Error(`X-PAYMENT: missing/invalid integer in ${field}`);
    19	    }
    20	    return s;
    21	}
    22	function chainIdOf(envelope, accepted) {
    23	    for (const net of [accepted?.network, envelope.network]) {
    24	        if (typeof net === "string") {
    25	            const m = /^eip155:(\d+)$/.exec(net);
    26	            if (m)
    27	                return Number(m[1]);
    28	        }
    29	    }
    30	    const cid = accepted?.chainId ?? envelope.chainId;
    31	    if (cid != null && /^\d+$/.test(String(cid)))
    32	        return Number(cid);
    33	    return undefined;
    34	}
    35	/**
    36	 * Decode and normalize an `X-PAYMENT` header.
    37	 *
    38	 * Tolerates both buyer envelope dialects:
    39	 *  - Studio: `{x402Version, resource, accepted, payload:{signature, authorization}}`
    40	 *  - Altana: `{x402Version, scheme, network, resource?, accepted?, payload:{signature, authorization | from+permit}}`
    41	 *  - b402:   permit2 authorizations arrive as `payload.permit2Authorization`
    42	 *            with `from` nested inside, rather than `permit` + `payload.from`.
    43	 *
    44	 * Throws on malformed input; business-rule checks live in `verifyPayment`.
    45	 */
    46	export function decodeXPayment(header) {
    47	    let envelope;
    48	    try {
    49	        envelope = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(header, "base64").toString("utf8"));
    50	    }
    51	    catch {
    52	        throw new Error("X-PAYMENT is not base64-encoded JSON");
    53	    }
    54	    if (typeof envelope !== "object" || envelope === null) {
    55	        throw new Error("X-PAYMENT: envelope is not an object");
    56	    }
    57	    const payload = envelope.payload;
    58	    if (!payload)
    59	        throw new Error("X-PAYMENT: missing payload");
    60	    const accepted = envelope.accepted;
    61	    const signature = asHex(payload.signature, "payload.signature");
    62	    const chainId = chainIdOf(envelope, accepted);
    63	    // eip3009: payload.authorization (both dialects use the same inner shape).
    64	    if (payload.authorization) {
    65	        const a = payload.authorization;
    66	        const authorization = {
    67	            from: asAddress(a.from, "authorization.from"),
    68	            to: asAddress(a.to, "authorization.to"),
    69	            value: asNumeric(a.value, "authorization.value"),
    70	            validAfter: asNumeric(a.validAfter, "authorization.validAfter"),
    71	            validBefore: asNumeric(a.validBefore, "authorization.validBefore"),
    72	            nonce: asHex(a.nonce, "authorization.nonce"),
    73	        };
    74	        const token = accepted?.asset != null ? asAddress(accepted.asset, "accepted.asset") : undefined;
    75	        return {
    76	            rail: "eip3009",
    77	            payer: authorization.from,
    78	            amount: BigInt(authorization.value),
    79	            // eip3009 verification/settlement resolves the token from the matched
    80	            // rail config; `accepted.asset` is the buyer's claim of it.
    81	            token: token ?? "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    82	            signature,
    83	            chainId,
    84	            authorization,
    85	            accepted,
    86	            raw: envelope,
    87	        };
    88	    }
    89	    // permit2 / permit2-witness. Two dialects carry the same authorization:
    90	    //  - Altana: `payload.permit` + a sibling `payload.from`
    91	    //  - b402:   `payload.permit2Authorization` with `from` nested inside
    92	    // Our buyer emits both; third-party b402 buyers send only the latter.
    93	    const permitField = payload.permit ?? payload.permit2Authorization;
    94	    if (permitField) {
    95	        const p = permitField;
    96	        const permitted = p.permitted;
    97	        if (!permitted)
    98	            throw new Error("X-PAYMENT: missing permit.permitted");
    99	        const witness = p.witness;
   100	        const permit = {
   101	            permitted: {
   102	                token: asAddress(permitted.token, "permit.permitted.token"),
   103	                amount: asNumeric(permitted.amount, "permit.permitted.amount"),
   104	            },
   105	            spender: asAddress(p.spender, "permit.spender"),
   106	            nonce: asNumeric(p.nonce, "permit.nonce"),
   107	            deadline: asNumeric(p.deadline, "permit.deadline"),
   108	            ...(witness
   109	                ? {
   110	                    witness: {
   111	                        to: asAddress(witness.to, "permit.witness.to"),
   112	                        validAfter: asNumeric(witness.validAfter, "permit.witness.validAfter"),
   113	                    },
   114	                }
   115	                : {}),
   116	        };
   117	        return {
   118	            rail: witness ? "permit2-witness" : "permit2",
   119	            payer: asAddress(payload.from ?? p.from, "payload.from"),
   120	            amount: BigInt(permit.permitted.amount),
   121	            token: permit.permitted.token,
   122	            signature,
   123	            chainId,
   124	            permit,
   125	            accepted,
   126	            raw: envelope,
   127	        };
   128	    }
   129	    throw new Error("X-PAYMENT: payload carries neither authorization (eip3009) nor permit/permit2Authorization (permit2)");
   130	}

     1	/** Clamp the quoted price into [minPrice, maxPrice] (mirrors studio.toml semantics). */
     2	export function effectivePrice(cfg) {
     3	    let p = cfg.price;
     4	    if (cfg.minPrice != null && p < cfg.minPrice)
     5	        p = cfg.minPrice;
     6	    if (cfg.maxPrice != null && p > cfg.maxPrice)
     7	        p = cfg.maxPrice;

    10	/**
    11	 * Build the 402 challenge body. Every entry uses the real B402 v2 wire shape
    12	 * (`scheme:"exact"`, CAIP-2 network, `extra.assetTransferMethod`) so it is
    13	 * payable by BNB Agent Studio buyers (eip3009/$U) and Altana `fetchWithX402`
    14	 * buyers (permit2-exact) alike.
    15	 */
    16	export function buildChallenge(cfg) {
    17	    const amount = effectivePrice(cfg).toString();
    18	    const network = `eip155:${cfg.chainId}`;
    19	    // Default 300s, and keep custom values ≤480s if Studio buyers matter: their
    20	    // hardened signer refuses validity windows >600s and backdates validAfter
    21	    // by 120s, so a 600s challenge yields a 720s window and is refused.
    22	    const timeout = cfg.maxTimeoutSeconds ?? 300;
    23	    const accepts = cfg.rails.map((rail) => ({
    24	        scheme: "exact",
    25	        network,
    26	        asset: rail.token.address,
    27	        payTo: cfg.payTo,
    28	        amount,
    29	        maxTimeoutSeconds: timeout,
    30	        extra: {
    31	            name: rail.token.name,
    32	            version: rail.token.version,
    33	            assetTransferMethod: rail.rail,
    34	            ...(rail.rail === "permit2-exact" ? { spenderAddress: rail.spender } : {}),
    35	        },
    36	    }));
    37	    return {
    38	        x402Version: 2,
    39	        error: "payment required",
    40	        // Real b402 challenges carry `resource` as an object; a bare URL string is
    41	        // normalized so buyers always see the shape their merchants expect.
    42	        ...(cfg.resource
    43	            ? {
    44	                resource: typeof cfg.resource === "string" ? { url: cfg.resource } : cfg.resource,
    45	            }
    46	            : {}),
    47	        ...(cfg.description ? { description: cfg.description } : {}),
    48	        accepts,
    49	    };
    50	}

    83	export function computeLevels(
    84	  center: number,
    85	  spacing = GRID_SPACING,
    86	  perSide = GRID_LEVELS_PER_SIDE,
    87	): GridLevel[] {
    88	  const levels: GridLevel[] = [];
    89	  for (let i = 1; i <= perSide; i++) {
    90	    levels.push({ key: `sell:${i}`, side: 'sell', index: i, price: center * (1 + spacing * i) });
    91	  }
    92	  for (let i = 1; i <= perSide; i++) {
    93	    levels.push({ key: `buy:${i}`, side: 'buy', index: i, price: center * (1 - spacing * i) });
    94	  }
    95	  return levels;
    96	}
