    98	/** USDT per WBNB from slot0. Both tokens are 18 decimals on BSC, so the raw
    99	 * ratio needs no decimal adjustment. */
   100	export function priceFromSqrtPriceX96(sqrtPriceX96: bigint, wbnbIsToken0: boolean): number {
   101	  const ratio = Number(sqrtPriceX96) / 2 ** 96;
   102	  const token1PerToken0 = ratio * ratio;
   103	  return wbnbIsToken0 ? token1PerToken0 : 1 / token1PerToken0;
   104	}
   105	
   106	function isBeyond(price: number, level: GridLevel): boolean {
   107	  return level.side === 'sell' ? price >= level.price : price <= level.price;
   108	}
   109	
   110	/**
   111	 * Pick the single level to trade this tick: the nearest-to-center level the
   112	 * price sits beyond that is not marked crossed. When one tick jumps several
   113	 * levels only the nearest trades now; the farther ones stay unmarked and are
   114	 * picked up on later ticks while price remains beyond them (crossedThisTick
   115	 * false marks that carried case for the log).
   116	 */
   117	export function detectCrossing(
   118	  prevPrice: number,
   119	  price: number,
   120	  levels: GridLevel[],
   121	  crossed: Iterable<string>,
   122	): { level: GridLevel; crossedThisTick: boolean } | null {
   123	  const marked = crossed instanceof Set ? (crossed as Set<string>) : new Set(crossed);
   124	  const eligible = levels
   125	    .filter((l) => !marked.has(l.key) && isBeyond(price, l))
   126	    .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
   127	  const level = eligible[0];
   128	  if (!level) return null;
   129	  return { level, crossedThisTick: !isBeyond(prevPrice, level) };
   130	}
   131	
   132	/** All marks clear once price returns to within half a grid step of center,
   133	 * boundary inclusive. Formulated without division to keep the exact boundary
   134	 * free of float artifacts. */
   135	export function unmarkNearCenter(
   136	  price: number,
   137	  center: number,
   138	  crossed: string[],
   139	  spacing = GRID_SPACING,
   140	): string[] {
   141	  if (crossed.length === 0) return crossed;
   142	  return Math.abs(price - center) <= center * (spacing / 2) ? [] : crossed;
   143	}
   144	
   145	/** Fixed-notation decimal string with the given significant digits; never
   146	 * exponent notation, since toBaseUnits rejects it. */
   147	export function toSignificant(value: number, digits: number): string {
   148	  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
   149	    throw new Error(`toSignificant: expected a positive finite number, got ${value}`);
   150	  }
   151	  const precise = value.toPrecision(digits);
   152	  const eIndex = precise.toLowerCase().indexOf('e');
   153	  const expanded = eIndex < 0 ? precise : expandExponential(precise, eIndex);
   154	  return trimTrailingZeros(expanded);
   155	}
   156	
   157	function expandExponential(s: string, eIndex: number): string {
   158	  const mantissa = s.slice(0, eIndex);
   159	  const exp = Number(s.slice(eIndex + 1));
   160	  const dot = mantissa.indexOf('.');
   161	  const digits = dot < 0 ? mantissa : mantissa.slice(0, dot) + mantissa.slice(dot + 1);
   162	  const intLen = (dot < 0 ? mantissa.length : dot) + exp;
   163	  if (intLen <= 0) return '0.' + '0'.repeat(-intLen) + digits;
   164	  if (intLen >= digits.length) return digits + '0'.repeat(intLen - digits.length);
   165	  return digits.slice(0, intLen) + '.' + digits.slice(intLen);
   166	}
   167	
   168	function trimTrailingZeros(s: string): string {
   169	  if (!s.includes('.')) return s;
   170	  return s.replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '');
   171	}
   172	
   173	/** $2 notional clip: buys spend a fixed '2' USDT; sells move 2/price WBNB
   174	 * quoted to 6 significant digits. */
   175	export function clipForLevel(
   176	  side: GridSide,
   177	  price: number,
   178	  clipUsd = CLIP_USD,
   179	): { token: 'WBNB' | 'USDT'; amount: string } {
   180	  if (side === 'buy') return { token: 'USDT', amount: String(clipUsd) };
   181	  return { token: 'WBNB', amount: toSignificant(clipUsd / price, 6) };
   182	}
   183	
   184	export function inventoryValueUsd(wbnbWhole: number, usdtWhole: number, price: number): number {
   185	  return wbnbWhole * price + usdtWhole;
   186	}
   187	
   188	export function isCooldownActive(
   189	  nowMs: number,
   190	  lastFillAtMs: number | null,
   191	  cooldownMs = COOLDOWN_MS,
   192	): boolean {
   193	  return lastFillAtMs !== null && nowMs - lastFillAtMs < cooldownMs;
   194	}
   195	
   196	/** Breakout is strictly greater than the cap; exactly 6 percent still trades.
   197	 * Formulated without division: price/center - 1 carries a float artifact that
   198	 * pushes the exact boundary over the cap. */
   199	export function isTrendBreakout(
   200	  price: number,
   201	  center: number,
   202	  maxDeviation = TREND_MAX_DEVIATION,
   203	): boolean {
   204	  return price > center * (1 + maxDeviation) || price < center * (1 - maxDeviation);
   205	}
   206	
   207	/** Breach is strictly below the floor; exactly 95 percent still trades. */
   208	export function isLossBreach(
   209	  inventoryNowUsd: number,
   210	  inventoryStartUsd: number,
   211	  floor = LOSS_FLOOR_FRACTION,
   212	): boolean {
   213	  return inventoryNowUsd < inventoryStartUsd * floor;
   214	}
   215	
   216	export type GuardFailure =
   217	  | 'cooldown'
   218	  | 'rate-limit'
   219	  | 'trend-breakout'
   220	  | 'daily-loss'
   221	  | 'insufficient-balance';
   222	
   223	export interface GuardInput {
   224	  nowMs: number;
   225	  lastFillAtMs: number | null;
   226	  price: number;
   227	  center: number;
   228	  inventoryNowUsd: number;
   229	  inventoryStartUsd: number;
   230	  clipBaseUnits: bigint;
   231	  balanceBaseUnits: bigint;
   232	  /** Lazy so the persisted action counter records only when the chain
   233	   * actually reaches it, and never during cooldown. */
   234	  allowTrade: () => boolean;
   235	  cooldownMs?: number;
   236	  maxDeviation?: number;
   237	  lossFloor?: number;
   238	}
   239	
   240	export type GuardResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: GuardFailure; halt: boolean };
   241	
   242	/** Spec-fixed guard order: cooldown, rate limit, trend halt, loss halt,
   243	 * balance sufficiency. halt true means the caller must trip the breaker. */
   244	export function evaluateGuards(input: GuardInput): GuardResult {
   245	  if (isCooldownActive(input.nowMs, input.lastFillAtMs, input.cooldownMs)) {
   246	    return { ok: false, reason: 'cooldown', halt: false };
   247	  }
   248	  if (!input.allowTrade()) {
   249	    return { ok: false, reason: 'rate-limit', halt: false };
   250	  }
   251	  if (isTrendBreakout(input.price, input.center, input.maxDeviation)) {
   252	    return { ok: false, reason: 'trend-breakout', halt: true };
   253	  }
   254	  if (isLossBreach(input.inventoryNowUsd, input.inventoryStartUsd, input.lossFloor)) {
   255	    return { ok: false, reason: 'daily-loss', halt: true };
   256	  }
   257	  if (input.balanceBaseUnits < input.clipBaseUnits) {
   258	    return { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-balance', halt: false };
   259	  }
   260	  return { ok: true };
   261	}
   262	
   263	/* ----------------------------- chain access ----------------------------- */
   264	
   265	interface ReferencePool {
   266	  address: `0x${string}`;
   267	  fee: number;
   268	  wbnbIsToken0: boolean;
   269	}
   270	
   271	async function resolveReferencePool(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<ReferencePool> {
   272	  const cached = ctx.state.get<ReferencePool | null>('referencePool', null);
   273	  if (cached) return cached;
   274	
   275	  let best: { pool: ReferencePool; liquidity: bigint } | null = null;
   276	  for (const fee of FEE_TIERS) {
   277	    const address = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   278	      address: PANCAKE_V3_FACTORY,
   279	      abi: FACTORY_ABI,
   280	      functionName: 'getPool',
   281	      args: [WBNB.address, USDT.address, fee],
   282	    });
   283	    if (address.toLowerCase() === ZERO_ADDRESS) continue;
   284	    const [token0, token1, poolFee, liquidity] = await Promise.all([
   285	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'token0' }),
   286	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'token1' }),
   287	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'fee' }),
   288	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'liquidity' }),
   289	    ]);
   290	    const pair = [token0.toLowerCase(), token1.toLowerCase()].sort().join('/');
   291	    const expected = [WBNB.address.toLowerCase(), USDT.address.toLowerCase()].sort().join('/');
   292	    if (pair !== expected || poolFee !== fee) {
   293	      ctx.log({ event: 'pool-mismatch', address, fee, token0, token1, poolFee });
   294	      continue;
   295	    }
   296	    ctx.log({ event: 'pool-probe', address, fee, liquidity: liquidity.toString() });
   297	    const pool: ReferencePool = {
   298	      address,
   299	      fee,
   300	      wbnbIsToken0: token0.toLowerCase() === WBNB.address.toLowerCase(),
   301	    };
   302	    if (!best || liquidity > best.liquidity) best = { pool, liquidity };
   303	  }
   304	  if (!best) throw new Error('no valid WBNB/USDT PancakeSwap V3 pool found via factory');
   305	  ctx.state.set('referencePool', best.pool);
   306	  ctx.log({ event: 'pool-selected', ...best.pool, liquidity: best.liquidity.toString() });
   307	  return best.pool;
   308	}
   309	
   310	async function readMidPrice(ctx: AgentContext, pool: ReferencePool): Promise<number> {
   311	  const slot0 = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   312	    address: pool.address,
   313	    abi: POOL_ABI,
   314	    functionName: 'slot0',
   315	  });
   316	  return priceFromSqrtPriceX96(slot0[0], pool.wbnbIsToken0);
   317	}
   318	
   319	async function readBalances(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<{ wbnb: bigint; usdt: bigint }> {
   320	  const [wbnb, usdt] = await Promise.all([
   321	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   322	      address: WBNB.address,
   323	      abi: erc20Abi,
   324	      functionName: 'balanceOf',
   325	      args: [ctx.account.address],
   326	    }),
   327	    ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   328	      address: USDT.address,
   329	      abi: erc20Abi,
   330	      functionName: 'balanceOf',
   331	      args: [ctx.account.address],
   332	    }),
   333	  ]);
   334	  return { wbnb, usdt };
   335	}

   337	/* -------------------------------- module -------------------------------- */
   338	
   339	export const gridAgent: AgentModule = {
   340	  name: 'grid',
   341	  category: 'grid',
   342	  tickIntervalMs: 120_000,
   343	
   344	  async tick(ctx) {
   345	    if (ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted) return;
   346	
   347	    const pool = await resolveReferencePool(ctx);
   348	    const price = await readMidPrice(ctx, pool);
   349	    const balances = await readBalances(ctx);
   350	    const wbnbWhole = Number(fromBaseUnits(balances.wbnb, WBNB.decimals));
   351	    const usdtWhole = Number(fromBaseUnits(balances.usdt, USDT.decimals));
   352	    const inventoryNowUsd = inventoryValueUsd(wbnbWhole, usdtWhole, price);
   353	
   354	    const storedCenter = ctx.state.get<number | null>('center', null);
   355	    if (storedCenter === null) {
   356	      ctx.state.set('center', price);
   357	      ctx.state.set('inventoryStartUsd', inventoryNowUsd);
   358	      ctx.state.set('lastPrice', price);
   359	      ctx.log({
   360	        event: 'grid-init',
   361	        center: price,
   362	        inventoryStartUsd: inventoryNowUsd,
   363	        wbnbWhole,
   364	        usdtWhole,
   365	        pool: pool.address,
   366	        feeTier: pool.fee,
   367	      });
   368	      return;
   369	    }
   370	    const center = storedCenter;
   371	    const inventoryStartUsd = ctx.state.get<number>('inventoryStartUsd', inventoryNowUsd);
   372	    const prevPrice = ctx.state.get<number>('lastPrice', price);
   373	    ctx.state.set('lastPrice', price);
   374	
   375	    let crossed = ctx.state.get<string[]>('crossedLevels', []);
   376	    const afterUnmark = unmarkNearCenter(price, center, crossed);
   377	    if (afterUnmark.length !== crossed.length) {
   378	      ctx.log({ event: 'levels-unmarked', cleared: crossed, price, center });
   379	      ctx.state.set('crossedLevels', afterUnmark);
   380	      crossed = afterUnmark;
   381	    }
   382	
   383	    const levels = computeLevels(center);
   384	    const hit = detectCrossing(prevPrice, price, levels, crossed);
   385	    if (!hit) {
   386	      // With every level already marked the guard chain below is never
   387	      // reached, so the breakout and drawdown breakers must also fire here
   388	      // or a runaway trend would leave the agent unprotected.
   389	      if (isTrendBreakout(price, center)) {
   390	        ctx.log({ event: 'trend-breakout', price, center });
   391	        ctx.breakers.halt('trend-breakout');
   392	        return;
   393	      }
   394	      if (isLossBreach(inventoryNowUsd, inventoryStartUsd)) {
   395	        ctx.log({ event: 'daily-loss', inventoryNowUsd, inventoryStartUsd });
   396	        ctx.breakers.halt('daily-loss');
   397	        return;
   398	      }
   399	      ctx.log({ event: 'tick', price, center, inventoryNowUsd, crossedCount: crossed.length });
   400	      return;
   401	    }
   402	
   403	    const clip = clipForLevel(hit.level.side, price);
   404	    const clipToken = clip.token === 'WBNB' ? WBNB : USDT;
   405	    const clipBaseUnits = toBaseUnits(clip.amount, clipToken.decimals);
   406	    const balanceBaseUnits = clip.token === 'WBNB' ? balances.wbnb : balances.usdt;
   407	
   408	    const guard = evaluateGuards({
   409	      nowMs: Date.now(),
   410	      lastFillAtMs: ctx.state.get<number | null>('lastFillAt', null),
   411	      price,
   412	      center,
   413	      inventoryNowUsd,
   414	      inventoryStartUsd,
   415	      clipBaseUnits,
   416	      balanceBaseUnits,
   417	      allowTrade: () => ctx.breakers.allowAction('trade', MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY),
   418	    });
   419	    if (!guard.ok) {
   420	      ctx.log({
   421	        event: 'trade-blocked',
   422	        reason: guard.reason,
   423	        level: hit.level.key,
   424	        price,
   425	        center,
   426	        inventoryNowUsd,
   427	      });
   428	      if (guard.halt) ctx.breakers.halt(guard.reason);
   429	      return;
   430	    }
   431	
   432	    const sellToken = hit.level.side === 'sell' ? WBNB.address : USDT.address;
   433	    const buyToken = hit.level.side === 'sell' ? USDT.address : WBNB.address;
   434	    ctx.log({
   435	      event: 'trade-intent',
   436	      side: hit.level.side,
   437	      level: hit.level.key,
   438	      crossedThisTick: hit.crossedThisTick,
   439	      sellToken,
   440	      buyToken,
   441	      sellAmount: clip.amount,
   442	      price,
   443	      center,
   444	    });
   445	
   446	    const wallet = new ChassisOphisWallet(ctx.account, ctx.publicClient, ctx.walletClient);
   447	    const result = await executeOphisSwap(
   448	      wallet,
   449	      { sellToken, buyToken, sellAmount: clip.amount, slippageBps: SLIPPAGE_BPS },
   450	      {},
   451	    );
   452	    ctx.log({
   453	      event: 'trade-submitted',
   454	      orderUid: result.orderUid,
   455	      side: hit.level.side,
   456	      level: hit.level.key,
   457	      clipToken: clip.token,
   458	      clipAmount: clip.amount,
   459	      price,
   460	      center,
   461	      minBuyAmount: result.minBuyAmount,
   462	      explorerUrl: result.explorerUrl,
   463	      enrollmentWarning: result.enrollmentWarning ?? null,
   464	    });
   465	
   466	    const fill: FillRecord = {
   467	      at: new Date().toISOString(),
   468	      side: hit.level.side,
   469	      level: hit.level.key,
   470	      clipToken: clip.token,
   471	      clipAmount: clip.amount,
   472	      price,
   473	      orderUid: result.orderUid,
   474	    };
   475	    const fills = [...ctx.state.get<FillRecord[]>('fills', []), fill].slice(-FILL_HISTORY);
   476	    ctx.state.set('fills', fills);
   477	    ctx.state.set('lastFillAt', Date.now());
   478	    ctx.state.set('crossedLevels', [...crossed, hit.level.key]);
   479	  },
   480	
   481	  async status(ctx) {
   482	    const halted = ctx.breakers.isHalted();
   483	    const center = ctx.state.get<number | null>('center', null);
   484	    const crossed = new Set(ctx.state.get<string[]>('crossedLevels', []));
   485	    const fills = ctx.state.get<FillRecord[]>('fills', []);
   486	    const inventoryStartUsd = ctx.state.get<number | null>('inventoryStartUsd', null);
   487	
   488	    let price: number | null = null;
   489	    let inventoryNowUsd: number | null = null;
   490	    let error: string | undefined;
   491	    try {
   492	      const pool = await resolveReferencePool(ctx);
   493	      price = await readMidPrice(ctx, pool);
   494	      const balances = await readBalances(ctx);
   495	      inventoryNowUsd = inventoryValueUsd(
   496	        Number(fromBaseUnits(balances.wbnb, WBNB.decimals)),
   497	        Number(fromBaseUnits(balances.usdt, USDT.decimals)),
   498	        price,
   499	      );
   500	    } catch (err) {
   501	      error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
   502	    }
   503	
   504	    return {
   505	      center,
   506	      price,
   507	      levels:
   508	        center === null
   509	          ? []
   510	          : computeLevels(center).map((l) => ({
   511	              price: l.price,
   512	              side: l.side,
   513	              crossed: crossed.has(l.key),
   514	            })),
   515	      fills: fills.slice(-10),
   516	      inventoryStartUsd,
   517	      inventoryNowUsd,
   518	      halted,
   519	      ...(error ? { error } : {}),
   520	    };
   521	  },
   522	};

    55	export const MAX_UINT256 = (BigInt(1) << BigInt(256)) - BigInt(1);
    56	
    57	/** Aave returns HF 1e18-scaled, with type(uint256).max meaning "no debt". */
    58	export function hfWadToNumber(hfWad: bigint): number {
    59	  if (hfWad === MAX_UINT256) return Infinity;
    60	  return Number(hfWad) / 1e18;
    61	}
    62	
    63	function hfNumberToWad(hf: number): bigint {
    64	  return BigInt(Math.round(hf * 1e6)) * (BigInt(10) ** BigInt(12));
    65	}
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * Base-currency amount to repay so that HF lands on targetHf.
    69	 * HF = collateral*LT/debt and collateral is untouched by a wallet repay, so
    70	 * newDebt = debt*hf/target and repay = debt - newDebt. Zero when there is no
    71	 * debt, HF is already at or above target, or HF is Infinity.
    72	 */
    73	export function planRepair(hfRay: bigint, totalDebtBase: bigint, targetHf: number): bigint {
    74	  if (totalDebtBase <= BigInt(0)) return BigInt(0);
    75	  if (hfRay === MAX_UINT256) return BigInt(0);
    76	  const targetWad = hfNumberToWad(targetHf);
    77	  if (targetWad <= BigInt(0)) return BigInt(0);
    78	  if (hfRay >= targetWad) return BigInt(0);
    79	  return totalDebtBase - (totalDebtBase * hfRay) / targetWad;
    80	}
    81	
    82	/** Convert a base-currency repay amount into token units, proportionally to the token's share of the debt. */
    83	export function scaleRepayToToken(
    84	  repayBase: bigint,
    85	  totalDebtBase: bigint,
    86	  tokenDebt: bigint,
    87	): bigint {
    88	  if (totalDebtBase <= BigInt(0) || repayBase <= BigInt(0)) return BigInt(0);
    89	  const capped = repayBase > totalDebtBase ? totalDebtBase : repayBase;
    90	  return (tokenDebt * capped) / totalDebtBase;
    91	}

    93	export interface RepayPlan {
    94	  repayBase: bigint;
    95	  repayUsdt: bigint;
    96	  cappedByBudget: boolean;
    97	}
    98	
    99	/** Full repay sizing: target math, proportional token scaling, wallet-budget cap. */
   100	export function planRepayAmounts(input: {
   101	  hfWad: bigint;
   102	  totalDebtBase: bigint;
   103	  usdtDebt: bigint;
   104	  usdtBalance: bigint;
   105	  targetHf: number;
   106	}): RepayPlan {
   107	  const repayBase = planRepair(input.hfWad, input.totalDebtBase, input.targetHf);
   108	  const wanted = scaleRepayToToken(repayBase, input.totalDebtBase, input.usdtDebt);
   109	  const cappedByBudget = wanted > input.usdtBalance;
   110	  const repayUsdt = cappedByBudget ? input.usdtBalance : wanted;
   111	  return { repayBase, repayUsdt, cappedByBudget };
   112	}
   113	
   114	export type HfZone = 'healthy' | 'warn' | 'act';
   115	
   116	const ZONE_SEVERITY: Record<HfZone, number> = { healthy: 0, warn: 1, act: 2 };
   117	
   118	export function classifyHf(hf: number, warnAt: number, actAt: number): HfZone {
   119	  if (hf < actAt) return 'act';
   120	  if (hf < warnAt) return 'warn';
   121	  return 'healthy';
   122	}
   123	
   124	export interface ThresholdDecision {
   125	  zone: HfZone;
   126	  /** Emit the warn log only on a downward crossing into the warn zone. */
   127	  emitWarn: boolean;
   128	  shouldRepair: boolean;
   129	}
   130	
   131	export function evaluateThresholds(
   132	  prevZone: HfZone,
   133	  hf: number,
   134	  warnAt: number,
   135	  actAt: number,
   136	): ThresholdDecision {
   137	  const zone = classifyHf(hf, warnAt, actAt);
   138	  const emitWarn =
   139	    zone === 'warn' && ZONE_SEVERITY[prevZone] < ZONE_SEVERITY[zone];
   140	  return { zone, emitWarn, shouldRepair: zone === 'act' };
   141	}
   142	
   143	function serializeHf(hf: number): number | string {
   144	  return Number.isFinite(hf) ? hf : 'Infinity';
   145	}

   157	async function readAccountData(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<AccountData> {
   158	  const [totalCollateralBase, totalDebtBase, , , , healthFactor] =
   159	    await ctx.publicClient.readContract({

   168	async function readErc20Balance(
   169	  ctx: AgentContext,
   170	  token: `0x${string}`,
   171	): Promise<bigint> {
   172	  return ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   173	    address: token,
   174	    abi: erc20Abi,
   175	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   176	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   177	  });
   178	}

   180	async function confirmTx(
   181	  ctx: AgentContext,
   182	  label: string,
   183	  hash: `0x${string}`,
   184	): Promise<`0x${string}`> {
   185	  ctx.log({ event: label, txHash: hash });
   186	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   187	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') {
   188	    throw new Error(`${label} reverted: ${hash}`);
   189	  }
   190	  return hash;
   191	}
   192	
   193	async function ensureAllowance(
   194	  ctx: AgentContext,
   195	  token: `0x${string}`,
   196	  amount: bigint,
   197	): Promise<void> {
   198	  const current = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   199	    address: token,
   200	    abi: erc20Abi,
   201	    functionName: 'allowance',
   202	    args: [ctx.account.address, AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL],
   203	  });
   204	  if (current >= amount) return;
   205	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   206	    address: token,
   207	    abi: erc20Abi,
   208	    functionName: 'approve',
   209	    args: [AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL, amount],
   210	    account: ctx.account,
   211	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   212	  });
   213	  ctx.log({ event: 'approve', token, spender: AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL, amount: String(amount), txHash: hash });
   214	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   215	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`approve reverted: ${hash}`);
   216	}

   218	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   219	// Setup: supply 0.004 WBNB, borrow 0.8 USDT variable
   220	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   221	
   222	async function runSetup(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<boolean> {
   223	  const acct = await readAccountData(ctx);
   224	  const needSupply = acct.totalCollateralBase === BigInt(0);
   225	  const needBorrow = acct.totalDebtBase === BigInt(0);
   226	  if (!needSupply && !needBorrow) {
   227	    ctx.state.set('setupDone', true);
   228	    ctx.log({ event: 'setup-complete', note: 'existing position adopted' });
   229	    return true;
   230	  }
   231	
   232	  const supplyWei = toBaseUnits(SUPPLY_WBNB, WBNB.decimals);
   233	  if (needSupply) {
   234	    const wbnbBalance = await readErc20Balance(ctx, WBNB.address);
   235	    if (wbnbBalance < supplyWei) {
   236	      ctx.log({
   237	        event: 'setup-skip',
   238	        reason: 'insufficient-wbnb',
   239	        needed: SUPPLY_WBNB,
   240	        balance: fromBaseUnits(wbnbBalance, WBNB.decimals),
   241	      });
   242	      return false;
   243	    }
   244	  }
   245	
   246	  // allowAction records on allow, so it runs only after the balance gate.
   247	  if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('setup', 1)) {
   248	    ctx.log({ event: 'setup-skip', reason: 'action-cap' });
   249	    return false;
   250	  }
   251	
   252	  if (needSupply) {
   253	    await ensureAllowance(ctx, WBNB.address, supplyWei);
   254	    const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   255	      address: AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL,
   256	      abi: POOL_ABI,
   257	      functionName: 'supply',
   258	      args: [WBNB.address, supplyWei, ctx.account.address, 0],
   259	      account: ctx.account,
   260	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   261	    });
   262	    await confirmTx(ctx, 'supply', hash);
   263	  }
   264	  if (needBorrow) {
   265	    const borrowWei = toBaseUnits(BORROW_USDT, USDT.decimals);
   266	    const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   267	      address: AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL,
   268	      abi: POOL_ABI,
   269	      functionName: 'borrow',
   270	      args: [USDT.address, borrowWei, VARIABLE_RATE_MODE, 0, ctx.account.address],
   271	      account: ctx.account,
   272	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   273	    });
   274	    await confirmTx(ctx, 'borrow', hash);
   275	  }
   276	  ctx.state.set('setupDone', true);
   277	  ctx.log({ event: 'setup-complete', suppliedWbnb: SUPPLY_WBNB, borrowedUsdt: BORROW_USDT });
   278	  return true;
   279	}
   280	
   281	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   282	// Repair: repay USDT to lift HF back to TARGET_HF
   283	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   284	
   285	async function runRepair(ctx: AgentContext, acct: AccountData): Promise<void> {
   286	  const reserve = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   287	    address: AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL,
   288	    abi: POOL_ABI,
   289	    functionName: 'getReserveData',
   290	    args: [USDT.address],
   291	  });
   292	  const [usdtDebt, usdtBalance] = await Promise.all([
   293	    readErc20Balance(ctx, reserve.variableDebtTokenAddress),
   294	    readErc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   295	  ]);
   296	
   297	  const plan = planRepayAmounts({
   298	    hfWad: acct.healthFactor,
   299	    totalDebtBase: acct.totalDebtBase,
   300	    usdtDebt,
   301	    usdtBalance,
   302	    targetHf: TARGET_HF,
   303	  });
   304	  ctx.log({
   305	    event: 'repair-plan',
   306	    repayBase: String(plan.repayBase),
   307	    repayUsdt: fromBaseUnits(plan.repayUsdt, USDT.decimals),
   308	    usdtDebt: fromBaseUnits(usdtDebt, USDT.decimals),
   309	    usdtBalance: fromBaseUnits(usdtBalance, USDT.decimals),
   310	    cappedByBudget: plan.cappedByBudget,
   311	  });
   312	
   313	  if (usdtBalance === BigInt(0)) {
   314	    ctx.log({ event: 'budget-exhausted', level: 'warn', note: 'no USDT to repay with; monitoring continues' });
   315	    return;
   316	  }
   317	  if (plan.repayUsdt <= BigInt(0)) {
   318	    ctx.log({ event: 'repair-skip', reason: 'zero-repay-amount' });
   319	    return;
   320	  }
   321	  if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('repay', MAX_REPAYS_PER_DAY)) {
   322	    ctx.log({ event: 'repair-skip', reason: 'action-cap', maxPerDay: MAX_REPAYS_PER_DAY });
   323	    return;
   324	  }
   325	
   326	  await ensureAllowance(ctx, USDT.address, plan.repayUsdt);
   327	  const sent = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   328	    address: AAVE_V3_BSC_POOL,
   329	    abi: POOL_ABI,
   330	    functionName: 'repay',
   331	    args: [USDT.address, plan.repayUsdt, VARIABLE_RATE_MODE, ctx.account.address],
   332	    account: ctx.account,
   333	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   334	  });
   335	  const hash = await confirmTx(ctx, 'repay', sent);
   336	
   337	  const now = Date.now();
   338	  const repayTimes = ctx.state
   339	    .get<number[]>('repayTimes', [])
   340	    .filter((t) => t > now - DAY_MS);
   341	  ctx.state.set('repayTimes', [...repayTimes, now]);
   342	  ctx.log({
   343	    event: 'repair-done',
   344	    txHash: hash,
   345	    repaidUsdt: fromBaseUnits(plan.repayUsdt, USDT.decimals),
   346	  });
   347	}

   349	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   350	// Module
   351	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   352	
   353	export const healthFactorAgent: AgentModule = {
   354	  name: 'health-factor',
   355	  category: 'health-factor',
   356	  tickIntervalMs: 60_000,
   357	
   358	  async tick(ctx) {
   359	    if (ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted) return;
   360	
   361	    if (!ctx.state.get('setupDone', false)) {
   362	      const ready = await runSetup(ctx);
   363	      if (!ready) return;
   364	    }
   365	
   366	    const acct = await readAccountData(ctx);
   367	    const hf = hfWadToNumber(acct.healthFactor);
   368	    const prevZone = ctx.state.get<HfZone>('hfZone', 'healthy');
   369	    const decision = evaluateThresholds(prevZone, hf, WARN_AT, ACT_AT);
   370	
   371	    ctx.log({
   372	      event: 'hf',
   373	      hf: serializeHf(hf),
   374	      zone: decision.zone,
   375	      collateralBase: String(acct.totalCollateralBase),
   376	      debtBase: String(acct.totalDebtBase),
   377	    });
   378	    if (decision.zone !== prevZone) ctx.state.set('hfZone', decision.zone);
   379	    if (decision.emitWarn) {
   380	      ctx.log({ event: 'hf-warn', level: 'warn', hf: serializeHf(hf), warnAt: WARN_AT });
   381	    }
   382	    if (decision.shouldRepair) await runRepair(ctx, acct);
   383	  },
   384	
   385	  async status(ctx) {
   386	    const [acct, usdtBalance] = await Promise.all([
   387	      readAccountData(ctx),
   388	      readErc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   389	    ]);
   390	    const hf = hfWadToNumber(acct.healthFactor);
   391	    const dayAgo = Date.now() - DAY_MS;
   392	    const actionsToday = ctx.state
   393	      .get<number[]>('repayTimes', [])
   394	      .filter((t) => t > dayAgo).length;
   395	    return {
   396	      healthFactor: serializeHf(hf),
   397	      warnAt: WARN_AT,
   398	      actAt: ACT_AT,
   399	      targetAfterRepair: TARGET_HF,
   400	      collateralBase: String(acct.totalCollateralBase),
   401	      debtBase: String(acct.totalDebtBase),
   402	      repayBudgetUsdt: fromBaseUnits(usdtBalance, USDT.decimals),
   403	      actionsToday,
   404	      halted: ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted,
   405	    };
   406	  },
   407	};

    64	export const HYSTERESIS_BPS = 50;
    65	export const REQUIRED_STREAK = 2;
    66	
    67	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    68	// Pure decision logic (unit-tested, no network)
    69	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    70	
    71	/**
    72	 * BSC block cadence changed with the Lorentz/Maxwell upgrades (measured
    73	 * ~0.45s on 2026-08-18, not the historical 3s), so blocks-per-year is
    74	 * extrapolated from two observed block timestamps instead of assumed.
    75	 */
    76	export function deriveBlocksPerYear(
    77	  latestTimestamp: bigint,
    78	  olderTimestamp: bigint,
    79	  blockSpan: number,
    80	): number {
    81	  const elapsed = Number(latestTimestamp - olderTimestamp);
    82	  if (elapsed <= 0 || blockSpan <= 0) {
    83	    throw new Error(`cannot derive block cadence: elapsed=${elapsed}s span=${blockSpan}`);
    84	  }
    85	  return Math.round((YEAR_SECONDS * blockSpan) / elapsed);
    86	}
    87	
    88	/** Venus quotes a WAD-scaled per-block rate; simple APR (rate * blocks) in bps. */
    89	export function venusApyBps(supplyRatePerBlock: bigint, blocksPerYear: number): number {
    90	  return (Number(supplyRatePerBlock) / Number(WAD)) * blocksPerYear * 10_000;
    91	}
    92	
    93	/**
    94	 * Aave v3 currentLiquidityRate is the annualized APR in RAY (per-second
    95	 * compounding semantics). At ~2% the APY/APR gap is ~2 bps, far inside the
    96	 * 50 bps hysteresis, so APR is used as APY.
    97	 */
    98	export function aaveApyBps(currentLiquidityRate: bigint): number {
    99	  return (Number(currentLiquidityRate) / Number(RAY)) * 10_000;
   100	}

   102	export function chooseFirstVenue(venusBps: number, aaveBps: number): 'venus' | 'aave' {
   103	  return aaveBps > venusBps ? 'aave' : 'venus';
   104	}

   106	/** Venue as the chain sees it; a position in both venues resolves to the larger. */
   107	export function detectVenue(venusUnderlyingWei: bigint, aaveATokenWei: bigint, dustWei: bigint): Venue {
   108	  const inVenus = venusUnderlyingWei > dustWei;
   109	  const inAave = aaveATokenWei > dustWei;
   110	  if (inVenus && inAave) return venusUnderlyingWei >= aaveATokenWei ? 'venus' : 'aave';
   111	  if (inVenus) return 'venus';
   112	  if (inAave) return 'aave';
   113	  return 'none';
   114	}

   116	export interface RotationInput {
   117	  venue: 'venus' | 'aave';
   118	  venusBps: number;
   119	  aaveBps: number;
   120	  betterStreak: number;
   121	  hysteresisBps?: number;
   122	  requiredStreak?: number;
   123	}
   124	
   125	export interface RotationDecision {
   126	  action: 'hold' | 'rotate';
   127	  target: 'venus' | 'aave';
   128	  edgeBps: number;
   129	  nextStreak: number;
   130	}
   131	
   132	/**
   133	 * Rotate only when the other venue beats the current by more than the
   134	 * hysteresis on this check AND on the previous one (streak of 2); the streak
   135	 * resets the moment the edge falls back inside the hysteresis band.
   136	 */
   137	export function decideRotation(input: RotationInput): RotationDecision {
   138	  const hysteresis = input.hysteresisBps ?? HYSTERESIS_BPS;
   139	  const required = input.requiredStreak ?? REQUIRED_STREAK;
   140	  const other: 'venus' | 'aave' = input.venue === 'venus' ? 'aave' : 'venus';
   141	  const currentBps = input.venue === 'venus' ? input.venusBps : input.aaveBps;
   142	  const otherBps = other === 'venus' ? input.venusBps : input.aaveBps;
   143	  const edgeBps = otherBps - currentBps;
   144	
   145	  if (edgeBps > hysteresis) {
   146	    const nextStreak = input.betterStreak + 1;
   147	    if (nextStreak >= required) {
   148	      return { action: 'rotate', target: other, edgeBps, nextStreak: 0 };
   149	    }
   150	    return { action: 'hold', target: input.venue, edgeBps, nextStreak };
   151	  }
   152	  return { action: 'hold', target: input.venue, edgeBps, nextStreak: 0 };
   153	}

   226	  ]);
   227	  const aaveATokenWei = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   228	    address: reserve.aTokenAddress,
   229	    abi: erc20Abi,
   230	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   231	    args: [self],
   232	  });
   233	  return {
   234	    walletUsdtWei,
   235	    venusUnderlyingWei,
   236	    aaveATokenWei,
   237	    chainVenue: detectVenue(venusUnderlyingWei, aaveATokenWei, DUST_WEI),
   238	  };
   239	}
   240	
   241	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   242	// Chain writes
   243	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   244	
   245	async function ensureAllowance(
   246	  ctx: AgentContext,
   247	  spender: `0x${string}`,
   248	  amountWei: bigint,
   249	): Promise<void> {
   250	  const current = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   251	    address: USDT.address,
   252	    abi: erc20Abi,
   253	    functionName: 'allowance',
   254	    args: [ctx.account.address, spender],
   255	  });
   256	  if (current >= amountWei) return;
   257	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   258	    address: USDT.address,
   259	    abi: erc20Abi,
   260	    functionName: 'approve',
   261	    args: [spender, amountWei],
   262	    account: ctx.account,
   263	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   264	  });
   265	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   266	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`approve reverted: ${hash}`);
   267	  ctx.log({ event: 'approve', spender, amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals), txHash: hash });
   268	}
   269	
   270	async function supplyVenus(ctx: AgentContext, amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   271	  await ensureAllowance(ctx, VENUS_VUSDT, amountWei);
   272	  const { result, request } = await ctx.publicClient.simulateContract({
   273	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   274	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   275	    functionName: 'mint',
   276	    args: [amountWei],
   277	    account: ctx.account,
   278	  });
   279	  if (result !== BigInt(0)) throw new Error(`venus mint would fail with code ${result}`);
   280	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({ ...request, chain: ctx.walletClient.chain });
   281	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   282	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`venus mint reverted: ${hash}`);
   283	  ctx.log({
   284	    event: 'supply',
   285	    venue: 'venus',
   286	    amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals),
   287	    txHash: hash,
   288	  });
   289	}
   290	
   291	async function withdrawVenus(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<void> {
   292	  // Redeeming the full vToken balance (not redeemUnderlying) exits exactly,
   293	  // leaving no interest-accrual dust behind.
   294	  const vTokenBalance = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   295	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   296	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   297	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   298	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   299	  });
   300	  if (vTokenBalance === BigInt(0)) {
   301	    ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw-skip', venue: 'venus', reason: 'no vToken balance' });
   302	    return;
   303	  }
   304	  const { result, request } = await ctx.publicClient.simulateContract({
   305	    address: VENUS_VUSDT,
   306	    abi: vTokenAbi,
   307	    functionName: 'redeem',
   308	    args: [vTokenBalance],
   309	    account: ctx.account,
   310	  });
   311	  if (result !== BigInt(0)) throw new Error(`venus redeem would fail with code ${result}`);
   312	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({ ...request, chain: ctx.walletClient.chain });
   313	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   314	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`venus redeem reverted: ${hash}`);
   315	  ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw', venue: 'venus', vTokens: vTokenBalance.toString(), txHash: hash });
   316	}
   317	
   318	async function supplyAave(ctx: AgentContext, amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   319	  await ensureAllowance(ctx, AAVE_POOL, amountWei);
   320	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   321	    address: AAVE_POOL,
   322	    abi: aavePoolAbi,
   323	    functionName: 'supply',
   324	    args: [USDT.address, amountWei, ctx.account.address, 0],
   325	    account: ctx.account,
   326	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   327	  });
   328	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   329	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`aave supply reverted: ${hash}`);
   330	  ctx.log({
   331	    event: 'supply',
   332	    venue: 'aave',
   333	    amount: fromBaseUnits(amountWei, USDT.decimals),
   334	    txHash: hash,
   335	  });
   336	}
   337	
   338	async function withdrawAave(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<void> {
   339	  // maxUint256 tells the pool to withdraw the full aToken balance including
   340	  // interest accrued in the same block.
   341	  const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   342	    address: AAVE_POOL,
   343	    abi: aavePoolAbi,
   344	    functionName: 'withdraw',
   345	    args: [USDT.address, maxUint256, ctx.account.address],
   346	    account: ctx.account,
   347	    chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   348	  });
   349	  const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   350	  if (receipt.status !== 'success') throw new Error(`aave withdraw reverted: ${hash}`);
   351	  ctx.log({ event: 'withdraw', venue: 'aave', txHash: hash });
   352	}
   353	
   354	async function supplyTo(ctx: AgentContext, venue: 'venus' | 'aave', amountWei: bigint): Promise<void> {
   355	  if (venue === 'venus') await supplyVenus(ctx, amountWei);
   356	  else await supplyAave(ctx, amountWei);
   357	}
   358	
   359	function recordMove(ctx: AgentContext): void {
   360	  const now = Date.now();
   361	  const dayAgo = now - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
   362	  const moves = ctx.state.get<number[]>('moves', []).filter((t) => t > dayAgo);
   363	  ctx.state.set('moves', [...moves, now]);
   364	}
   365	
   366	function movesToday(ctx: AgentContext): number {
   367	  const dayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
   368	  return ctx.state.get<number[]>('moves', []).filter((t) => t > dayAgo).length;
   369	}

   371	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   372	// Agent module
   373	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   374	
   375	export const yieldAgent: AgentModule = {
   376	  name: 'yield',
   377	  category: 'yield',
   378	  tickIntervalMs: 21_600_000,
   379	
   380	  async tick(ctx) {
   381	    const halted = ctx.breakers.isHalted();
   382	    if (halted.halted) {
   383	      ctx.log({ event: 'tick-skip', reason: `halted: ${halted.reason}` });
   384	      return;
   385	    }
   386	
   387	    const rates = await readRates(ctx);
   388	    const position = await readPosition(ctx);
   389	
   390	    const storedVenue = ctx.state.get<Venue>('venue', 'none');
   391	    const venue = position.chainVenue;
   392	    if (venue !== storedVenue) {
   393	      ctx.log({ event: 'venue-reconciled', stored: storedVenue, chain: venue });
   394	      ctx.state.set('venue', venue);
   395	    }
   396	
   397	    const base = {
   398	      venue,
   399	      venusApyBps: rates.venusBps,
   400	      aaveApyBps: rates.aaveBps,
   401	      blocksPerYear: rates.blocksPerYear,
   402	      venusRatePerBlock: rates.venusRatePerBlock,
   403	      aaveLiquidityRate: rates.aaveLiquidityRate,
   404	      walletUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.walletUsdtWei, USDT.decimals),
   405	      venusUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.venusUnderlyingWei, USDT.decimals),
   406	      aaveUsdt: fromBaseUnits(position.aaveATokenWei, USDT.decimals),
   407	    };
   408	
   409	    if (venue === 'none') {
   410	      const deployableWei = position.walletUsdtWei - RESERVE_WEI;
   411	      if (deployableWei <= DUST_WEI) {
   412	        ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'unfunded', deployable: fromBaseUnits(
   413	          deployableWei > BigInt(0) ? deployableWei : BigInt(0),
   414	          USDT.decimals,
   415	        ) });
   416	        return;
   417	      }
   418	      const target = chooseFirstVenue(rates.venusBps, rates.aaveBps);
   419	      if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('enter', 2)) {
   420	        ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'enter-capped', target });
   421	        return;
   422	      }
   423	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'enter', target, amount: fromBaseUnits(deployableWei, USDT.decimals) });
   424	      await supplyTo(ctx, target, deployableWei);
   425	      ctx.state.set('venue', target);
   426	      ctx.state.set('betterStreak', 0);
   427	      recordMove(ctx);
   428	      return;
   429	    }
   430	
   431	    const decision = decideRotation({
   432	      venue,
   433	      venusBps: rates.venusBps,
   434	      aaveBps: rates.aaveBps,
   435	      betterStreak: ctx.state.get<number>('betterStreak', 0),
   436	    });
   437	    ctx.state.set('betterStreak', decision.nextStreak);
   438	
   439	    if (decision.action === 'hold') {
   440	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'hold', edgeBps: decision.edgeBps, betterStreak: decision.nextStreak });
   441	      return;
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('rotate', 1)) {
   445	      ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'rotate-capped', target: decision.target, edgeBps: decision.edgeBps });
   446	      return;
   447	    }
   448	
   449	    ctx.log({ ...base, event: 'tick', decision: 'rotate', from: venue, to: decision.target, edgeBps: decision.edgeBps });
   450	    if (venue === 'venus') await withdrawVenus(ctx);
   451	    else await withdrawAave(ctx);
   452	    ctx.state.set('venue', 'none');
   453	
   454	    const walletAfterWei = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   455	      address: USDT.address,
   456	      abi: erc20Abi,
   457	      functionName: 'balanceOf',
   458	      args: [ctx.account.address],
   459	    });
   460	    const deployableWei = walletAfterWei - RESERVE_WEI;
   461	    if (deployableWei <= DUST_WEI) {
   462	      ctx.log({ event: 'rotate-abort', reason: 'nothing to redeploy after withdraw', wallet: fromBaseUnits(walletAfterWei, USDT.decimals) });
   463	      return;
   464	    }
   465	    await supplyTo(ctx, decision.target, deployableWei);
   466	    ctx.state.set('venue', decision.target);
   467	    recordMove(ctx);
   468	  },
   469	
   470	  async status(ctx) {
   471	    const [rates, position] = await Promise.all([readRates(ctx), readPosition(ctx)]);
   472	    const venue = position.chainVenue;
   473	    const positionWei =
   474	      venue === 'venus' ? position.venusUnderlyingWei
   475	      : venue === 'aave' ? position.aaveATokenWei
   476	      : BigInt(0);
   477	    const edgeBps =
   478	      venue === 'venus' ? rates.aaveBps - rates.venusBps
   479	      : venue === 'aave' ? rates.venusBps - rates.aaveBps
   480	      : Math.abs(rates.aaveBps - rates.venusBps);
   481	    return {
   482	      venue,
   483	      positionUsdt: fromBaseUnits(positionWei, USDT.decimals),
   484	      venusApyBps: rates.venusBps,
   485	      aaveApyBps: rates.aaveBps,
   486	      edgeBps,
   487	      betterStreak: ctx.state.get<number>('betterStreak', 0),
   488	      movesToday: movesToday(ctx),
   489	      halted: ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted,
   490	    };
   491	  },
   492	};

    27	/** Lower bound snaps down, upper snaps up, so the current tick stays strictly inside. */
    28	export function snapRange(
    29	  currentTick: number,
    30	  tickDelta: number,
    31	  tickSpacing: number,
    32	): { tickLower: number; tickUpper: number } {
    33	  const tickLower = Math.floor((currentTick - tickDelta) / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
    34	  const tickUpper = Math.ceil((currentTick + tickDelta) / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
    35	  return { tickLower, tickUpper };

    61	export interface RebalanceLeg {
    62	  sell: 'WBNB' | 'USDT';
    63	  amountUnits: number;
    64	  notionalUsd: number;
    65	}
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * One swap that moves inventory to ~50/50 by value: sell half the value gap
    69	 * from the heavy side. Returns null when the gap leg is <= minNotionalUsd.
    70	 */
    71	export function computeRebalanceLeg(
    72	  wbnbUnits: number,
    73	  usdtUnits: number,
    74	  usdtPerWbnb: number,
    75	  minNotionalUsd: number = MIN_SWAP_NOTIONAL_USD,
    76	): RebalanceLeg | null {
    77	  const excessUsd = (wbnbUnits * usdtPerWbnb - usdtUnits) / 2;
    78	  if (!Number.isFinite(excessUsd) || Math.abs(excessUsd) <= minNotionalUsd) return null;
    79	  if (excessUsd > 0) {
    80	    return { sell: 'WBNB', amountUnits: excessUsd / usdtPerWbnb, notionalUsd: excessUsd };
    81	  }
    82	  return { sell: 'USDT', amountUnits: -excessUsd, notionalUsd: -excessUsd };
    83	}

   222	async function resolvePool(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<PoolInfo> {
   223	  const cached = ctx.state.get<PoolInfo | null>('poolInfo', null);
   224	  if (cached && cached.pool) return cached;
   225	
   226	  const factory = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   227	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   228	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   229	    functionName: 'factory',
   230	  });
   231	  if (factory.toLowerCase() !== EXPECTED_FACTORY.toLowerCase()) {
   232	    /* Minting through a manager wired to an unknown factory risks the funds. */
   233	    ctx.breakers.halt(`position manager factory mismatch: ${factory}`);
   234	    throw new Error(`position manager factory mismatch: ${factory}`);
   235	  }
   236	
   237	  for (const fee of POOL_FEE_TIERS) {
   238	    const pool = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   239	      address: factory,
   240	      abi: FACTORY_ABI,
   241	      functionName: 'getPool',
   242	      args: [WBNB.address, USDT.address, fee],
   243	    });
   244	    if (pool === zeroAddress) {
   245	      ctx.log({ event: 'pool-probe', fee, result: 'no-pool' });
   246	      continue;
   247	    }
   248	    const liquidity = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   249	      address: pool,
   250	      abi: POOL_ABI,
   251	      functionName: 'liquidity',
   252	    });
   253	    if (liquidity <= BigInt(0)) {
   254	      ctx.log({ event: 'pool-probe', fee, pool, result: 'zero-liquidity' });
   255	      continue;
   256	    }
   257	    const [tickSpacing, token0] = await Promise.all([
   258	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address: pool, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'tickSpacing' }),
   259	      ctx.publicClient.readContract({ address: pool, abi: POOL_ABI, functionName: 'token0' }),
   260	    ]);
   261	    const info: PoolInfo = {
   262	      pool,
   263	      fee,
   264	      tickSpacing,
   265	      wbnbIsToken0: token0.toLowerCase() === WBNB.address.toLowerCase(),
   266	    };
   267	    ctx.state.set('poolInfo', info);
   268	    ctx.log({ event: 'pool-selected', ...info, liquidity: liquidity.toString() });
   269	    return info;
   270	  }
   271	  throw new Error('no WBNB/USDT PancakeSwap V3 pool with liquidity found');
   272	}
   273	
   274	type PendingStatus = 'none' | 'pending' | 'filled' | 'expired';
   275	
   276	async function checkPendingOrder(ctx: AgentContext): Promise<PendingStatus> {
   277	  const po = ctx.state.get<PendingOrder | null>('pendingOrder', null);
   278	  if (!po) return 'none';
   279	  const token = po.sellSymbol === 'WBNB' ? WBNB : USDT;
   280	  const balance = await erc20Balance(ctx, token.address);
   281	  const pre = BigInt(po.preSellBalanceWei);
   282	  const amount = BigInt(po.sellAmountWei);
   283	  /* Filled when >= 90% of the sell amount left the wallet (fee dust tolerance). */
   284	  const filledThreshold = pre - (amount * BigInt(9)) / BigInt(10);
   285	  if (balance <= filledThreshold) {
   286	    ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', null);
   287	    ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-order-filled', orderUid: po.orderUid });
   288	    return 'filled';
   289	  }
   290	  if (Date.now() - po.placedAt > PENDING_ORDER_MAX_AGE_MS) {
   291	    ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', null);
   292	    ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-order-stale-cleared', orderUid: po.orderUid });
   293	    return 'expired';
   294	  }
   295	  return 'pending';
   296	}
   297	
   298	async function findMintedTokenId(ctx: AgentContext, logs: Log[]): Promise<bigint> {
   299	  const events = parseEventLogs({ abi: NPM_ABI, logs, eventName: 'IncreaseLiquidity' }).filter(
   300	    (l) => l.address.toLowerCase() === POSITION_MANAGER.toLowerCase(),
   301	  );
   302	  const first = events[0];
   303	  if (first) return first.args.tokenId;
   304	  ctx.log({ event: 'mint-event-parse-miss', fallback: 'tokenOfOwnerByIndex' });
   305	  const balance = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   306	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   307	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   308	    functionName: 'balanceOf',
   309	    args: [ctx.account.address],
   310	  });
   311	  if (balance <= BigInt(0)) throw new Error('mint receipt has no IncreaseLiquidity and owner holds no NPM tokens');
   312	  return ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   313	    address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   314	    abi: NPM_ABI,
   315	    functionName: 'tokenOfOwnerByIndex',
   316	    args: [ctx.account.address, balance - BigInt(1)],
   317	  });
   318	}
   319	
   320	async function tryMint(ctx: AgentContext, info: PoolInfo): Promise<void> {
   321	  const pending = await checkPendingOrder(ctx);
   322	  if (pending === 'pending') {
   323	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-deferred', reason: 'ophis-order-pending' });
   324	    return;
   325	  }
   326	
   327	  const [wbnbBal, usdtBal, slot0] = await Promise.all([
   328	    erc20Balance(ctx, WBNB.address),
   329	    erc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   330	    readSlot0(ctx, info.pool),
   331	  ]);
   332	  const availWbnb = wbnbBal > WBNB_DUST_RESERVE ? wbnbBal - WBNB_DUST_RESERVE : BigInt(0);
   333	  const availUsdt = usdtBal > USDT_DUST_RESERVE ? usdtBal - USDT_DUST_RESERVE : BigInt(0);
   334	  const price = sqrtPriceX96ToUsdtPerWbnb(slot0.sqrtPriceX96, info.wbnbIsToken0);
   335	  const wbnbUnits = Number(fromBaseUnits(availWbnb, WBNB.decimals));
   336	  const usdtUnits = Number(fromBaseUnits(availUsdt, USDT.decimals));
   337	
   338	  if (wbnbUnits * price < MIN_MINT_LEG_USD || usdtUnits < MIN_MINT_LEG_USD) {
   339	    ctx.log({
   340	      event: 'mint-skipped',
   341	      reason: 'insufficient-leg',
   342	      wbnbUnits,
   343	      usdtUnits,
   344	      usdtPerWbnb: price,
   345	    });
   346	    return;
   347	  }
   348	  if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('mint', 3)) {
   349	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-skipped', reason: 'daily-mint-cap' });
   350	    return;
   351	  }
   352	
   353	  const { tickLower, tickUpper } = snapRange(slot0.tick, pctToTickDelta(RANGE_PCT), info.tickSpacing);
   354	  const wallet = new ChassisOphisWallet(ctx.account, ctx.publicClient, ctx.walletClient);
   355	  try {
   356	    await wallet.ensureErc20Allowance(USDT.address, POSITION_MANAGER, availUsdt);
   357	    await wallet.ensureErc20Allowance(WBNB.address, POSITION_MANAGER, availWbnb);
   358	
   359	    const amount0Desired = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? availWbnb : availUsdt;
   360	    const amount1Desired = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? availUsdt : availWbnb;
   361	    const token0 = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? WBNB.address : USDT.address;
   362	    const token1 = info.wbnbIsToken0 ? USDT.address : WBNB.address;
   363	
   364	    const hash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   365	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   366	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   367	      functionName: 'mint',
   368	      args: [
   369	        {
   370	          token0,
   371	          token1,
   372	          fee: info.fee,
   373	          tickLower,
   374	          tickUpper,
   375	          amount0Desired,
   376	          amount1Desired,
   377	          amount0Min: BigInt(0),
   378	          amount1Min: BigInt(0),
   379	          recipient: ctx.account.address,
   380	          deadline: txDeadline(),
   381	        },
   382	      ],
   383	      account: ctx.account,
   384	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   385	    });
   386	    const receipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash });
   387	    if (receipt.status !== 'success') {
   388	      ctx.log({ event: 'mint-reverted', txHash: hash });
   389	      return;
   390	    }
   391	    const tokenId = await findMintedTokenId(ctx, receipt.logs);
   392	    const position: PositionState = {
   393	      tokenId: tokenId.toString(),
   394	      tickLower,
   395	      tickUpper,
   396	      outSince: null,
   397	    };
   398	    ctx.state.set('position', position);
   399	    ctx.log({
   400	      event: 'minted',
   401	      txHash: hash,
   402	      tokenId: position.tokenId,
   403	      tickLower,
   404	      tickUpper,
   405	      currentTick: slot0.tick,
   406	      wbnbUnits,
   407	      usdtUnits,
   408	    });
   409	  } catch (err) {
   410	    ctx.log({ event: 'mint-failed', error: String(err) });
   411	  }
   412	}
   413	
   414	async function exitPosition(ctx: AgentContext, pos: PositionState): Promise<boolean> {
   415	  const tokenId = BigInt(pos.tokenId);
   416	  try {
   417	    const position = await ctx.publicClient.readContract({
   418	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   419	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   420	      functionName: 'positions',
   421	      args: [tokenId],
   422	    });
   423	    const liquidity = position[7];
   424	    if (liquidity > BigInt(0)) {
   425	      const decreaseHash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   426	        address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   427	        abi: NPM_ABI,
   428	        functionName: 'decreaseLiquidity',
   429	        args: [
   430	          {
   430	          {
   431	            tokenId,
   432	            liquidity,
   433	            amount0Min: BigInt(0),
   434	            amount1Min: BigInt(0),
   435	            deadline: txDeadline(),
   436	          },
   437	        ],
   438	        account: ctx.account,
   439	        chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   440	      });
   441	      const decreaseReceipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: decreaseHash });
   442	      if (decreaseReceipt.status !== 'success') {
   443	        ctx.log({ event: 'decrease-liquidity-reverted', txHash: decreaseHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   444	        return false;
   445	      }
   446	      ctx.log({ event: 'decrease-liquidity', txHash: decreaseHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   447	    }
   448	    const collectHash = await ctx.walletClient.writeContract({
   449	      address: POSITION_MANAGER,
   450	      abi: NPM_ABI,
   451	      functionName: 'collect',
   452	      args: [
   453	        {
   454	          tokenId,
   455	          recipient: ctx.account.address,
   456	          amount0Max: MAX_UINT128,
   457	          amount1Max: MAX_UINT128,
   458	        },
   459	      ],
   460	      account: ctx.account,
   461	      chain: ctx.walletClient.chain,
   462	    });
   463	    const collectReceipt = await ctx.publicClient.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: collectHash });
   464	    if (collectReceipt.status !== 'success') {
   465	      ctx.log({ event: 'collect-reverted', txHash: collectHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   466	      return false;
   467	    }
   468	    ctx.log({ event: 'collected', txHash: collectHash, tokenId: pos.tokenId });
   469	    return true;
   470	  } catch (err) {
   471	    ctx.log({ event: 'exit-failed', tokenId: pos.tokenId, error: String(err) });
   472	    return false;
   473	  }
   474	}

   476	async function rebalanceInventory(ctx: AgentContext, info: PoolInfo): Promise<void> {
   477	  const [wbnbBal, usdtBal, slot0] = await Promise.all([
   478	    erc20Balance(ctx, WBNB.address),
   479	    erc20Balance(ctx, USDT.address),
   480	    readSlot0(ctx, info.pool),
   481	  ]);
   482	  const price = sqrtPriceX96ToUsdtPerWbnb(slot0.sqrtPriceX96, info.wbnbIsToken0);
   483	  const leg = computeRebalanceLeg(
   484	    Number(fromBaseUnits(wbnbBal, WBNB.decimals)),
   485	    Number(fromBaseUnits(usdtBal, USDT.decimals)),
   486	    price,
   487	  );
   488	  if (!leg) {
   489	    ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-swap-skipped', reason: 'imbalance-under-min-notional' });
   490	    return;
   491	  }
   492	  const sellToken = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? WBNB : USDT;
   493	  const buyToken = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? USDT : WBNB;
   494	  const sellAmount = formatWholeUnits(leg.amountUnits);
   495	  const preSellBalance = leg.sell === 'WBNB' ? wbnbBal : usdtBal;
   496	
   497	  const wallet = new ChassisOphisWallet(ctx.account, ctx.publicClient, ctx.walletClient);
   498	  const result = await executeOphisSwap(
   499	    wallet,
   500	    {
   501	      sellToken: sellToken.address,
   502	      buyToken: buyToken.address,
   503	      sellAmount,
   504	      slippageBps: 100,
   505	    },
   506	    {},
   507	  );
   508	  const pendingOrder: PendingOrder = {
   509	    orderUid: result.orderUid,
   510	    sellSymbol: leg.sell,
   511	    sellAmountWei: toBaseUnits(sellAmount, sellToken.decimals).toString(),
   512	    preSellBalanceWei: preSellBalance.toString(),
   513	    placedAt: Date.now(),
   514	  };
   515	  ctx.state.set('pendingOrder', pendingOrder);
   516	  ctx.log({
   517	    event: 'ophis-swap-submitted',
   518	    orderUid: result.orderUid,
   519	    explorerUrl: result.explorerUrl,
   520	    sellToken: sellToken.symbol,
   521	    buyToken: buyToken.symbol,
   522	    sellAmount,
   523	    notionalUsd: leg.notionalUsd,
   524	    minBuyAmount: result.minBuyAmount,
   525	    enrollmentWarning: result.enrollmentWarning ?? null,
   526	  });
   527	
   528	  for (let i = 0; i < FILL_POLL_ATTEMPTS; i += 1) {
   529	    await sleep(FILL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
   530	    const status = await checkPendingOrder(ctx);
   531	    if (status !== 'pending') return;
   532	  }
   533	  ctx.log({ event: 'ophis-fill-poll-timeout', orderUid: result.orderUid });
   534	}

   539	
   540	export const lpRangeAgent: AgentModule = {
   541	  name: 'lp-range',
   542	  category: 'rebalancing',
   543	  tickIntervalMs: 600_000,
   544	
   545	  async tick(ctx) {
   546	    if (ctx.breakers.isHalted().halted) {
   547	      ctx.log({ event: 'tick-skipped', reason: 'halted' });
   548	      return;
   549	    }
   550	    const info = await resolvePool(ctx);
   551	    const pos = ctx.state.get<PositionState | null>('position', null);
   552	
   553	    if (!pos) {
   554	      await tryMint(ctx, info);
   555	      return;
   556	    }
   557	
   558	    const now = Date.now();
   559	    const slot0 = await readSlot0(ctx, info.pool);
   560	    const inRange = isInRange(slot0.tick, pos.tickLower, pos.tickUpper);
   561	    const outSince = nextOutSince(inRange, pos.outSince, now);
   562	    if (outSince !== pos.outSince) {
   563	      ctx.state.set('position', { ...pos, outSince });
   564	    }
   565	    ctx.log({
   566	      event: 'range-check',
   567	      tokenId: pos.tokenId,
   568	      currentTick: slot0.tick,
   569	      tickLower: pos.tickLower,
   570	      tickUpper: pos.tickUpper,
   571	      inRange,
   572	      outSinceMs: outSince === null ? null : now - outSince,
   573	    });
   574	
   575	    if (!shouldRebalance(outSince, now)) return;
   576	
   577	    const weekly = pruneWindow(ctx.state.get<number[]>('rebalanceTimes', []), now, WEEK_MS);
   578	    if (weekly.length >= MAX_REBALANCES_PER_WEEK) {
   579	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-skipped', reason: 'weekly-cap', rebalancesThisWeek: weekly.length });
   580	      ctx.state.set('rebalanceTimes', weekly);
   581	      return;
   582	    }
   583	    if (!ctx.breakers.allowAction('rebalance', 2)) {
   584	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-skipped', reason: 'daily-cap' });
   585	      return;
   586	    }
   587	
   588	    /* Committed: count it even if a later step fails, so caps stay conservative. */
   589	    ctx.state.set('rebalanceTimes', [...weekly, now]);
   590	    ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-start', tokenId: pos.tokenId, currentTick: slot0.tick });
   591	
   592	    const exited = await exitPosition(ctx, pos);
   593	    if (!exited) return;
   594	    ctx.state.set('position', null);
   595	
   596	    try {
   597	      await rebalanceInventory(ctx, info);
   598	    } catch (err) {
   599	      ctx.log({ event: 'rebalance-swap-failed', error: String(err) });
   600	    }
   601	    /* Re-mint defers to the next tick when the Ophis order has not filled yet. */
   602	    await tryMint(ctx, info);
   603	  },
   604	
   605	  async status(ctx) {
   606	    const now = Date.now();
   607	    const pos = ctx.state.get<PositionState | null>('position', null);
   608	    const weekly = pruneWindow(ctx.state.get<number[]>('rebalanceTimes', []), now, WEEK_MS);
   609	    let currentTick: number | null = null;
   610	    try {
   611	      const info = await resolvePool(ctx);
   612	      currentTick = (await readSlot0(ctx, info.pool)).tick;
   613	    } catch {
   614	      currentTick = null;
   615	    }
   616	    const halted = ctx.breakers.isHalted();
   617	    return {
   618	      tokenId: pos?.tokenId ?? null,
   619	      tickLower: pos?.tickLower ?? null,
   620	      tickUpper: pos?.tickUpper ?? null,
   621	      currentTick,
   622	      inRange:
   623	        pos && currentTick !== null ? isInRange(currentTick, pos.tickLower, pos.tickUpper) : null,
   624	      outSinceMinutes:
   625	        pos?.outSince != null ? Math.round((now - pos.outSince) / 60000) : null,
   626	      rebalancesToday: pruneWindow(weekly, now, DAY_MS).length,
   627	      rebalancesThisWeek: weekly.length,
   628	      halted: halted.halted,
   629	    };
   630	  },
   631	};

     1	import { TOKENS_BSC, fromBaseUnits, toBaseUnits } from '@agripinaa/shared';
     2	
     3	export type Address = `0x${string}`;
     4	
     5	export const MAX_SESSION_SECONDS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
     6	
     7	export type SpendCapToken = 'USDT' | 'USDC';
     8	
     9	export interface SessionScopeInput {
    10	  allowlist: readonly Address[];
    11	  spendCap: { token: SpendCapToken; amount: string; period: 'day' };
    12	  expiresInSeconds: number;
    13	}
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * Structurally compatible with the Altana SDK's GrantSessionOptions
    17	 * (permissions + expiry), kept SDK-free so the web app can build and
    18	 * render scopes without the SDK loaded.
    19	 */
    20	export interface SessionScope {
    21	  permissions: {
    22	    calls: { to: Address }[];
    23	    spend: { limit: bigint; period: 'day'; token: Address }[];
    24	  };
    25	  expiry: number;
    26	}
    27	
    28	const ADDRESS_RE = /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/;
    29	
    30	/**
    31	 * Builds {permissions, expiry} ready to spread into grantSession.
    32	 *
    33	 * Fail-closed by construction: upstream, omitting permissions.calls means
    34	 * UNRESTRICTED contract access, and a spend entry without a token address
    35	 * caps the NATIVE token instead of the stablecoin. Every rule here exists
    36	 * to make those upstream defaults unreachable.
    37	 */
    38	export function buildSessionScope(input: SessionScopeInput): SessionScope {
    39	  const { allowlist, spendCap, expiresInSeconds } = input;
    40	
    41	  if (!allowlist || allowlist.length === 0) {
    42	    throw new Error(
    43	      'buildSessionScope rule "allowlist-required": allowlist is empty or missing; ' +
    44	        'an empty calls allowlist would fall through to the upstream fail-open default (unrestricted contract access)',
    45	    );
    46	  }
    47	  for (const to of allowlist) {
    48	    if (typeof to !== 'string' || !ADDRESS_RE.test(to)) {
    49	      throw new Error(
    50	        `buildSessionScope rule "allowlist-address-shape": "${String(to)}" is not a 20-byte 0x address; ` +
    51	          'a malformed entry cannot be trusted to restrict anything',
    52	      );
    53	    }
    54	  }
    55	
    56	  const token = TOKENS_BSC[spendCap.token];
    57	  if (!token) {
    58	    throw new Error(
    59	      `buildSessionScope rule "known-token": "${spendCap.token}" is not in TOKENS_BSC; ` +
    60	        'spend caps are only built for tokens whose decimals are pinned there',
    61	    );
    62	  }
    63	  if (spendCap.period !== 'day') {
    64	    throw new Error(
    65	      `buildSessionScope rule "day-period-only": period "${String(spendCap.period)}" is not supported; only 'day' is`,
    66	    );
    67	  }
    68	  // toBaseUnits throws on malformed amounts; decimals always come from
    69	  // TOKENS_BSC (USDT/USDC are 18 decimals on BNB, not the 6 of Ethereum USDT).
    70	  const limit = toBaseUnits(spendCap.amount, token.decimals);
    71	
    72	  if (
    73	    typeof expiresInSeconds !== 'number' ||
    74	    !Number.isInteger(expiresInSeconds) ||
    75	    expiresInSeconds <= 0
    76	  ) {
    77	    throw new Error(
    78	      `buildSessionScope rule "positive-integer-expiry": expiresInSeconds must be an integer > 0, got ${String(expiresInSeconds)}`,
    79	    );
    80	  }
    81	  if (expiresInSeconds > MAX_SESSION_SECONDS) {
    82	    throw new Error(
    83	      `buildSessionScope rule "max-expiry-30-days": expiresInSeconds ${expiresInSeconds} exceeds ${MAX_SESSION_SECONDS} (30 days)`,
    84	    );
    85	  }
    86	
    87	  return {
    88	    permissions: {
    89	      calls: allowlist.map((to) => ({ to })),
    90	      spend: [{ limit, period: 'day', token: token.address }],
    91	    },
    92	    expiry: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + expiresInSeconds,
    93	  };
    94	}
    95	
    96	export interface ScopeSummary {
    97	  allowlistCount: number;
    98	  capFormatted: string;
    99	  expiresAt: string;
   100	}
   101	
   102	/** Plain-English summary of a scope for UI rendering. */
   103	export function describeScope(scope: SessionScope): ScopeSummary {
   104	  const spend = scope.permissions.spend[0];
   105	  let capFormatted = 'no spend cap';
   106	  if (spend) {
   107	    const known = Object.values(TOKENS_BSC).find(
   108	      (t) => t.address.toLowerCase() === spend.token.toLowerCase(),
   109	    );
   110	    capFormatted = known
   111	      ? `${fromBaseUnits(spend.limit, known.decimals)} ${known.symbol} per ${spend.period}`
   112	      : `${spend.limit.toString()} base units of ${spend.token} per ${spend.period}`;
   113	  }
   114	  return {
   115	    allowlistCount: scope.permissions.calls.length,
   116	    capFormatted,
   117	    expiresAt: new Date(scope.expiry * 1000).toISOString(),
   118	  };
   119	}

FILE packages/session-kit/src/persist.ts
     1	/**
     2	 * Session persistence. Sessions REQUIRE byte-exact persistence: the relay
     3	 * validates against the exact granted object, and any re-serialization that
     4	 * reorders keys or reformats values breaks the session. These helpers are
     5	 * the only supported way to write a session to disk or read one back.
     6	 *
     7	 * bigint fields (spend limits) are encoded as "bigint:<decimal>" strings,
     8	 * the same convention the spike session files on disk already use.
     9	 */
    10	
    11	const BIGINT_MARKER = 'bigint:';
    12	
    13	export function serializeSession(session: unknown): string {
    14	  return JSON.stringify(session, (_key, value: unknown) =>
    15	    typeof value === 'bigint' ? BIGINT_MARKER + value.toString() : value,
    16	  );
    17	}
    18	
    19	export function deserializeSession(raw: string): unknown {
    20	  return JSON.parse(raw, (_key, value: unknown) =>
    21	    typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith(BIGINT_MARKER)
    22	      ? BigInt(value.slice(BIGINT_MARKER.length))
    23	      : value,
    24	  );
    25	}
    26	
    27	/** True iff serialize(deserialize(serialize(x))) === serialize(x). */
    28	export function roundTripIsExact(session: unknown): boolean {
    29	  const first = serializeSession(session);
    30	  return serializeSession(deserializeSession(first)) === first;
    31	}
    32	
    33	// File helpers use dynamic import so bundling this module for the browser
    34	// never pulls node:fs at top level; only agents (Node) may call these.
    35	
    36	export async function saveSessionFile(path: string, session: unknown): Promise<void> {
    37	  const { writeFile } = await import('node:fs/promises');
    38	  await writeFile(path, serializeSession(session), 'utf8');
    39	}
    40	
    41	export async function loadSessionFile(path: string): Promise<unknown> {
    42	  const { readFile } = await import('node:fs/promises');
    43	  return deserializeSession(await readFile(path, 'utf8'));
    44	}

FILE packages/session-kit/src/verify.ts
     1	/**
     2	 * Read-only on-chain session-key authority checks. Deliberately free of any
     3	 * Altana SDK dependency so the web app can render authority panels with zero
     4	 * credentials: viem public reads only.
     5	 *
     6	 * ABI and derivation confirmed against @altananetwork/sdk@0.7.0 sources
     7	 * (dist/internal/keystore.js): KeyStore v0 convention is
     8	 * keyId = keccak256(publicKey) with publicKey as SEC1 uncompressed bytes
     9	 * (0x04 || x || y, 65 bytes), and the registry read is
    10	 * isValidKey(address user, bytes32 keyId) view returns (bool), true iff the
    11	 * key is registered, unexpired, and unrevoked. Addresses below match the
    12	 * SDK's BNB and BNB_TESTNET NetworkConfig keyStore fields exactly.
    13	 */
    14	
    15	import { createPublicClient, http, keccak256, type Hex } from 'viem';
    16	import { BSC_MAINNET, BSC_TESTNET } from '@agripinaa/shared';
    17	import type { Address } from './scope';
    18	
    19	export const KEYSTORE_ADDRESSES: Record<number, Address> = {
    20	  56: '0x6572427ED530BadcF7375Cf9A4709D8d2b0E7E0a',
    21	  97: '0x6b8361C29d05D498b1a12B54A37310f94171E94A',
    22	};
    23	
    24	export const KEYSTORE_READ_ABI = [
    25	  {
    26	    name: 'isValidKey',
    27	    type: 'function',
    28	    stateMutability: 'view',
    29	    inputs: [
    30	      { name: 'user', type: 'address' },
    31	      { name: 'keyId', type: 'bytes32' },
    32	    ],
    33	    outputs: [{ type: 'bool' }],
    34	  },
    35	  {
    36	    name: 'getKeys',
    37	    type: 'function',
    38	    stateMutability: 'view',
    39	    inputs: [{ name: 'user', type: 'address' }],
    40	    outputs: [{ type: 'bytes32[]' }],
    41	  },
    42	  {
    43	    name: 'getPublicKey',
    44	    type: 'function',
    45	    stateMutability: 'view',
    46	    inputs: [
    47	      { name: 'user', type: 'address' },
    48	      { name: 'keyId', type: 'bytes32' },
    49	    ],
    50	    outputs: [{ type: 'bytes' }],
    51	  },
    52	] as const;
    53	
    54	/** KeyStore v0 keyId convention: keccak256 of the SEC1-encoded public key. */
    55	export function keyIdFromPublicKey(sessionPublicKey: Hex): Hex {
    56	  return keccak256(sessionPublicKey);
    57	}
    58	
    59	function rpcUrlFor(chainId: number): string {
    60	  if (chainId === BSC_MAINNET.id) return BSC_MAINNET.rpcUrls[0];
    61	  if (chainId === BSC_TESTNET.id) return BSC_TESTNET.rpcUrls[0];
    62	  throw new Error(
    63	    `isSessionKeyValid: no default RPC for chainId ${chainId}; supported chains are 56 and 97`,
    64	  );
    65	}
    66	
    67	export interface IsSessionKeyValidArgs {
    68	  chainId: number;
    69	  /** The smart-account (wallet) address the session was granted on. */
    70	  account: Address;
    71	  /** SEC1 uncompressed public key of the session signer (0x04 || x || y). */
    72	  sessionPublicKey: Hex;
    73	  /** Override the default public RPC (e.g. a paid endpoint). */
    74	  rpcUrl?: string;
    75	}
    76	
    77	/**
    78	 * True iff the session key is currently registered, unexpired, and unrevoked
    79	 * in the KeyStore registry. False is a definitive negative (never registered,
    80	 * expired, or revoked); the call does not revert for unknown keys.
    81	 */
    82	export async function isSessionKeyValid(args: IsSessionKeyValidArgs): Promise<boolean> {
    83	  const { chainId, account, sessionPublicKey, rpcUrl } = args;
    84	  const keyStore = KEYSTORE_ADDRESSES[chainId];
    85	  if (!keyStore) {
    86	    throw new Error(
    87	      `isSessionKeyValid: no KeyStore deployment known for chainId ${chainId}; supported chains are 56 and 97`,
    88	    );
    89	  }
    90	  const client = createPublicClient({
    91	    transport: http(rpcUrl ?? rpcUrlFor(chainId)),
    92	  });
    93	  return client.readContract({
    94	    address: keyStore,
    95	    abi: KEYSTORE_READ_ABI,
    96	    functionName: 'isValidKey',
    97	    args: [account, keyIdFromPublicKey(sessionPublicKey)],
    98	  });
    99	}

     6	import {
     7	  deserializeSession,
     8	  loadSessionFile,
     9	  roundTripIsExact,
    10	  saveSessionFile,
    11	  serializeSession,
    12	} from '../src/index';
    13	
    14	// Same shape as wallets/spike-b-session.json (keys redacted, values fake).
    15	const sessionFixture = {
    16	  walletAddress: '0xACF6FC404F2B2D11D77Fe788f1eDaE5A7E0996Cf',
    17	  signer: {
    18	    type: 'privateKey',
    19	    address: '0x59cb56a0a8B09223256A5ED92FEAd4f726610c0F',
    20	    publicKey: '0x04ab',
    21	    _privateKey: '0x01',
    22	  },
    23	  publicKey: '0x04ab',
    24	  permissions: {
    25	    calls: [{ to: '0x337610d27c682E347C9cD60BD4b3b107C9d34dDd' }],
    26	    spend: [{ limit: 5000000000000000000n, period: 'day' }],
    27	  },
    28	  expiry: 1787074935,
    29	};
    30	
    31	test('bigints serialize with the marker and revive back to bigint', () => {
    32	  const raw = serializeSession(sessionFixture);
    33	  assert.ok(raw.includes('"bigint:5000000000000000000"'));
    34	  const revived = deserializeSession(raw) as typeof sessionFixture;
    35	  assert.equal(revived.permissions.spend[0]?.limit, 5000000000000000000n);
    36	  assert.equal(typeof revived.permissions.spend[0]?.limit, 'bigint');
    37	});
    38	
    39	test('round trip is byte-exact for nested objects with bigints', () => {
    40	  const first = serializeSession(sessionFixture);
    41	  const second = serializeSession(deserializeSession(first));
    42	  assert.equal(second, first);
    43	  assert.equal(roundTripIsExact(sessionFixture), true);
    44	});
    45	
    46	test('round trip is byte-exact for deeply nested mixed values', () => {
    47	  const gnarly = {
    48	    a: [1n, 'two', { three: 3n, four: [4, '5', 6n] }],
    49	    b: { c: { d: 0n, e: null, f: false } },
    50	    g: 'bigint:123',
    51	  };
    52	  assert.equal(roundTripIsExact(gnarly), true);
    53	});
    54	
    55	test('deserializeSession(garbage) throws cleanly', () => {
    56	  assert.throws(() => deserializeSession('not json at all'));
    57	  assert.throws(() => deserializeSession('{"x": "bigint:notanumber"}'));
    58	});
    59	
    60	test('saveSessionFile writes the exact serializeSession bytes; loadSessionFile revives', async () => {
    61	  const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'session-kit-'));
    62	  try {
    63	    const path = join(dir, 'session.json');
    64	    await saveSessionFile(path, sessionFixture);
    65	    const onDisk = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
    66	    assert.equal(onDisk, serializeSession(sessionFixture));
    67	    const loaded = (await loadSessionFile(path)) as typeof sessionFixture;
    68	    assert.equal(loaded.permissions.spend[0]?.limit, 5000000000000000000n);
    69	    assert.equal(serializeSession(loaded), onDisk);
    70	  } finally {
    71	    await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    72	  }
    73	});
    74

    81	    t.skip('spike session file not present');
    82	    return;
    83	  }
    84	  assert.equal(serializeSession(deserializeSession(onDisk)), onDisk);
    85	});
