     1	import {} from "viem";
     2	import {} from "./config.js";
     3	import { keyHashForSigner } from "./internal/erc1271.js";
     4	import { createPrivateKeySigner } from "./internal/signer.js";
     5	import { buildPublicClient, buildRelayClient, keyDescriptorFromSigner, submitCalls, waitForCalls, } from "./internal/relay.js";
     6	import { buildAdditionalRegisterCall, readRegistrationFee, } from "./internal/keystore.js";
     7	const NATIVE_TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
     8	/**
     9	 * Grant a scoped session key for a wallet. The admin signer authorizes the
    10	 * session on-chain; from that point forward the session can act on the
    11	 * wallet within its permissions/expiry, enforced by the Altana account
    12	 * contract validator.
    13	 *
    14	 * Pass the returned Session to whichever process runs the agent. The agent
    15	 * calls execute(session, calls) — never the admin.
    16	 */
    17	export async function grantSession(wallet, adminSigner, opts, config) {
    18	    const network = config.network;
    19	    const feeToken = config.feeToken ?? NATIVE_TOKEN;
    20	    const sessionSigner = opts.sessionSigner ?? createPrivateKeySigner();
    21	    // Session key descriptor — secp256k1 or passkey (WebAuthnP256), by signer.
    22	    const sessionKeyDesc = keyDescriptorFromSigner(sessionSigner, {
    23	        role: "session",
    24	        expiry: opts.expiry,
    25	        permissions: opts.permissions,
    26	    });
    27	    // Admin descriptor. Only `role` is consumed by submitCalls for signing (the
    28	    // curve is inferred from adminSigner itself), so secp256k1 here is inert even
    29	    // for passkey admins.
    30	    const adminKeyDesc = {
    31	        type: "secp256k1",
    32	        publicKey: adminSigner.publicKey,
    33	        role: "admin",
    34	    };
    35	    const relayClient = buildRelayClient(network);
    36	    const publicClient = buildPublicClient(network);
    37	    // Register the session's public key in KeyStore alongside the Porto
    38	    // authorization (default). KeyStore is the public registry that lets ANY
    39	    // tool/agent verify this session — without it, the session only exists
    40	    // inside Porto's smart-account contract and `verify_authorization` returns
    41	    // false. Batched into the same userOp at the cost of one registration fee.
    42	    // `register: false` skips the registry entry (and the fee) for ephemeral
    43	    // sessions; the account-level authorization below is unaffected, and the
    44	    // key can be registered later with registerSessionKey.
    45	    const register = opts.register !== false;
    46	    let registerCalls = [];
    47	    if (register) {
    48	        const fee = await readRegistrationFee(publicClient, network);
    49	        registerCalls = [
    50	            buildAdditionalRegisterCall({
    51	                publicKey: sessionSigner.publicKey,
    52	                fee,
    53	                network,
    54	                expiry: opts.expiry,
    55	            }),
    56	        ];
    57	    }
    58	    // submitCalls auto-prepends initialRegisterKey(admin) on the wallet's
    59	    // very first admin action, so the final intent ends up as:
    60	    //   [ initialRegisterKey(admin)?, registerKey(session)?, authorizeKeys=[session] ]
    61	    const callsId = await submitCalls(relayClient, wallet.address, adminSigner, registerCalls, {
    62	        feeToken,
    63	        submittingKey: adminKeyDesc,
    64	        authorizeKeys: [sessionKeyDesc],
    65	        network,
    66	    });
    67	    const result = await waitForCalls(relayClient, callsId);
    68	    if (result.status !== "CONFIRMED") {
    69	        throw new Error(`Session grant did not confirm: status=${result.status}`);
    70	    }
    71	    // Some public RPCs (notably BSC) return stale eth_call results for
    72	    // a few seconds after a tx confirms. The relay says CONFIRMED, but a follow
    73	    // up read of AltanaAccount.getKeys() can still miss the just-added session
    74	    // key, which makes the very next execute() call fail with "unknown key
    75	    // hash". Wait until the new keyHash is visible from THIS process AND give
    76	    // the relay's separate connection pool time to converge before we hand the
    77	    // Session back to the caller.
    78	    const expectedKeyHash = keyHashForSigner(sessionSigner);
    79	    const startedWait = Date.now();
    80	    await waitForSessionKeyVisible(publicClient, wallet.address, expectedKeyHash, 30_000);
    81	    // Extra buffer: load-balanced public RPCs serve independent caches to
    82	    // different connection pools. After our process sees the new key, the
    83	    // relay's separate pool can still be ~10s behind. Round up to 12s to be
    84	    // safe; cap the total time we've spent waiting since CONFIRMED at 30s.
    85	    const elapsed = Date.now() - startedWait;
    86	    const relayCatchUpMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(12_000, 30_000 - elapsed));
    87	    if (relayCatchUpMs > 0) {
    88	        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, relayCatchUpMs));
    89	    }

   119	async function waitForSessionKeyVisible(publicClient, walletAddress, expectedKeyHash, timeoutMs) {
   120	    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
   121	    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
   122	        try {
   123	            const [, keyHashes] = (await publicClient.readContract({
   124	                address: walletAddress,
   125	                abi: ACCOUNT_GET_KEYS_ABI,
   126	                functionName: "getKeys",
   127	                blockTag: "latest",
   128	            }));
   129	            if (keyHashes.includes(expectedKeyHash))
   130	                return;
   131	        }
   132	        catch {
   133	            // Wallet may not be delegated yet on a still-stale read; retry.
   134	        }
   135	        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
   136	    }
   137	    // Timeout: relay confirmed the grant, but this process's view of the chain
   138	    // never caught up. The session was still written on-chain; the caller can
   139	    // try to use it (execute will retry under the hood once the RPC catches up
   140	    // on the relay's separate connection too).
   141	}

    12	 * USDT and USDC are 18 decimals on BNB Chain (USDT is 6 on Ethereum). A
    13	 * hardcoded 6 anywhere silently turns a $50 session spend cap into $0.00005.

    33	/** "12.5" + 18 decimals → BigInt("12500000000000000000"). Throws on malformed input. */
    34	export function toBaseUnits(amount: string, decimals: number): bigint {
    35	  const match = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(amount.trim());
    36	  if (!match) throw new Error(`Invalid decimal amount: "${amount}"`);
    37	  const whole = match[1] ?? '0';
    38	  const frac = match[2] ?? '';
    39	  if (frac.length > decimals) {
    40	    throw new Error(
    41	      `Amount "${amount}" has more fractional digits than token decimals (${decimals})`,
    42	    );
    43	  }
    44	  return BigInt(whole + frac.padEnd(decimals, '0'));
    45	}
    46	
    47	export function fromBaseUnits(value: bigint, decimals: number): string {
    48	  const s = value.toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0');
    49	  const whole = s.slice(0, s.length - decimals);
    50	  const frac = s.slice(s.length - decimals).replace(/0+$/, '');
    51	  return frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : whole;
    52	}

    42	        if (!cancelled) setValidity('unknown');
    43	      }
    44	    }
    45	    void check();
    46	    return () => {
    47	      cancelled = true;
    48	    };
    49	  }, [meta]);
    50	
    51	  async function revoke() {
    52	    setBusy(true);
    53	    setError(null);
    54	    try {
    55	      const client = altanaClient();
    56	      // Re-authenticate with the passkey to sign the revocation as admin.
    57	      const wallet = await client.recoverFromPasskey();
    58	      if (wallet.address.toLowerCase() !== meta.account.toLowerCase()) {
    59	        throw new Error(
    60	          'This passkey controls a different account than the session grantor.',
    61	        );
    62	      }
    63	      const session = reviveSession(meta);
    64	      await client.revokeSession({
    65	        wallet,
    66	        signer: wallet.signer,
    67	        chainId: meta.chainId,
    68	        session: session as Parameters<typeof client.revokeSession>[0]['session'],
    69	      });
    70	      markRevoked(meta.id);
    71	      setValidity('invalid');
    72	      onChange();
    73	    } catch (e) {
    74	      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    75	    } finally {
    76	      setBusy(false);
    77	    }
    78	  }
    79	
    80	  const badge =
    81	    validity === 'valid'
    82	      ? { text: 'active on-chain', cls: 'bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-300' }
    83	      : validity === 'invalid'
    84	        ? { text: 'revoked / expired', cls: 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400' }
    85	        : validity === 'checking'
    86	          ? { text: 'checking…', cls: 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500' }
    87	          : { text: 'not verifiable', cls: 'bg-amber-900/40 text-amber-300' };
    88	
    89	  return (
    90	    <li className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 p-4">
    91	      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
    92	        <div>
    93	          <p className="font-medium">{meta.agent.name}</p>
    94	          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
    95	            {meta.chainId === 97 ? 'BSC Testnet' : 'BNB Chain'} · granted{' '}
    96	            {new Date(meta.grantedAt).toLocaleString()}
    97	          </p>
    98	        </div>
    99	        <span className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs ${badge.cls}`}>
   100	          {badge.text}
   101	        </span>
   102	      </div>
   103	      <dl className="mt-3 space-y-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">
   104	        <div>
   105	          <dt className="inline text-zinc-500">Cap: </dt>
   106	          <dd className="inline">{meta.scope.capFormatted}</dd>
   107	        </div>
   108	        <div>
   109	          <dt className="inline text-zinc-500">Expires: </dt>
   110	          <dd className="inline">{new Date(meta.scope.expiresAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
   111	        </div>
   112	        <div>
   113	          <dt className="inline text-zinc-500">Allowlist: </dt>
   114	          <dd className="inline break-all font-mono">
   115	            {meta.scope.allowlist.join(', ')}
   116	          </dd>
   117	        </div>
   118	      </dl>
   119	      <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
   120	        {validity === 'valid' && (
   121	          <button
   122	            onClick={revoke}
   123	            disabled={busy}
   124	            className="rounded border border-red-900 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-red-300 hover:bg-red-950/40 disabled:opacity-50"
   125	          >
   126	            {busy ? 'Revoking…' : 'Revoke'}
   127	          </button>
   128	        )}
   129	        <button
   130	          onClick={() => {
   131	            forgetSession(meta.id);
   132	            onChange();
   133	          }}
   134	          className="rounded border border-zinc-700 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:border-zinc-500"
   135	        >
   136	          Forget
   137	        </button>
   138	      </div>
   139	      {error && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-300">{error}</p>}
   140	    </li>
   141	  );
   142	}

   371	/**
   372	 * Converts a Relay-formatted key to a key.
   373	 *
   374	 * @example
   375	 * TODO
   376	 *
   377	 * @param relayKey - Relay key.
   378	 * @returns Key.
   379	 */
   380	export function fromRelay(relayKey, options) {
   381	    const { chainId } = options;
   382	    const { publicKey } = relayKey;
   383	    const isAddress = Hex.size(publicKey) === 20 ||
   384	        Hex.toBigInt(Hex.slice(publicKey, 0, 12)) === 0n;
   385	    const permissions = {};
   386	    for (const permission of relayKey.permissions) {
   387	        if (permission.type === 'call') {
   388	            permissions.calls ??= [];
   389	            permissions.calls.push({
   390	                signature: permission.selector,
   391	                to: permission.to === Call.anyTarget ? undefined : permission.to,
   392	            });
   393	        }
   394	        if (permission.type === 'spend') {
   395	            permissions.spend ??= [];
   396	            permissions.spend.push({
   397	                limit: permission.limit,
   398	                period: permission.period,
   399	                token: permission.token,
   400	            });
   401	        }
   402	    }
   403	    return from({
   404	        chainId,
   405	        expiry: relayKey.expiry,
   406	        permissions: permissions,
   407	        publicKey: relayKey.publicKey,
   408	        role: fromRelayKeyRole[relayKey.role],
   409	        type: isAddress ? 'address' : fromRelayKeyType[relayKey.type],
   410	    });
   411	}

   745	/**
   746	 * Converts a key to a Relay-compatible format.
   747	 *
   748	 * @example
   749	 * TODO
   750	 *
   751	 * @param key - Key.
   752	 * @returns Relay key.
   753	 */
   754	export function toRelay(key, options = {}) {
   755	    const { expiry = 0, prehash = false, publicKey, role = 'admin', type } = key;
   756	    const { feeTokens, orchestrator } = options;
   757	    // biome-ignore lint/complexity/useFlatMap: i know
   758	    const permissions = Object.entries(resolvePermissions(key, {
   759	        feeTokens,
   760	    }))
   761	        // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/useIterableCallbackReturn: _
   762	        .map(([key, v]) => {
   763	        if (key === 'calls') {
   764	            const calls = v;
   765	            return calls.map(({ signature, to }) => {
   766	                const selector = (() => {
   767	                    if (!signature)
   768	                        return Call.anySelector;
   769	                    if (Hex.validate(signature))
   770	                        return signature;
   771	                    return AbiFunction.getSelector(signature);
   772	                })();
   773	                return {
   774	                    selector,
   775	                    to: to ?? Call.anyTarget,
   776	                    type: 'call',
   777	                };
   778	            });
   779	        }
   780	        if (key === 'feeToken')
   781	            return;
   782	        if (key === 'spend') {
   783	            const value = v;
   784	            return value.map(({ limit, period, token }) => {
   785	                return {
   786	                    limit,
   787	                    period,
   788	                    token,
   789	                    type: 'spend',
   790	                };
   791	            });
   792	        }
   793	        throw new Error(`Invalid permission type "${key}".`);
   794	    })
   795	        .flat()
   796	        .filter(Boolean);
   797	    if (key.role === 'session' && orchestrator)
   798	        permissions.push({
   799	            selector: Call.anySelector,
   800	            to: orchestrator,
   801	            type: 'call',
   802	        });
   803	    return {
   804	        expiry,
   805	        permissions: permissions ?? [],
   806	        prehash,
   807	        publicKey: serializePublicKey(publicKey),
   808	        role: toRelayKeyRole[role],
   809	        type: toRelayKeyType[type],
   810	    };
   811	}

   831	            let minPeriod = toSerializedSpendPeriod.year;
   832	            for (let i = 0; i < spend.length; i++) {

   834	                if (s.token && Address.isEqual(feeToken.address, s.token)) {

   836	                    break;
   837	                }
   838	                if (!s.token && feeToken.address === zeroAddress) {

   879	export function getFeeToken(key, options) {
   880	    const { feeTokens } = options;
   881	    if (!key.feeToken)
   882	        return undefined;
   883	    const feeToken = feeTokens.find((token) => {
   884	        if (key.feeToken.symbol === token.symbol)
   885	            return true;
   886	        if (!key.feeToken.symbol)
   887	            return token.address === zeroAddress;
   888	        if (key.feeToken.symbol === 'native')
   889	            return token.address === zeroAddress;
   890	        return false;
   891	    });
   892	    if (!feeToken)
   893	        return undefined;
   894	    const value = Value.from(key.feeToken.limit, feeToken.decimals);
   895	    return {
   896	        ...feeToken,
   897	        value,
   898	    };

     5	const NATIVE_TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
     6	/**
     7	 * Revoke a session key from a wallet on-chain. After confirmation, the
     8	 * session's next execute attempt fails at validator level.
     9	 *
    10	 * Accepts either a Session object or just the session's public key when
    11	 * you've persisted the session metadata in your app.
    12	 */
    13	export async function revokeSession(wallet, adminSigner, sessionOrPublicKey, config) {
    14	    const network = config.network;
    15	    const feeToken = config.feeToken ?? NATIVE_TOKEN;
    16	    const sessionPublicKey = typeof sessionOrPublicKey === "string"
    17	        ? sessionOrPublicKey
    18	        : sessionOrPublicKey.publicKey;
    19	    const sessionKeyDesc = {
    20	        type: "secp256k1",
    21	        publicKey: sessionPublicKey,
    22	        role: "session",
    23	    };
    24	    const adminKeyDesc = {
    25	        type: "secp256k1",
    26	        publicKey: adminSigner.publicKey,
    27	        role: "admin",
    28	    };
    29	    const relayClient = buildRelayClient(network);
    30	    const publicClient = buildPublicClient(network);
    31	    // Revoke in KeyStore alongside revoking on Porto. KeyStore is the
    32	    // public registry — leaving a revoked session there would be a stale
    33	    // record that other tools would still treat as active. Both ops land in
    34	    // the same userOp. Revocation is monotonic in v1.0.0.
    35	    //
    36	    // Gated on the key actually being registered: sessions granted with
    37	    // `register: false` have no KeyStore entry, and revoking a missing keyId
    38	    // would revert — taking the account-level revoke (the one that removes the
    39	    // session's authority) down with it, since the bundle is atomic.
    40	    const keyId = keccak256(sessionPublicKey);
    41	    const isRegistered = await readIsValidKey(publicClient, network, wallet.address, keyId);
    42	    const revokeCalls = isRegistered
    43	        ? [buildRevokeKeyCall({ walletAddress: wallet.address, keyId, network })]
    44	        : [];
    45	    const callsId = await submitCalls(relayClient, wallet.address, adminSigner, revokeCalls, {
    46	        feeToken,
    47	        submittingKey: adminKeyDesc,
    48	        revokeKeys: [sessionKeyDesc],
    49	        network,
    50	    });
    51	    const result = await waitForCalls(relayClient, callsId);
    52	    return {
    53	        callsId,
    54	        status: result.status,
    55	        ...(result.transactionHash ? { transactionHash: result.transactionHash } : {}),
    56	    };
    57	}

     7	 *   - validator    = address(0)  (no on-chain validator for secp256k1 in v0)
     8	 *   - metadata     = "0x"        (none)
     9	 *   - publicKey    = SEC1 uncompressed: 0x04 || x || y (65 bytes, viem default)
    10	 */
    11	import { encodeFunctionData, keccak256, } from "viem";
    12	const ZERO_ADDRESS = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
    13	const CONTROLLER_ABI = [
    14	    {
    15	        name: "initialRegisterKey",
    16	        type: "function",
    17	        stateMutability: "payable",
    18	        inputs: [
    19	            { name: "keyId", type: "bytes32" },
    20	            { name: "validator", type: "address" },
    21	            { name: "metadata", type: "bytes" },
    22	            { name: "publicKey", type: "bytes" },
    23	            { name: "expiry", type: "uint40" },
    24	        ],
    25	        outputs: [],
    26	    },
    27	    {
    28	        name: "registerKey",
    29	        type: "function",
    30	        stateMutability: "payable",
    31	        inputs: [
    32	            { name: "keyId", type: "bytes32" },
    33	            { name: "validator", type: "address" },
    34	            { name: "metadata", type: "bytes" },
    35	            { name: "publicKey", type: "bytes" },
    36	            { name: "expiry", type: "uint40" },
    37	        ],
    38	        outputs: [],
    39	    },
    40	    {
    41	        name: "getRegistrationFeeInWei",
    42	        type: "function",
    43	        stateMutability: "view",
    44	        inputs: [],
    45	        outputs: [{ type: "uint256" }],
    46	    },
    47	];
    48	const KEYSTORE_ABI = [
    49	    {
    50	        name: "getKeys",
    51	        type: "function",
    52	        stateMutability: "view",
    53	        inputs: [{ name: "user", type: "address" }],
    54	        outputs: [{ type: "bytes32[]" }],
    55	    },
    56	    {
    57	        name: "getPublicKey",
    58	        type: "function",
    59	        stateMutability: "view",
    60	        inputs: [
    61	            { name: "user", type: "address" },
    62	            { name: "keyId", type: "bytes32" },
    63	        ],
    64	        outputs: [{ type: "bytes" }],
    65	    },
    66	    {
    67	        name: "revokeKey",
    68	        type: "function",
    69	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    70	        inputs: [
    71	            { name: "user", type: "address" },
    72	            { name: "keyId", type: "bytes32" },
    73	        ],
    74	        outputs: [],
    75	    },
    76	    {
    77	        name: "isValidKey",
    78	        type: "function",
    79	        stateMutability: "view",
    80	        inputs: [
    81	            { name: "user", type: "address" },
    82	            { name: "keyId", type: "bytes32" },
    83	        ],
    84	        outputs: [{ type: "bool" }],
    85	    },
    86	];
    87	const UINT40_MAX = 2 ** 40 - 1;
    88	function toUint40Expiry(expiry) {
    89	    if (!expiry || expiry < 0)
    90	        return 0;
    91	    const v = Math.floor(expiry);
    92	    return v > UINT40_MAX ? UINT40_MAX : v;
    93	}
    94	/** Derives the v0 keyId convention from a SEC1-encoded public key. */
    95	export function deriveKeyId(publicKey) {
    96	    return keccak256(publicKey);
    97	}
    98	/** Reads the current registration fee from the Controller. */
    99	export function readRegistrationFee(publicClient, network) {
   100	    return publicClient.readContract({
   101	        address: network.keyStoreController,
   102	        abi: CONTROLLER_ABI,
   103	        functionName: "getRegistrationFeeInWei",
   104	    });
   105	}
   106	/** Reads the active key ids for a user. Empty array = not yet registered. */
   107	export function readActiveKeys(publicClient, network, user) {
   108	    return publicClient.readContract({
   109	        address: network.keyStore,
   110	        abi: KEYSTORE_ABI,
   111	        functionName: "getKeys",
   112	        args: [user],
   113	    });
   114	}
   115	/**
   116	 * Reads the public key bytes stored for (user, keyId). Used by the passkey
   117	 * recovery flow to reconstruct a wallet's admin authority from on-chain
   118	 * state when localStorage is unavailable.
   119	 */
   120	export function readPublicKey(publicClient, network, user, keyId) {
   121	    return publicClient.readContract({
   122	        address: network.keyStore,
   123	        abi: KEYSTORE_ABI,
   124	        functionName: "getPublicKey",
   125	        args: [user, keyId],
   126	    });
   127	}
   128	/**
   129	 * Reads whether (user, keyId) is a currently valid KeyStore entry —
   130	 * registered, unexpired, unrevoked. The same check `verify_authorization`
   131	 * uses. revokeSession gates its KeyStore call on this (a never-registered
   132	 * key would revert the whole revoke bundle), and registerSessionKey uses it
   133	 * for idempotency.
   134	 */
   135	export function readIsValidKey(publicClient, network, user, keyId) {
   136	    return publicClient.readContract({
   137	        address: network.keyStore,
   138	        abi: KEYSTORE_ABI,
   139	        functionName: "isValidKey",
   140	        args: [user, keyId],
   141	    });
   142	}
   143	/**
   144	 * Returns the KeyStore initial-register call to prepend to a wallet's first
   145	 * admin-signed action, or an empty array if the wallet is already
   146	 * registered. Use this in every entry point that lets an admin act on the
   147	 * wallet (execute, grantSession, revokeSession) so the admin key always
   148	 * lands in KeyStore on whichever call happens to be first — that's what
   149	 * makes recovery-from-passkey work.
   150	 */
   151	export async function buildFirstActionPrepend(args) {
   152	    const active = await readActiveKeys(args.publicClient, args.network, args.walletAddress);
   153	    if (active.length > 0)
   154	        return [];
   155	    const fee = await readRegistrationFee(args.publicClient, args.network);
   156	    return [
   157	        buildInitialRegisterCall({
   158	            publicKey: args.adminPublicKey,
   159	            fee,
   160	            network: args.network,
   161	        }),
   162	    ];
   163	}
   164	/**
   165	 * Builds the call payload to register a wallet's admin authority in KeyStore
   166	 * for the first time. The caller must supply msg.value >= fee (read via
   167	 * readRegistrationFee). Use this in the first execute() so registration
   168	 * batches with whatever the agent is actually doing.
   169	 *
   170	 * `publicKey` is the SEC1-encoded public key of the admin authority — for
   171	 * privateKey signers, the secp256k1 pubkey; for passkey signers, the P256
   172	 * pubkey. KeyStore is signature-scheme agnostic (stores opaque bytes), so
   173	 * the same call shape works for both.
   174	 */
   175	export function buildInitialRegisterCall(args) {
   176	    return {
   177	        to: args.network.keyStoreController,
   178	        value: args.fee,
   179	        data: encodeFunctionData({
   180	            abi: CONTROLLER_ABI,
   181	            functionName: "initialRegisterKey",
   182	            // Root keys must have expiry=0 (enforced by KeyStore v1.0.0).
   183	            args: [
   184	                deriveKeyId(args.publicKey),
   185	                ZERO_ADDRESS,
   186	                "0x",
   187	                args.publicKey,
   188	                0,
   189	            ],
   190	        }),
   191	    };
   192	}
   193	/**
   194	 * Builds the call to register an ADDITIONAL key (e.g. a freshly granted
   195	 * session key) on a wallet that's already initialRegistered in KeyStore.
   196	 * Pays the same fee as initialRegisterKey. Use inside grantSession so the
   197	 * session shows up in the public KeyStore registry, not just on Porto's
   198	 * smart-account contract.
   199	 */
   200	export function buildAdditionalRegisterCall(args) {
   201	    return {
   202	        to: args.network.keyStoreController,
   203	        value: args.fee,
   204	        data: encodeFunctionData({
   205	            abi: CONTROLLER_ABI,
   206	            functionName: "registerKey",
   207	            args: [
   208	                deriveKeyId(args.publicKey),
   209	                ZERO_ADDRESS,
   210	                "0x",
   211	                args.publicKey,
   212	                toUint40Expiry(args.expiry),
   213	            ],
   214	        }),
   215	    };
   216	}
   217	/**
   218	 * Builds the call to revoke a key (e.g. a session being torn down) in
   219	 * KeyStore. Called directly on the KeyStore contract — no fee, no
   220	 * controller in the middle. The wallet itself is the msg.sender (it's
   221	 * executing inside its own userOp), which satisfies KeyStore's
   222	 * onlyKeyOwnerOrValidator modifier. Revocation is monotonic in v1.0.0:
   223	 * once revoked, a key cannot be re-activated.
   224	 */
   225	export function buildRevokeKeyCall(args) {
   226	    return {
   227	        to: args.network.keyStore,
   228	        value: 0n,
   229	        data: encodeFunctionData({
   230	            abi: KEYSTORE_ABI,
   231	            functionName: "revokeKey",
   232	            args: [args.walletAddress, args.keyId],
   233	        }),
   234	    };
   235	}

     1	import { CATEGORIES, type Category } from "@agripinaa/agent-index";
     2	
     3	import { listAgents } from "@/lib/data";
     4	
     5	export async function GET(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
     6	  const url = new URL(request.url);
     7	  const rawCategory = url.searchParams.get("category") ?? undefined;
     8	  const category = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c === rawCategory) as
     9	    | Category
    10	    | undefined;
    11	  if (rawCategory && !category) {
    12	    return Response.json(
    13	      { error: `Unknown category "${rawCategory}"` },
    14	      { status: 400 },
    15	    );
    16	  }
    17	  const limitRaw = Number.parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") ?? "24", 10);
    18	  const limit = Number.isFinite(limitRaw) ? Math.min(limitRaw, 100) : 24;
    19	  const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor") ?? undefined;
    20	
    21	  const page = await listAgents(category, limit, cursor);
    22	  return Response.json(page);
    23	}

    24	  const agent = await getAgent(tokenId);
    25	  if (!agent) notFound();
    26	
    27	  return (
    28	    <div>
    29	      <h1 className="mb-1 text-2xl font-semibold">Activate {agent.name}</h1>
    30	      <p className="mb-8 max-w-xl text-sm text-zinc-400">
    31	        Three steps: a passkey-secured account, a one-time gas top-up, and one
    32	        signature granting exactly the authority you choose.
    33	      </p>
    34	      <SessionWizard
    35	        agent={{
    36	          chainId: agent.chainId,
    37	          tokenId: agent.tokenId,
    38	          name: agent.name,
    39	          agentWallet: agent.agentWallet,
    40	        }}
    41	      />
    42	    </div>
    43	  );

     1	import { ERC8004_REGISTRIES } from '@agripinaa/shared';
     2	import { classify } from '../classify';
     3	import type { AgentIndexSource } from '../source';
     4	import type {
     5	  AgentDetail,

    14	const BASE_URL = process.env.SCAN8004_BASE_URL ?? 'https://8004scan.io/api/v1/public';
    15	/**
    16	 * The keyed API surface (no /public suffix) is a DIFFERENT api: offset/limit
    17	 * envelope ({items,total,offset,limit}) and, crucially, a chain_id filter
    18	 * that actually works server-side (verified 2026-08-18: 257,873 BSC agents
    19	 * vs 740k global). 180 req/min + 20k/day with a key.
    20	 */
    21	const KEYED_BASE_URL = process.env.SCAN8004_KEYED_BASE ?? 'https://8004scan.io/api/v1';
    22	const API_KEY = process.env.SCAN8004_API_KEY;
    23	const KEY_HEADER = process.env.SCAN8004_KEY_HEADER ?? 'X-API-Key';
    24	
    25	export class Scan8004Error extends Error {
    26	  constructor(
    27	    message: string,
    28	    readonly status?: number,
    29	  ) {
    30	    super(message);
    31	    this.name = 'Scan8004Error';
    32	  }
    33	}
    34	
    35	interface ScanEnvelope<T> {
    36	  success: boolean;
    37	  data: T;
    38	  meta?: {
    39	    pagination?: { page: number; limit: number; total: number; hasMore: boolean };
    40	  };
    41	}
    42	
    43	interface ScanAgent {
    44	  agent_id: string;
    45	  token_id: string;
    46	  chain_id: number;
    47	  contract_address: string;
    48	  owner_address: string;
    49	  agent_wallet?: string | null;
    50	  name: string | null;
    51	  description: string | null;
    52	  image_url: string | null;
    53	  is_verified: boolean;
    54	  star_count: number | null;
    55	  supported_protocols: string[] | null;
    56	  x402_supported: boolean;
    57	  total_score: number | null;
    58	  average_score: number | null;
    59	  rank: number | null;
    60	  health_score: number | null;
    61	  total_feedbacks: number | null;
    62	  created_at: string | null;
    63	  services?: unknown[] | null;
    64	  scores?: Record<string, number> | null;
    65	  agent_uri?: string | null;
    66	  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    67	}
    68	
    69	async function scanFetch<T>(path: string, params: Record<string, string | number>): Promise<ScanEnvelope<T>> {
    70	  const url = new URL(`${BASE_URL}${path}`);
    71	  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    72	
    73	  const headers: Record<string, string> = { accept: 'application/json' };
    74	  if (API_KEY) headers[KEY_HEADER] = API_KEY;
    75	
    76	  const res = await fetch(url, { headers });
    77	  if (!res.ok) {
    78	    throw new Scan8004Error(`8004scan ${path} responded ${res.status}`, res.status);
    79	  }
    80	  const json = (await res.json()) as ScanEnvelope<T>;
    81	  if (!json.success) {
    82	    throw new Scan8004Error(`8004scan ${path} returned success=false`);
    83	  }
    84	  return json;
    85	}
    86	
    87	/**
    88	 * Verified 2026-08-07: the public /agents list endpoint IGNORES chain
    89	 * filters (`chain_id` and `chain` both return the global, mixed-chain set
    90	 * with a global total). Lists are therefore over-fetched and filtered here,
    91	 * and upstream totals are never surfaced as chain-specific numbers.
    92	 *
    93	 * The detail endpoint (/agents/{chainId}/{tokenId}) IS chain-scoped by
    94	 * path, so a mismatch there is a real bug and throws.
    95	 */
    96	function assertChain(agent: ScanAgent, expectedChainId: number): void {
    97	  if (agent.chain_id !== expectedChainId) {
    98	    throw new Scan8004Error(
    99	      `8004scan detail endpoint returned agent on chain ${agent.chain_id}, expected ${expectedChainId}.`,
   100	    );
   101	  }
   102	}
   103	
   104	function toTrust(a: ScanAgent, asOf: string): TrustData {
   105	  return {
   106	    totalScore: a.total_score,
   107	    averageScore: a.average_score,
   108	    rank: a.rank,
   109	    healthScore: a.health_score,
   110	    totalFeedbacks: a.total_feedbacks ?? 0,
   111	    starCount: a.star_count,
   112	    isVerified: a.is_verified,
   113	    breakdown: a.scores ?? undefined,
   114	    source: '8004scan',
   115	    asOf,
   116	  };
   117	}
   118	
   119	function toSummary(a: ScanAgent, asOf: string): AgentSummary {
   120	  const name = a.name ?? `Agent #${a.token_id}`;
   121	  const description = a.description ?? '';
   122	  return {
   123	    id: `${a.chain_id}-${a.token_id}`,
   124	    chainId: a.chain_id,
   125	    tokenId: a.token_id,
   126	    agentId: a.agent_id,
   127	    name,
   128	    description,
   129	    imageUrl: a.image_url,
   130	    owner: a.owner_address,
   131	    category: classify({ metadata: a.metadata, name, description }),
   132	    supportedProtocols: a.supported_protocols ?? [],
   133	    x402Supported: a.x402_supported,
   134	    registeredAt: a.created_at,
   135	    trust: toTrust(a, asOf),
   136	  };
   137	}
   138	
   139	function toDetail(a: ScanAgent, expectedChainId: number, asOf: string): AgentDetail {
   140	  assertChain(a, expectedChainId);
   141	  return {
   142	    ...toSummary(a, asOf),
   143	    agentURI: a.agent_uri ?? null,
   144	    agentWallet: a.agent_wallet ?? null,
   145	    metadata: a.metadata ?? null,
   146	    services: a.services ?? null,
   147	  };
   148	}
   149	
   150	async function keyedFetch<T>(
   151	  path: string,
   152	  params: Record<string, string | number>,
   153	): Promise<T> {
   154	  const url = new URL(`${KEYED_BASE_URL}${path}`);
   155	  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
   156	  const res = await fetch(url, {
   157	    headers: { accept: 'application/json', [KEY_HEADER]: API_KEY! },
   158	  });
   159	  if (!res.ok) {
   160	    throw new Scan8004Error(`8004scan keyed ${path} responded ${res.status}`, res.status);
   161	  }
   162	  return (await res.json()) as T;
   163	}
   164	
   165	export class Scan8004Source implements AgentIndexSource {
   166	  readonly name = API_KEY ? '8004scan-pro' : '8004scan';
   167	
   168	  async listAgents(q: ListAgentsQuery): Promise<Page<AgentSummary>> {
   169	    if (API_KEY) return this.listAgentsKeyed(q);
   170	    return this.listAgentsPublic(q);
   171	  }
   172	
   173	  /** Keyed surface: server-side chain filter, offset cursor, real per-chain total. */
   174	  private async listAgentsKeyed(q: ListAgentsQuery): Promise<Page<AgentSummary>> {
   175	    const limit = q.limit ?? 24;
   176	    const offset = q.cursor ? Number.parseInt(q.cursor, 10) : 0;
   177	    const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
   178	
   179	    const res = await keyedFetch<{ items: ScanAgent[]; total: number }>('/agents', {
   180	      chain_id: q.chainId,
   181	      limit,
   182	      offset,
   183	    });
   184	
   185	    // Server filters by chain; keep the local filter as defense in depth.
   186	    let items = res.items
   187	      .filter((a) => a.chain_id === q.chainId)
   188	      .map((a) => toSummary(a, asOf));
   189	    if (q.category) items = items.filter((a) => a.category === q.category);
   190	
   191	    return {
   192	      items,
   193	      nextCursor: offset + limit < res.total ? String(offset + limit) : null,
   194	      total: res.total,
   195	      asOf,
   196	      source: this.name,
   197	    };
   198	  }
   199	
   200	  /** Public surface: chain filters ignored upstream; over-fetch + filter locally. */
   201	  private async listAgentsPublic(q: ListAgentsQuery): Promise<Page<AgentSummary>> {
   202	    const page = q.cursor ? Number.parseInt(q.cursor, 10) : 1;
   203	    const limit = q.limit ?? 24;
   204	    const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
   205	
   206	    const res = await scanFetch<ScanAgent[]>('/agents', {
   207	      chain_id: q.chainId, // kept: harmless today, correct if upstream fixes it
   208	      page,
   209	      limit: 100,
   210	    });
   211	
   212	    let items = res.data
   213	      .filter((a) => a.chain_id === q.chainId)
   214	      .map((a) => toSummary(a, asOf));
   215	    if (q.category) items = items.filter((a) => a.category === q.category);
   216	    items = items.slice(0, limit);
   217	
   218	    const pagination = res.meta?.pagination;
   219	    return {
   220	      items,
   221	      nextCursor: pagination?.hasMore ? String(page + 1) : null,
   222	      // Public upstream total is global (all chains); never present it as ours.
   223	      total: null,
   224	      asOf,
   225	      source: this.name,
   226	    };
   227	  }
   228	
   229	  async getAgent(chainId: number, tokenId: string): Promise<AgentDetail | null> {
   230	    const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
   231	    if (API_KEY) {
   232	      try {
   233	        // Keyed detail returns the agent object directly (no envelope).
   234	        const agent = await keyedFetch<ScanAgent>(`/agents/${chainId}/${tokenId}`, {});
   235	        return toDetail(agent, chainId, asOf);
   236	      } catch (err) {
   237	        if (err instanceof Scan8004Error && err.status === 404) return null;
   238	        throw err;
   239	      }
   240	    }
   241	    try {
   242	      const res = await scanFetch<ScanAgent>(`/agents/${chainId}/${tokenId}`, {});
   243	      return toDetail(res.data, chainId, asOf);
   244	    } catch (err) {
   245	      if (err instanceof Scan8004Error && err.status === 404) return null;
   246	      throw err;
   247	    }
   248	  }
   249	
   250	  async searchAgents(chainId: number, query: string): Promise<AgentSummary[]> {
   251	    const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
   252	    const res = await scanFetch<ScanAgent[]>('/agents/search', {
   253	      q: query,
   254	      chain_id: chainId,
   255	    });
   256	    // Search ignores chain filters upstream as well; filter locally.
   257	    return res.data
   258	      .filter((a) => a.chain_id === chainId)
   259	      .map((a) => toSummary(a, asOf));
   260	  }
   261	
   262	  async getFeedback(chainId: number, tokenId: string): Promise<Feedback[]> {
   263	    const registry = ERC8004_REGISTRIES[chainId]?.identity.toLowerCase();
   264	    if (!registry) throw new Scan8004Error(`No ERC-8004 registry known for chain ${chainId}`);
   265	    const res = await scanFetch<Record<string, unknown>[]>('/feedbacks', {
   266	      chain_id: chainId,
   267	      agent_id: `${chainId}:${registry}:${tokenId}`,
   268	    });
   269	    return res.data.map((f) => ({
   270	      agentRef: String(f['agent_id'] ?? `${chainId}-${tokenId}`),
   271	      client: String(f['user_address'] ?? ''),
   272	      score: typeof f['score'] === 'number' ? f['score'] : null,
   273	      value: f['value'] != null ? String(f['value']) : null,
   274	      tags: [f['tag1'], f['tag2']].filter((t): t is string => typeof t === 'string' && t.length > 0),
   275	      uri: f['feedback_uri'] != null ? String(f['feedback_uri']) : null,
   276	      txHash: f['transaction_hash'] != null ? String(f['transaction_hash']) : null,
   277	      blockNumber: typeof f['block_number'] === 'number' ? f['block_number'] : null,
   278	      revoked: f['is_revoked'] === true,
   279	      timestamp: f['created_at'] != null ? String(f['created_at']) : null,
   280	    }));
   281	  }
   282	
   283	  async stats(chainId: number): Promise<IndexStats> {
   284	    const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
   285	    const res = await scanFetch<Record<string, unknown>>('/stats', { chain_id: chainId });
   286	    const d = res.data;
   287	    const num = (v: unknown): number | null => (typeof v === 'number' ? v : null);
   288	    return {
   289	      totalAgents: num(d['total_agents']) ?? num(d['agents']) ?? null,
   290	      totalFeedbacks: num(d['total_feedbacks']) ?? num(d['feedbacks']) ?? null,
   291	      asOf,
   292	      source: this.name,
   293	    };
   294	  }
   295	}
     1	import {
     2	  BSC_MAINNET,
     3	  BSC_TESTNET,
     4	  ERC8004_REGISTRIES,
     5	  IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI,
     6	} from '@agripinaa/shared';
     7	import {
     8	  createPublicClient,
     9	  fallback,
    10	  http,
    11	  type PublicClient,
    12	} from 'viem';
    13	
    14	import { classify } from '../classify';
    15	import type { AgentDetail } from '../types';
    16	
    17	const clients = new Map<number, PublicClient>();
    18	
    19	function clientFor(chainId: number): PublicClient {
    20	  const cached = clients.get(chainId);
    21	  if (cached) return cached;
    22	  const rpcUrls =
    23	    chainId === 97 ? BSC_TESTNET.rpcUrls : BSC_MAINNET.rpcUrls;
    24	  const client = createPublicClient({
    25	    transport: fallback(rpcUrls.map((u) => http(u))),
    26	  });
    27	  clients.set(chainId, client);
    28	  return client;
    29	}
    30	
    31	function resolveUri(uri: string): string {
    32	  if (uri.startsWith('ipfs://')) {
    33	    return `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${uri.slice('ipfs://'.length)}`;
    34	  }
    35	  return uri;
    36	}
    37	
    38	async function fetchMetadata(uri: string): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
    39	  try {
    40	    const res = await fetch(resolveUri(uri), {
    41	      headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
    42	      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5_000),
    43	    });
    44	    if (!res.ok) return null;
    45	    const json = (await res.json()) as unknown;
    46	    return typeof json === 'object' && json !== null
    47	      ? (json as Record<string, unknown>)
    48	      : null;
    49	  } catch {
    50	    return null;
    51	  }
    52	}
    53	
    54	/**
    55	 * Direct on-chain fallback: per-agent reads only (ownerOf + tokenURI +
    56	 * metadata fetch). Deliberately no event-log enumeration: public BSC RPCs
    57	 * throttle getLogs, and list views are served by 8004scan or the committed
    58	 * snapshot instead.
    59	 */
    60	export async function readAgentFromRegistry(
    61	  chainId: number,
    62	  tokenId: string,
    63	): Promise<AgentDetail | null> {
    64	  const registries = ERC8004_REGISTRIES[chainId];
    65	  if (!registries) return null;
    66	  const client = clientFor(chainId);
    67	  const asOf = new Date().toISOString();
    68	
    69	  let owner: string;
    70	  try {
    71	    owner = await client.readContract({
    72	      address: registries.identity,
    73	      abi: IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI,
    74	      functionName: 'ownerOf',
    75	      args: [BigInt(tokenId)],
    76	    });
    77	  } catch {
    78	    return null; // nonexistent token
    79	  }
    80	
    81	  let agentURI: string | null = null;
    82	  try {
    83	    agentURI = await client.readContract({
    84	      address: registries.identity,
    85	      abi: IDENTITY_REGISTRY_ABI,
    86	      functionName: 'tokenURI',
    87	      args: [BigInt(tokenId)],
    88	    });
    89	  } catch {
    90	    agentURI = null;
    91	  }
    92	
    93	  const metadata = agentURI ? await fetchMetadata(agentURI) : null;
    94	  const name =
    95	    typeof metadata?.['name'] === 'string'
    96	      ? (metadata['name'] as string)
    97	      : `Agent #${tokenId}`;
    98	  const description =
    99	    typeof metadata?.['description'] === 'string'
   100	      ? (metadata['description'] as string)
   101	      : '';
   102	  const image =
   103	    typeof metadata?.['image'] === 'string' ? (metadata['image'] as string) : null;
   104	  const agentWallet =
   105	    typeof metadata?.['agentWallet'] === 'string'
   106	      ? (metadata['agentWallet'] as string)
   107	      : null;
   108	
   109	  return {
   110	    id: `${chainId}-${tokenId}`,
   111	    chainId,
   112	    tokenId,
   113	    agentId: `${chainId}:${registries.identity.toLowerCase()}:${tokenId}`,
   114	    name,
   115	    description,
   116	    imageUrl: image,
   117	    owner,
   118	    category: classify({ metadata, name, description }),
   119	    supportedProtocols: [],
   120	    x402Supported: false,
   121	    registeredAt: null,
   122	    trust: {
   123	      totalScore: null,
   124	      averageScore: null,
   125	      rank: null,
   126	      healthScore: null,
   127	      totalFeedbacks: 0,
   128	      starCount: null,
   129	      isVerified: false,
   130	      source: 'registry',
   131	      asOf,
   132	    },
   133	    agentURI,
   134	    agentWallet,
   135	    metadata,
   136	    services: null,
   137	  };
   138	}
     1	import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
     2	import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
     3	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
     4	
     5	import type { AgentIndexSource } from '../source';
     6	import type {
     7	  AgentDetail,
     8	  AgentSummary,
     9	  Feedback,
    10	  IndexStats,
    11	  ListAgentsQuery,
    12	  Page,
    13	} from '../types';
    14	import { readAgentFromRegistry } from './registry-viem';
    15	import { Scan8004Source } from './scan8004';
    16	
    17	const SNAPSHOT_DIR = join(
    18	  dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),
    19	  '..',
    20	  '..',
    21	  'data',
    22	);
    23	
    24	interface CacheEntry<T> {
    25	  value: T;
    26	  at: number;
    27	}
    28	
    29	/** An indexer record that has the registration but not the agentURI
    30	 * document yet: placeholder name and no classifiable category. */
    31	function isMetadataPoor(agent: AgentDetail): boolean {
    32	  return /^Agent #\d+$/.test(agent.name) || (!agent.description && agent.category == null);
    33	}
    34	
    35	/**
    36	 * Priority: live 8004scan → committed snapshot (lists) or direct registry
    37	 * read (details) → last-known-good stale cache. Every response is labeled
    38	 * with its source so the UI can show provenance instead of pretending.
    39	 */
    40	export class MergedSource implements AgentIndexSource {
    41	  readonly name = 'merged';
    42	  private readonly scan = new Scan8004Source();
    43	  private readonly staleCache = new Map<string, CacheEntry<unknown>>();
    44	
    45	  private remember<T>(key: string, value: T): T {
    46	    this.staleCache.set(key, { value, at: Date.now() });
    47	    return value;
    48	  }
    49	
    50	  private stale<T>(key: string): T | null {
    51	    const hit = this.staleCache.get(key);
    52	    return hit ? (hit.value as T) : null;
    53	  }
    54	
    55	  private async loadSnapshot(chainId: number): Promise<AgentSummary[] | null> {
    56	    try {
    57	      const raw = await readFile(
    58	        join(SNAPSHOT_DIR, `agents-${chainId}.json`),
    59	        'utf8',
    60	      );
    61	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { items: AgentSummary[] };
    62	      return parsed.items;
    63	    } catch {
    64	      return null;
    65	    }
    66	  }
    67	
    68	  async listAgents(q: ListAgentsQuery): Promise<Page<AgentSummary>> {
    69	    const key = `list:${q.chainId}:${q.category ?? 'all'}:${q.cursor ?? '1'}:${q.limit ?? 24}`;
    70	    try {
    71	      return this.remember(key, await this.scan.listAgents(q));
    72	    } catch {
    73	      const snapshot = await this.loadSnapshot(q.chainId);
    74	      if (snapshot) {
    75	        const filtered = q.category
    76	          ? snapshot.filter((a) => a.category === q.category)
    77	          : snapshot;
    78	        const limit = q.limit ?? 24;
    79	        const page = q.cursor ? Number.parseInt(q.cursor, 10) : 1;
    80	        const start = (page - 1) * limit;
    81	        const items = filtered.slice(start, start + limit);
    82	        return {
    83	          items,
    84	          nextCursor: start + limit < filtered.length ? String(page + 1) : null,
    85	          total: filtered.length,
    86	          asOf: new Date().toISOString(),
    87	          source: 'snapshot',
    88	        };
    89	      }
    90	      const stale = this.stale<Page<AgentSummary>>(key);
    91	      if (stale) return { ...stale, source: `${stale.source} (stale)` };
    92	      throw new Error(
    93	        `agent-index: 8004scan unavailable and no snapshot for chain ${q.chainId}`,
    94	      );
    95	    }
    96	  }
    97	
    98	  async getAgent(chainId: number, tokenId: string): Promise<AgentDetail | null> {
    99	    const key = `agent:${chainId}:${tokenId}`;
   100	    try {
   101	      const fromScan = await this.scan.getAgent(chainId, tokenId);
   102	      // A null from the indexer is not proof of nonexistence: fresh
   103	      // registrations lag it (BSC lane is rpc_only). The registry is the
   104	      // source of truth for existence; only a null THERE is final.
   105	      if (fromScan && !isMetadataPoor(fromScan)) return this.remember(key, fromScan);
   106	      // The indexer often lists a registration before it fetches the
   107	      // agentURI document (name null, no category). Enrich identity fields
   108	      // from the chain + manifest; keep the indexer's trust scores.
   109	      const fromRegistry = await readAgentFromRegistry(chainId, tokenId);
   110	      if (fromScan && fromRegistry) {
   111	        return this.remember(key, {
   112	          ...fromScan,
   113	          name: fromRegistry.name,
   114	          description: fromRegistry.description || fromScan.description,
   115	          imageUrl: fromScan.imageUrl ?? fromRegistry.imageUrl,
   116	          category: fromRegistry.category ?? fromScan.category,
   117	          agentURI: fromRegistry.agentURI ?? fromScan.agentURI,
   118	          agentWallet: fromScan.agentWallet ?? fromRegistry.agentWallet,
   119	          metadata: fromRegistry.metadata ?? fromScan.metadata,
   120	        });
   121	      }
   122	      return this.remember(key, fromScan ?? fromRegistry);
   123	    } catch {
   124	      const fromRegistry = await readAgentFromRegistry(chainId, tokenId);
   125	      if (fromRegistry) return this.remember(key, fromRegistry);
   126	      return this.stale<AgentDetail | null>(key);
   127	    }
   128	  }
   129	
   130	  async searchAgents(chainId: number, query: string): Promise<AgentSummary[]> {
   131	    try {
   132	      return await this.scan.searchAgents(chainId, query);
   133	    } catch {
   134	      const snapshot = await this.loadSnapshot(chainId);
   135	      if (!snapshot) return [];
   136	      const q = query.toLowerCase();
   137	      return snapshot.filter(
   138	        (a) =>
   139	          a.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
   140	          a.description.toLowerCase().includes(q),
   141	      );
   142	    }
   143	  }
   144	
   145	  async getFeedback(chainId: number, tokenId: string): Promise<Feedback[]> {
   146	    const key = `feedback:${chainId}:${tokenId}`;
   147	    try {
   148	      return this.remember(key, await this.scan.getFeedback(chainId, tokenId));
   149	    } catch {
   150	      return this.stale<Feedback[]>(key) ?? [];
   151	    }
   152	  }
   153	
   154	  async stats(chainId: number): Promise<IndexStats> {
   155	    const key = `stats:${chainId}`;
   156	    try {
   157	      return this.remember(key, await this.scan.stats(chainId));
   158	    } catch {
   159	      const stale = this.stale<IndexStats>(key);
   160	      if (stale) return { ...stale, source: `${stale.source} (stale)` };

   163	        totalAgents: snapshot?.length ?? null,
   164	        totalFeedbacks: null,
   165	        asOf: new Date().toISOString(),
   166	        source: 'snapshot',
   167	      };
   168	    }
   169	  }

     1	import { OrderBookApi, SigningScheme, OrderQuoteSideKindSell } from '@cowprotocol/cow-sdk';
     2	import { MetadataApi, stringifyDeterministic } from '@cowprotocol/app-data';
     3	import { getOphisOrderbookUrl, getOphisOrderDomain, getOphisVaultRelayer, buildOphisOrderMetadata, buildOphisOrderCreation, enrollOphisTrader, ophisOrderReceiver, assertReceiverIsOwner, isOphisFeeChain, } from '@ophis/sdk';
     4	import { keccak256, toBytes, parseUnits, isAddress, getAddress as toChecksum } from 'viem';
     5	import { GPV2_ORDER_EIP712_TYPES, GPV2_ORDER_PRIMARY_TYPE } from './order-types.js';
     6	// EIP-7528 native sentinel + the zero address. The EOA EIP-712 path is ERC-20 only; native-ETH
     7	// sells need CoW eth-flow (owner becomes a contract, which also changes rebate attribution), so the
     8	// agent must wrap to WETH instead. Reject both up front with a clear message.
     9	const NATIVE_SENTINEL = '0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee';
    10	const ZERO_ADDRESS = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    11	// Autonomous-agent slippage ceiling (50%). At 100% the buy floor is 0 — an order that accepts any
    12	// proceeds. There is no human reviewing an agent's tx, so an absurd slippage is rejected outright.
    13	const MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 5_000;
    14	// The order's validity window. We set this ourselves (now + TTL) rather than trusting the quote's
    15	// validTo, so a compromised quote cannot mint a signature valid far into the future for delayed,
    16	// unfavorable execution. 30 min comfortably covers batch-auction settlement.
    17	const ORDER_TTL_SECONDS = 30 * 60;
    18	let warnedNoReferral = false;
    19	function assertErc20(addr, label) {
    20	    if (!isAddress(addr))
    21	        throw new Error(`${label} is not a valid address: ${addr}`);
    22	    const lower = addr.toLowerCase();
    23	    if (lower === ZERO_ADDRESS || lower === NATIVE_SENTINEL) {
    24	        throw new Error(`${label} is native ETH / the zero address. This agent path is ERC-20 only — sell WETH instead ` +
    25	            `(native-ETH sells require CoW eth-flow, a separate path).`);
    26	    }
    27	    return toChecksum(addr);
    28	}
    29	function applySlippage(amount, bps) {
    30	    return (amount * BigInt(10_000 - bps)) / 10000n;
    31	}
    32	/**
    33	 * Quote, sign (EIP-712), and submit an ERC-20 -> ERC-20 Ophis (CoW) swap from an agent's EOA wallet,
    34	 * carrying the Ophis partner fee + referrer code in appData so the integrator earns the rebate.
    35	 * Returns the order UID. The signature is produced by the framework wallet's `signTypedData`.
    36	 */
    37	export async function executeOphisSwap(wallet, params, options) {
    38	    const chainId = wallet.getChainId();
    39	    if (!isOphisFeeChain(chainId)) {
    40	        throw new Error(`Ophis does not operate on chain ${chainId}; switch the agent to a supported chain.`);
    41	    }
    42	    if (!options.referralCode && !warnedNoReferral) {
    43	        warnedNoReferral = true;
    44	        // Do not block the swap on a missing code (that was the top adoption
    45	        // killer): warn once, keep swapping, let the builder add a code to earn.
    46	        console.warn('[@ophis/agent-swap] No referralCode set: swaps still work, but you are leaving the 8-12% rebate on the table. Mint a code at https://swap.ophis.fi/#/rewards and pass it as options.referralCode.');
    47	    }
    48	    const owner = wallet.getAddress();
    49	    const sellToken = assertErc20(params.sellToken, 'sellToken');
    50	    const buyToken = assertErc20(params.buyToken, 'buyToken');
    51	    const slippageBps = params.slippageBps ?? 50;
    52	    // Cap well below 100%: at 10000 the buy floor would be 0 (an order that accepts ANY/zero proceeds
    53	    // — a max-sandwich invitation). An unattended agent has no human reviewing the tx, so reject an
    54	    // absurd slippage outright. MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = 5000 (50%) still allows very illiquid pairs.
    55	    if (!Number.isInteger(slippageBps) || slippageBps < 0 || slippageBps > MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS) {
    56	        throw new Error(`slippageBps out of range [0,${MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS}] or non-integer: ${slippageBps}`);
    57	    }
    58	    const decimals = await wallet.readErc20Decimals(sellToken);
    59	    // REJECT excess precision instead of letting parseUnits ROUND it. parseUnits rounds
    60	    // a fraction that doesn't fit the token's decimals (e.g. "0.5" of a 0-decimal token
    61	    // -> 1, i.e. 2x the intended amount), which for an unattended agent means selling a
    62	    // different quantity than requested. Enforce a plain decimal whose fractional part
    63	    // fits `decimals` so the whole-unit -> base-unit conversion is exact.
    64	    const amountStr = params.sellAmount.trim();
    65	    const amountMatch = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(amountStr);
    66	    if (!amountMatch) {
    67	        throw new Error(`sellAmount must be a plain decimal string (e.g. "1.5"): ${params.sellAmount}`);
    68	    }
    69	    // Trailing zeros carry no real precision (viem strips them), so "1.000" or "1.2300"
    70	    // are exact even on a low-decimal token — count only the significant fraction digits.
    71	    // Strip trailing zeros with a single-pass scan (not a regex) to avoid a CodeQL
    72	    // polynomial-regex flag on library input; behaviour is identical.
    73	    const fraction = amountMatch[2] ?? '';
    74	    let fractionEnd = fraction.length;
    75	    while (fractionEnd > 0 && fraction.charCodeAt(fractionEnd - 1) === 48 /* '0' */)
    76	        fractionEnd--;
    77	    const significantFraction = fraction.slice(0, fractionEnd);
    78	    if (significantFraction.length > decimals) {
    79	        throw new Error(`sellAmount "${params.sellAmount}" needs ${significantFraction.length} decimal places but the token supports only ${decimals}.`);
    80	    }
    81	    const sellAmountAtomic = parseUnits(amountStr, decimals);
    82	    if (sellAmountAtomic <= 0n)
    83	        throw new Error(`sellAmount must be > 0: ${params.sellAmount}`);
    84	    // Enroll the trader with the OWNER-SCOPED rebate indexer. Non-fatal: an enrollment hiccup must not
    85	    // abort the swap; the rebate simply won't index until the wallet is enrolled.
    86	    let enrollmentWarning;
    87	    try {
    88	        await enrollOphisTrader(owner);
    89	    }
    90	    catch (e) {
    91	        enrollmentWarning = `rebate-indexer enrollment failed (swap still executes; rebate may not index): ${e.message}`;
    92	    }
    93	    // Build the fee-bearing appData (appCode 'ophis' + CIP-75 partner fee + ophisReferrer code) and
    94	    // hash it. NON-validating path: ophisReferrer is an Ophis extension key CoW's strict schema rejects.
    95	    const appDataInput = buildOphisOrderMetadata({ chainId, referralCode: options.referralCode, isStablePair: options.isStablePair });
    96	    const appDataDoc = await new MetadataApi().generateAppDataDoc(appDataInput);
    97	    const fullAppData = await stringifyDeterministic(appDataDoc);
    98	    const appDataHash = keccak256(toBytes(fullAppData));
    99	    // Quote against the OPHIS orderbook host (getOphisOrderbookUrl; hitting api.cow.fi directly drops the fee).
   100	    const orderBookApi = new OrderBookApi({ chainId, baseUrls: { [chainId]: getOphisOrderbookUrl(chainId) } });
   101	    const receiver = ophisOrderReceiver(owner);
   102	    const quoteRes = (await orderBookApi.getQuote({
   103	        kind: OrderQuoteSideKindSell.SELL,
   104	        sellToken,
   105	        buyToken,
   106	        sellAmountBeforeFee: sellAmountAtomic.toString(),
   107	        from: owner,
   108	        receiver,
   109	        appData: fullAppData,
   110	        appDataHash,
   111	        signingScheme: SigningScheme.EIP712,
   112	    }));
   113	    const q = (quoteRes.quote ?? quoteRes);
   114	    // Assemble the order to sign. appData = the bytes32 HASH (this is what is signed). Slippage lowers
   115	    // the buyAmount so the quoted price is a floor, not an exact requirement.
   116	    const minBuyAmount = applySlippage(BigInt(String(q.buyAmount)), slippageBps).toString();
   117	    // The order sells the GROSS amount with a signed feeAmount of 0: Ophis/CoW orders take the fee from
   118	    // surplus + the appData partner fee, never a signed feeAmount (a non-zero one is unslipped extra
   119	    // spend and the orderbook rejects it — see apps/mcp-server assertion). For a sell quote CoW splits
   120	    // sellAmountBeforeFee into (sellAmount NET, feeAmount); their sum is the gross the caller asked for.
   121	    const grossSell = BigInt(String(q.sellAmount)) + BigInt(String(q.feeAmount));
   122	    const order = {
   123	        sellToken: toChecksum(String(q.sellToken)),
   124	        buyToken: toChecksum(String(q.buyToken)),
   125	        receiver,
   126	        sellAmount: grossSell.toString(),
   127	        buyAmount: minBuyAmount,
   128	        validTo: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + ORDER_TTL_SECONDS,
   129	        appData: appDataHash,
   130	        feeAmount: '0',
   131	        kind: 'sell',
   132	        partiallyFillable: false,
   133	        sellTokenBalance: 'erc20',
   134	        buyTokenBalance: 'erc20',
   135	    };
   136	    assertReceiverIsOwner(owner, receiver); // drain guard: the receiver must be the owner
   137	    // Bind the signed order back to the REQUEST. The orderbook host is trusted for pricing, but the
   138	    // fields the wallet approves + signs must not drift from what the caller asked for: a compromised
   139	    // quote must not substitute tokens or change the amount pulled. Tokens must match exactly (both
   140	    // already checksummed), and the gross (quote sellAmount + feeAmount) must EQUAL the requested
   141	    // amount — an honest CoW sell quote splits sellAmountBeforeFee exactly, so any drift up (over-pull)
   142	    // or down (selling less than asked while reporting the full amount) means a bad/hostile quote.
   143	    if (order.sellToken !== sellToken)
   144	        throw new Error(`quote sellToken ${order.sellToken} != requested ${sellToken}; refusing to sign`);
   145	    if (order.buyToken !== buyToken)
   146	        throw new Error(`quote buyToken ${order.buyToken} != requested ${buyToken}; refusing to sign`);
   147	    if (grossSell !== sellAmountAtomic)
   148	        throw new Error(`quote gross (sellAmount+feeAmount = ${grossSell}) != requested ${sellAmountAtomic}; refusing to sign`);
   149	    // A quote can only be trusted for pricing so far: reject a buy floor of 0 outright. At buyAmount=1
   150	    // (or any tiny value) slippage rounds minBuyAmount to 0 — an order that would sell the full input
   151	    // for zero proceeds (a max-sandwich invitation). We cannot assert a GOOD price without an oracle,
   152	    // but we can refuse a zero-proceeds order.
   153	    if (BigInt(order.buyAmount) <= 0n)
   154	        throw new Error(`quote buy floor is 0 (buyAmount too low: ${String(q.buyAmount)}); refusing to sign a zero-proceeds order`);
   155	    // Approve the OPHIS vault relayer for what settlement pulls: the signed sellAmount (the gross; the
   156	    // signed feeAmount is 0, so sellAmount + feeAmount = grossSell).
   157	    const relayer = getOphisVaultRelayer(chainId);
   158	    await wallet.ensureErc20Allowance(sellToken, relayer, grossSell);
   159	    // Sign the order EIP-712 with the agent's EOA wallet (NOT presign — that is the smart-wallet path).
   160	    const signature = await wallet.signTypedData({
   161	        domain: getOphisOrderDomain(chainId),
   162	        types: GPV2_ORDER_EIP712_TYPES,
   163	        primaryType: GPV2_ORDER_PRIMARY_TYPE,
   164	        message: order,
   165	    });
   166	    // Submit. buildOphisOrderCreation produces the correct wire body (full appData STRING + the hash)
   167	    // and asserts the signed order's appData equals the hash.
   168	    const body = buildOphisOrderCreation({ order, owner, fullAppData, appDataHash, signature, signingScheme: 'eip712' });
   169	    const orderUid = (await orderBookApi.sendOrder(body));
   170	    return {
   171	        orderUid,
   172	        chainId,
   173	        owner,
   174	        sellToken,
   175	        buyToken,
   176	        sellAmount: params.sellAmount,
   177	        minBuyAmount,
   178	        explorerUrl: `https://explorer.ophis.fi/orders/${orderUid}`,
   179	        enrollmentWarning,
   180	    };
   181	}
     1	# @ophis/agent-swap
     2	
     3	Framework-agnostic core for executing an **Ophis** (a CoW Protocol fork) ERC-20 swap from an AI agent's **EOA** wallet. It is consumed by [`@ophis/plugin-goat`](../plugin-goat) (GOAT SDK) and [`@ophis/agentkit-ophis`](../agentkit-ophis) (Coinbase AgentKit) — you usually want one of those, not this directly.
     4	
     5	The order flow is written and tested once here: quote against the Ophis orderbook → build the fee-bearing appData (so the integrator earns the 8–12% rebate) → **EIP-712 sign** via your wallet's `signTypedData` (an EOA, not a Safe presign) → approve the CoW vault relayer → submit → enroll the trader with the owner-scoped rebate indexer.
     6	
     7	## Use from a custom framework
     8	
     9	Implement the minimal `OphisAgentWallet` for your agent's wallet (5 methods: `getAddress`, `getChainId`, `readErc20Decimals`, `ensureErc20Allowance`, `signTypedData`), then:
    10	
    11	```ts
    12	import { executeOphisSwap, type OphisAgentWallet } from '@ophis/agent-swap';
    13	
    14	const result = await executeOphisSwap(
    15	  wallet, // your OphisAgentWallet
    16	  { sellToken, buyToken, sellAmount: '1.5' /* whole units */, slippageBps: 50 },
    17	  { referralCode: process.env.OPHIS_REFERRAL_CODE! },
    18	);
    19	// result.orderUid, result.explorerUrl, result.minBuyAmount
    20	```
    21	
    22	ERC-20 → ERC-20 only (the EOA EIP-712 path; native-ETH sells need CoW eth-flow). The agent's wallet is the order owner **and** receiver. Get a referral code at https://docs.ophis.fi/ai-agents.

     5	/**
     6	 * Local registry of sessions this browser has granted. The session payload is
     7	 * stored as the EXACT serialized string produced at grant time (re-serializing
     8	 * a parsed session can change byte order and break execution upstream).
     9	 */
    10	export interface StoredSessionMeta {
    11	  id: string;
    12	  chainId: number;
    13	  account: string;
    14	  publicKey: string | null;
    15	  agent: { chainId: number; tokenId: string; name: string };
    16	  scope: { allowlist: string[]; capFormatted: string; expiresAt: string };
    17	  grantedAt: string;
    18	  revokedAt: string | null;
    19	  /** Byte-exact serialized session. */
    20	  raw: string;
    21	}
    22	
    23	const KEY = 'agripinaa.sessions.v1';
    24	
    25	function read(): StoredSessionMeta[] {
    26	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
    27	  try {
    28	    return JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) ?? '[]') as StoredSessionMeta[];
    29	  } catch {
    30	    return [];
    31	  }
    32	}
    33	
    34	function write(sessions: StoredSessionMeta[]): void {
    35	  window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(sessions));
    36	}
    37	
    38	export function listStoredSessions(): StoredSessionMeta[] {
    39	  return read().sort((a, b) => b.grantedAt.localeCompare(a.grantedAt));
    40	}
    41	
    42	export function storeSession(input: {
    43	  session: unknown;
    44	  chainId: number;
    45	  agent: StoredSessionMeta['agent'];
    46	  scope: StoredSessionMeta['scope'];
    47	}): StoredSessionMeta {
    48	  const raw = serializeSession(input.session);
    49	  const s = input.session as {
    50	    publicKey?: string;
    51	    walletAddress?: string;
    52	  };

    63	  };
    64	  write([...read(), meta]);
    65	  return meta;

     1	/**
     2	 * Session persistence. Sessions REQUIRE byte-exact persistence: the relay
     3	 * validates against the exact granted object, and any re-serialization that
     4	 * reorders keys or reformats values breaks the session. These helpers are
     5	 * the only supported way to write a session to disk or read one back.
     6	 *
     7	 * bigint fields (spend limits) are encoded as "bigint:<decimal>" strings,
     8	 * the same convention the spike session files on disk already use.
     9	 */
    10	
    11	const BIGINT_MARKER = 'bigint:';
    12	
    13	export function serializeSession(session: unknown): string {
    14	  return JSON.stringify(session, (_key, value: unknown) =>
    15	    typeof value === 'bigint' ? BIGINT_MARKER + value.toString() : value,
    16	  );
    17	}
    18	
    19	export function deserializeSession(raw: string): unknown {
    20	  return JSON.parse(raw, (_key, value: unknown) =>
    21	    typeof value === 'string' && value.startsWith(BIGINT_MARKER)
    22	      ? BigInt(value.slice(BIGINT_MARKER.length))
    23	      : value,
    24	  );
    25	}
    26	
    27	/** True iff serialize(deserialize(serialize(x))) === serialize(x). */
    28	export function roundTripIsExact(session: unknown): boolean {
    29	  const first = serializeSession(session);
    30	  return serializeSession(deserializeSession(first)) === first;
    31	}

    51	  async function revoke() {
    52	    setBusy(true);
    53	    setError(null);
    54	    try {
    55	      const client = altanaClient();

    61	        );
    62	      }
    63	      const session = reviveSession(meta);
    64	      await client.revokeSession({
    65	        wallet,
    66	        signer: wallet.signer,
    67	        chainId: meta.chainId,
    68	        session: session as Parameters<typeof client.revokeSession>[0]['session'],
    69	      });
    70	      markRevoked(meta.id);
    71	      setValidity('invalid');
    72	      onChange();
    73	    } catch (e) {
    74	      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    75	    } finally {
    76	      setBusy(false);
    77	    }
    78	  }
    79	
    80	  const badge =
    81	    validity === 'valid'
    82	      ? { text: 'active on-chain', cls: 'bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-300' }
    83	      : validity === 'invalid'
    84	        ? { text: 'revoked / expired', cls: 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400' }
    85	        : validity === 'checking'
    20	  const cached = clients.get(chainId);
    21	  if (cached) return cached;
    22	  const rpcUrls =
    23	    chainId === 97 ? BSC_TESTNET.rpcUrls : BSC_MAINNET.rpcUrls;
    24	  const client = createPublicClient({
    25	    transport: fallback(rpcUrls.map((u) => http(u))),
    26	  });
    27	  clients.set(chainId, client);
    28	  return client;
    29	}

     5	export async function GET(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
     6	  const url = new URL(request.url);

     8	  const category = CATEGORIES.find((c) => c === rawCategory) as

    19	  const cursor = url.searchParams.get("cursor") ?? undefined;

    21	  const page = await listAgents(category, limit, cursor);
    22	  return Response.json(page);

    26	const PINNED_AGENT_IDS = ['269703', '269704', '269705', '269706'];

    28	export async function listAgents(
    29	  category?: Category,
    30	  limit = 24,
    31	  cursor?: string,
    32	): Promise<Page<AgentSummary>> {
    33	  'use cache';
    34	  cacheLife('minutes');
    35	  const page = await source.listAgents({ chainId: CHAIN_ID, category, limit, cursor });
    36	  if (cursor) return page; // pin only on the first page
    37	
    38	  // Always resolve pinned agents through getAgent (which enriches indexer
    39	  // records from the on-chain manifest), then REPLACE any poorer copies the
    40	  // list already contains, so hubs never regress to "Agent #NNN" entries.
    41	  const pinned = (
    42	    await Promise.all(
    43	      PINNED_AGENT_IDS.map((id) => source.getAgent(CHAIN_ID, id).catch(() => null)),
    44	    )
    45	  )
    46	    .filter((a): a is NonNullable<typeof a> => a != null)
    47	    .filter((a) => (category ? a.category === category : true));
    48	  if (pinned.length === 0) return page;
    49	  const pinnedIds = new Set(pinned.map((a) => a.tokenId));
    50	  return {
    51	    ...page,
    52	    items: [...pinned, ...page.items.filter((a) => !pinnedIds.has(a.tokenId))],
    53	  };
    54	}

   207	/** Breach is strictly below the floor; exactly 95 percent still trades. */
   208	export function isLossBreach(
   209	  inventoryNowUsd: number,
   210	  inventoryStartUsd: number,
   211	  floor = LOSS_FLOOR_FRACTION,
   212	): boolean {
   213	  return inventoryNowUsd < inventoryStartUsd * floor;

   215	
   216	export type GuardFailure =
   217	  | 'cooldown'
   218	  | 'rate-limit'
   219	  | 'trend-breakout'
   220	  | 'daily-loss'
   221	  | 'insufficient-balance';
   222	
   223	export interface GuardInput {
   224	  nowMs: number;
   225	  lastFillAtMs: number | null;
   226	  price: number;
   227	  center: number;
   228	  inventoryNowUsd: number;
   229	  inventoryStartUsd: number;
   230	  clipBaseUnits: bigint;
   231	  balanceBaseUnits: bigint;
   232	  /** Lazy so the persisted action counter records only when the chain
   233	   * actually reaches it, and never during cooldown. */
   234	  allowTrade: () => boolean;
   235	  cooldownMs?: number;
   236	  maxDeviation?: number;
   237	  lossFloor?: number;
   238	}
   239	
   240	export type GuardResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: GuardFailure; halt: boolean };
   241	
   242	/** Spec-fixed guard order: cooldown, rate limit, trend halt, loss halt,
   243	 * balance sufficiency. halt true means the caller must trip the breaker. */
   244	export function evaluateGuards(input: GuardInput): GuardResult {
   245	  if (isCooldownActive(input.nowMs, input.lastFillAtMs, input.cooldownMs)) {
   246	    return { ok: false, reason: 'cooldown', halt: false };
   247	  }
   248	  if (!input.allowTrade()) {
   249	    return { ok: false, reason: 'rate-limit', halt: false };
   250	  }
   251	  if (isTrendBreakout(input.price, input.center, input.maxDeviation)) {
   252	    return { ok: false, reason: 'trend-breakout', halt: true };
   253	  }
   254	  if (isLossBreach(input.inventoryNowUsd, input.inventoryStartUsd, input.lossFloor)) {
   255	    return { ok: false, reason: 'daily-loss', halt: true };
   256	  }
   257	  if (input.balanceBaseUnits < input.clipBaseUnits) {
   258	    return { ok: false, reason: 'insufficient-balance', halt: false };
   259	  }
   260	  return { ok: true };
   261	}
