     1	import { TOKENS_BSC, fromBaseUnits, toBaseUnits } from '@agripinaa/shared';
     2	
     3	export type Address = `0x${string}`;
     4	
     5	export const MAX_SESSION_SECONDS = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
     6	
     7	export type SpendCapToken = 'USDT' | 'USDC';
     8	
     9	export interface SessionScopeInput {
    10	  allowlist: readonly Address[];
    11	  spendCap: { token: SpendCapToken; amount: string; period: 'day' };
    12	  expiresInSeconds: number;
    13	}
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * Structurally compatible with the Altana SDK's GrantSessionOptions
    17	 * (permissions + expiry), kept SDK-free so the web app can build and
    18	 * render scopes without the SDK loaded.
    19	 */
    20	export interface SessionScope {
    21	  permissions: {
    22	    calls: { to: Address }[];
    23	    spend: { limit: bigint; period: 'day'; token: Address }[];
    24	  };
    25	  expiry: number;
    26	}
    27	
    28	const ADDRESS_RE = /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/;
    29	
    30	/**
    31	 * Builds {permissions, expiry} ready to spread into grantSession.
    32	 *
    33	 * Fail-closed by construction: upstream, omitting permissions.calls means
    34	 * UNRESTRICTED contract access, and a spend entry without a token address
    35	 * caps the NATIVE token instead of the stablecoin. Every rule here exists
    36	 * to make those upstream defaults unreachable.
    37	 */
    38	export function buildSessionScope(input: SessionScopeInput): SessionScope {
    39	  const { allowlist, spendCap, expiresInSeconds } = input;
    40	
    41	  if (!allowlist || allowlist.length === 0) {
    42	    throw new Error(
    43	      'buildSessionScope rule "allowlist-required": allowlist is empty or missing; ' +
    44	        'an empty calls allowlist would fall through to the upstream fail-open default (unrestricted contract access)',
    45	    );
    46	  }
    47	  for (const to of allowlist) {
    48	    if (typeof to !== 'string' || !ADDRESS_RE.test(to)) {
    49	      throw new Error(
    50	        `buildSessionScope rule "allowlist-address-shape": "${String(to)}" is not a 20-byte 0x address; ` +
    51	          'a malformed entry cannot be trusted to restrict anything',
    52	      );
    53	    }
    54	  }
    55	
    56	  const token = TOKENS_BSC[spendCap.token];
    57	  if (!token) {
    58	    throw new Error(
    59	      `buildSessionScope rule "known-token": "${spendCap.token}" is not in TOKENS_BSC; ` +
    60	        'spend caps are only built for tokens whose decimals are pinned there',
    61	    );
    62	  }
    63	  if (spendCap.period !== 'day') {
    64	    throw new Error(
    65	      `buildSessionScope rule "day-period-only": period "${String(spendCap.period)}" is not supported; only 'day' is`,
    66	    );
    67	  }
    68	  // toBaseUnits throws on malformed amounts; decimals always come from
    69	  // TOKENS_BSC (USDT/USDC are 18 decimals on BNB, not the 6 of Ethereum USDT).
    70	  const limit = toBaseUnits(spendCap.amount, token.decimals);
    71	
    72	  if (
    73	    typeof expiresInSeconds !== 'number' ||
    74	    !Number.isInteger(expiresInSeconds) ||
    75	    expiresInSeconds <= 0
    76	  ) {
    77	    throw new Error(
    78	      `buildSessionScope rule "positive-integer-expiry": expiresInSeconds must be an integer > 0, got ${String(expiresInSeconds)}`,
    79	    );
    80	  }
    81	  if (expiresInSeconds > MAX_SESSION_SECONDS) {
    82	    throw new Error(
    83	      `buildSessionScope rule "max-expiry-30-days": expiresInSeconds ${expiresInSeconds} exceeds ${MAX_SESSION_SECONDS} (30 days)`,
    84	    );
    85	  }
    86	
    87	  return {
    88	    permissions: {
    89	      calls: allowlist.map((to) => ({ to })),
    90	      spend: [{ limit, period: 'day', token: token.address }],
    91	    },
    92	    expiry: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + expiresInSeconds,
    93	  };
    94	}

   104	  const spend = scope.permissions.spend[0];
   105	  let capFormatted = 'no spend cap';
   106	  if (spend) {

   108	      (t) => t.address.toLowerCase() === spend.token.toLowerCase(),
   109	    );
   110	    capFormatted = known
   111	      ? `${fromBaseUnits(spend.limit, known.decimals)} ${known.symbol} per ${spend.period}`
   112	      : `${spend.limit.toString()} base units of ${spend.token} per ${spend.period}`;
   113	  }
   114	  return {
   115	    allowlistCount: scope.permissions.calls.length,

    35	/**
    36	 * A live session — the result of grantSession. Carries everything an agent
    37	 * needs to act on the wallet within the granted scope.
    38	 *
    39	 * The integrator hands this object to whichever process runs the agent;
    40	 * the agent uses it with execute(session, calls).
    41	 */
    42	export type Session = {
    43	    /** The wallet this session can act on. */
    44	    walletAddress: Address;
    45	    /** The session key's signer. Agent signs with this. */
    46	    signer: Signer;
    47	    /** Public key registered on-chain. Identifier for revocation. */
    48	    publicKey: Hex;
    49	    /** Granted permissions (also enforced on-chain). */
    50	    permissions: SessionPermissions;
    51	    /** Unix epoch seconds when this session expires. */
    52	    expiry: number;
    53	};
    54	/** Options for grantSession. */
    55	export type GrantSessionOptions = {
    56	    permissions: SessionPermissions;
    57	    /** Unix epoch seconds. Most apps use Date.now()/1000 + N. */
    58	    expiry: number;
    59	    /**
    60	     * Provide your own session signer (e.g., generated by your backend and
    61	     * stored alongside user state). If omitted, the SDK generates a fresh
    62	     * secp256k1 session signer and returns it as part of the Session.
    63	     */
    64	    sessionSigner?: Signer;
    65	    /**
     1	import { keccak256 } from "viem";
     2	import {} from "./config.js";
     3	import { buildPublicClient, buildRelayClient, submitCalls, waitForCalls, } from "./internal/relay.js";
     4	import { buildRevokeKeyCall, readIsValidKey } from "./internal/keystore.js";
     5	const NATIVE_TOKEN = "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
     6	/**
     7	 * Revoke a session key from a wallet on-chain. After confirmation, the
     8	 * session's next execute attempt fails at validator level.
     9	 *
    10	 * Accepts either a Session object or just the session's public key when
    11	 * you've persisted the session metadata in your app.
    12	 */
    13	export async function revokeSession(wallet, adminSigner, sessionOrPublicKey, config) {
    14	    const network = config.network;
    15	    const feeToken = config.feeToken ?? NATIVE_TOKEN;
    16	    const sessionPublicKey = typeof sessionOrPublicKey === "string"
    17	        ? sessionOrPublicKey
    18	        : sessionOrPublicKey.publicKey;
    19	    const sessionKeyDesc = {
    20	        type: "secp256k1",
    21	        publicKey: sessionPublicKey,
    22	        role: "session",
    23	    };
    24	    const adminKeyDesc = {
    25	        type: "secp256k1",
    26	        publicKey: adminSigner.publicKey,
    27	        role: "admin",
    28	    };
    29	    const relayClient = buildRelayClient(network);
    30	    const publicClient = buildPublicClient(network);
    31	    // Revoke in KeyStore alongside revoking on Porto. KeyStore is the
    32	    // public registry — leaving a revoked session there would be a stale
    33	    // record that other tools would still treat as active. Both ops land in
    34	    // the same userOp. Revocation is monotonic in v1.0.0.
    35	    //
    36	    // Gated on the key actually being registered: sessions granted with
    37	    // `register: false` have no KeyStore entry, and revoking a missing keyId
    38	    // would revert — taking the account-level revoke (the one that removes the
    39	    // session's authority) down with it, since the bundle is atomic.
    40	    const keyId = keccak256(sessionPublicKey);
    41	    const isRegistered = await readIsValidKey(publicClient, network, wallet.address, keyId);
    42	    const revokeCalls = isRegistered
    43	        ? [buildRevokeKeyCall({ walletAddress: wallet.address, keyId, network })]
    44	        : [];
    45	    const callsId = await submitCalls(relayClient, wallet.address, adminSigner, revokeCalls, {
    46	        feeToken,
    47	        submittingKey: adminKeyDesc,
    48	        revokeKeys: [sessionKeyDesc],
    49	        network,
    50	    });
    51	    const result = await waitForCalls(relayClient, callsId);
    52	    return {
    53	        callsId,
    54	        status: result.status,
    55	        ...(result.transactionHash ? { transactionHash: result.transactionHash } : {}),
    56	    };
    57	}
    58	//# sourceMappingURL=revokeSession.js.map

     1	# @ophis/agent-swap
     2	
     3	Framework-agnostic core for executing an **Ophis** (a CoW Protocol fork) ERC-20 swap from an AI agent's **EOA** wallet. It is consumed by [`@ophis/plugin-goat`](../plugin-goat) (GOAT SDK) and [`@ophis/agentkit-ophis`](../agentkit-ophis) (Coinbase AgentKit) — you usually want one of those, not this directly.
     4	
     5	The order flow is written and tested once here: quote against the Ophis orderbook → build the fee-bearing appData (so the integrator earns the 8–12% rebate) → **EIP-712 sign** via your wallet's `signTypedData` (an EOA, not a Safe presign) → approve the CoW vault relayer → submit → enroll the trader with the owner-scoped rebate indexer.
     6	
     7	## Use from a custom framework
     8	
     9	Implement the minimal `OphisAgentWallet` for your agent's wallet (5 methods: `getAddress`, `getChainId`, `readErc20Decimals`, `ensureErc20Allowance`, `signTypedData`), then:
    10	
    11	```ts
    12	import { executeOphisSwap, type OphisAgentWallet } from '@ophis/agent-swap';
    13	
    14	const result = await executeOphisSwap(
    15	  wallet, // your OphisAgentWallet
    16	  { sellToken, buyToken, sellAmount: '1.5' /* whole units */, slippageBps: 50 },
    17	  { referralCode: process.env.OPHIS_REFERRAL_CODE! },
    18	);
    19	// result.orderUid, result.explorerUrl, result.minBuyAmount
    20	```
    21	
    22	ERC-20 → ERC-20 only (the EOA EIP-712 path; native-ETH sells need CoW eth-flow). The agent's wallet is the order owner **and** receiver. Get a referral code at https://docs.ophis.fi/ai-agents.

     2	import { buildChallenge } from "./challenge.js";

     4	import { settlePayment } from "./settle.js";

     6	/**
     7	 * A framework-agnostic x402/B402 merchant: give it your price, your payout
     8	 * address, and a funded facilitator key; put `requirePayment` in front of any
     9	 * paid route. Payable by BNB Agent Studio buyers (`bag x402 buy`), Altana
    10	 * `fetchWithX402` buyers, and anything else speaking the B402 v2 wire.
    11	 */
    12	export function createX402Merchant(opts) {
    13	    const publicClient = createPublicClient({
    14	        chain: opts.chain,
    15	        transport: http(opts.rpcUrl),
    16	    });
    17	    const walletClient = createWalletClient({
    18	        account: opts.facilitator,
    19	        chain: opts.chain,
    20	        transport: http(opts.rpcUrl),
    21	    });
    22	    // In-process replay guard so one authorization can't settle twice in a race;
    23	    // the on-chain nonce is the durable source of truth.
    24	    const seen = new Set();
    25	    const challengeBody = () => buildChallenge(opts);
    26	    async function requirePayment(xPaymentHeader) {
    27	        if (!xPaymentHeader)
    28	            return { status: 402, body: challengeBody() };
    29	        let decoded;
    30	        try {
    31	            decoded = decodeXPayment(xPaymentHeader);
    32	        }
    33	        catch (e) {
    34	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `invalid X-PAYMENT: ${e.message}` } };
    35	        }
    36	        const verdict = await verifyPayment(decoded, opts, {
    37	            // ERC-1271/ERC-6492-capable verification: smart-account payers welcome.
    38	            verifySignature: (args) => publicClient.verifyTypedData(args),
    39	            // Checker-restricted accounts (Altana session keys) defer to settlement.
    40	            isContract: async (address) => {
    41	                const code = await publicClient.getCode({ address });
    42	                return code != null && code !== "0x";
    43	            },
    44	        });
    45	        if (!verdict.ok) {
    46	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `payment rejected: ${verdict.reason}` } };
    47	        }
    48	        const nonceKey = decoded.rail === "eip3009"
    49	            ? `3009:${decoded.payer}:${decoded.authorization.nonce}`
    50	            : `p2:${decoded.payer}:${decoded.permit.nonce}`;
    51	        if (seen.has(nonceKey)) {
    52	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: "payment rejected: replayed authorization" } };
    53	        }
    54	        seen.add(nonceKey);
    55	        try {
    56	            const settled = await settlePayment(decoded, opts, { wallet: walletClient, public: publicClient });
    57	            return {
    58	                status: 200,
    59	                receipt: { ...settled, payer: decoded.payer, amount: decoded.amount, token: verdict.token, rail: decoded.rail },
    60	            };
    61	        }
    62	        catch (e) {
    63	            seen.delete(nonceKey); // let an honest retry through (e.g. RPC hiccup)
    64	            return { status: 402, body: { ...challengeBody(), error: `settlement failed: ${e.message}` } };
    65	        }
    66	    }
    67	    /** Fetch-API sugar: returns null when paid (proceed), or a Response to send. */
    68	    async function guard(request) {
    69	        // b402 buyers send the envelope under PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; ours sends both.
    70	        const result = await requirePayment(request.headers.get("X-PAYMENT") ?? request.headers.get("PAYMENT-SIGNATURE"));
    71	        if (result.status === 200)
    72	            return { response: null, receipt: result.receipt };
    73	        return {
    74	            response: new Response(JSON.stringify(result.body), {
    75	                status: 402,
    76	                headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    77	            }),
    78	        };
    79	    }
    80	    return { challengeBody, requirePayment, guard };
    81	}

     3	function matchRail(cfg, d) {
     4	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
     5	        return cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "eip3009" &&
     6	            (d.token === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ||
     7	                r.token.address.toLowerCase() === d.token.toLowerCase()));
     8	    }
     9	    return cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "permit2-exact" && r.token.address.toLowerCase() === d.token.toLowerCase());
    10	}
    11	/**
    12	 * Verify a decoded payment against the merchant config — token/amount/payTo/
    13	 * expiry business rules first (cheap), then the cryptographic signature.
    14	 * Settlement is the on-chain source of truth for nonce replay; this function
    15	 * makes sure only payments worth broadcasting reach it.
    16	 */
    17	export async function verifyPayment(d, cfg, opts) {
    18	    const now = BigInt(opts.now ?? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
    19	    if (d.chainId != null && d.chainId !== cfg.chainId) {
    20	        return { ok: false, reason: `wrong chain: payment is for ${d.chainId}, merchant is on ${cfg.chainId}` };
    21	    }
    22	    const rail = matchRail(cfg, d);
    23	    if (!rail) {
    24	        return { ok: false, reason: `token ${d.token} is not offered on any configured rail` };
    25	    }
    26	    const token = rail.token;
    27	    const price = effectivePrice(cfg);
    28	    if (d.amount < price) {
    29	        return { ok: false, reason: `amount ${d.amount} below the quoted price ${price}` };
    30	    }
    31	    if (cfg.maxPrice != null && d.amount > cfg.maxPrice) {
    32	        return { ok: false, reason: `amount ${d.amount} above maxPrice ${cfg.maxPrice}` };
    33	    }
    34	    let typedData;
    35	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
    36	        const a = d.authorization;
    37	        if (a.to.toLowerCase() !== cfg.payTo.toLowerCase()) {
    38	            return { ok: false, reason: `payTo mismatch: authorization pays ${a.to}, merchant is ${cfg.payTo}` };
    39	        }
    40	        if (BigInt(a.validBefore) <= now)
    41	            return { ok: false, reason: "authorization expired (validBefore in the past)" };
    42	        if (BigInt(a.validAfter) >= now)
    43	            return { ok: false, reason: "authorization not yet valid (validAfter in the future)" };
    44	        typedData = buildEip3009TypedData({
    45	            chainId: cfg.chainId,
    46	            token: token.address,
    47	            name: token.name,
    48	            version: token.version,
    49	            from: a.from,
    50	            to: a.to,
    51	            value: BigInt(a.value),
    52	            validAfter: BigInt(a.validAfter),
    53	            validBefore: BigInt(a.validBefore),
    54	            nonce: a.nonce,
    55	        });
    56	    }
    57	    else {
    58	        const p = d.permit;
    59	        if (rail.rail !== "permit2-exact" || p.spender.toLowerCase() !== rail.spender.toLowerCase()) {
    60	            return { ok: false, reason: `permit spender ${p.spender} is not the configured settler` };
    61	        }
    62	        if (BigInt(p.deadline) <= now)
    63	            return { ok: false, reason: "permit expired (deadline in the past)" };
    64	        const base = {
    65	            chainId: cfg.chainId,
    66	            token: p.permitted.token,
    67	            amount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount),
    68	            spender: p.spender,
    69	            nonce: BigInt(p.nonce),
    70	            deadline: BigInt(p.deadline),
    71	        };
    72	        if (d.rail === "permit2-witness") {
    73	            if (p.witness.to.toLowerCase() !== cfg.payTo.toLowerCase()) {
    74	                return { ok: false, reason: `payTo mismatch: witness pays ${p.witness.to}, merchant is ${cfg.payTo}` };
    75	            }
    76	            if (BigInt(p.witness.validAfter) >= now) {
    77	                return { ok: false, reason: "permit not yet valid (witness validAfter in the future)" };
    78	            }
    79	            typedData = buildPermit2WitnessTypedData({
    80	                ...base,
    81	                to: p.witness.to,
    82	                validAfter: BigInt(p.witness.validAfter),
    83	            });
    84	        }
    85	        else {
    86	            typedData = buildPermit2TypedData(base);
    87	        }
    88	    }
    89	    let valid = false;
    90	    try {
    91	        valid = await opts.verifySignature({ address: d.payer, signature: d.signature, ...typedData });
    92	    }
    93	    catch {
    94	        valid = false;
    95	    }
    96	    if (!valid && opts.isContract) {
    97	        // Checker-restricted smart accounts can't be pre-verified off-chain; the
    98	        // settlement contract (Permit2 / the token) is the authoritative verifier.
    99	        try {
   100	            valid = await opts.isContract(d.payer);
   101	        }
   102	        catch {
   103	            valid = false;
   104	        }
   105	    }
   106	    if (!valid)
   107	        return { ok: false, reason: "signature verification failed" };
   108	    return { ok: true, rail: d.rail, payer: d.payer, amount: d.amount, token: token.address };
   109	}

     2	import { PERMIT2_ADDRESS } from "@altananetwork/sdk";
     3	/** FiatTokenV2_2-style EIP-3009 with a `bytes` signature (EOA 65-byte sigs and
     4	 * ERC-1271-aware deployments alike). $U exposes this on both BSC networks. */
     5	const EIP3009_ABI = [
     6	    {
     7	        name: "transferWithAuthorization",
     8	        type: "function",
     9	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    10	        inputs: [
    11	            { name: "from", type: "address" },
    12	            { name: "to", type: "address" },
    13	            { name: "value", type: "uint256" },
    14	            { name: "validAfter", type: "uint256" },
    15	            { name: "validBefore", type: "uint256" },
    16	            { name: "nonce", type: "bytes32" },
    17	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    18	        ],
    19	        outputs: [],
    20	    },
    21	];
    22	const PERMIT2_ABI = [
    23	    {
    24	        name: "permitTransferFrom",
    25	        type: "function",
    26	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    27	        inputs: [
    28	            { name: "permit", type: "tuple", components: [
    29	                    { name: "permitted", type: "tuple", components: [
    30	                            { name: "token", type: "address" },
    31	                            { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
    32	                        ] },
    33	                    { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
    34	                    { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
    35	                ] },
    36	            { name: "transferDetails", type: "tuple", components: [
    37	                    { name: "to", type: "address" },
    38	                    { name: "requestedAmount", type: "uint256" },
    39	                ] },
    40	            { name: "owner", type: "address" },
    41	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    42	        ],
    43	        outputs: [],
    44	    },
    45	    {
    46	        name: "permitWitnessTransferFrom",
    47	        type: "function",
    48	        stateMutability: "nonpayable",
    49	        inputs: [
    50	            { name: "permit", type: "tuple", components: [
    51	                    { name: "permitted", type: "tuple", components: [
    52	                            { name: "token", type: "address" },
    53	                            { name: "amount", type: "uint256" },
    54	                        ] },
    55	                    { name: "nonce", type: "uint256" },
    56	                    { name: "deadline", type: "uint256" },
    57	                ] },
    58	            { name: "transferDetails", type: "tuple", components: [
    59	                    { name: "to", type: "address" },
    60	                    { name: "requestedAmount", type: "uint256" },
    61	                ] },
    62	            { name: "owner", type: "address" },
    63	            { name: "witness", type: "bytes32" },
    64	            { name: "witnessTypeString", type: "string" },
    65	            { name: "signature", type: "bytes" },
    66	        ],
    67	        outputs: [],
    68	    },
    69	];
    70	/**
    71	 * The witness type-string suffix Permit2 appends to its
    72	 * `PermitWitnessTransferFrom(...,` typehash stub. Must reproduce the exact
    73	 * EIP-712 encoding of `buildPermit2WitnessTypedData` (the B402 permit2-exact
    74	 * digest): referenced types sorted alphabetically after the primary type.
    75	 */
    76	const WITNESS_TYPE_STRING = "Witness witness)TokenPermissions(address token,uint256 amount)Witness(address to,uint256 validAfter)";
    77	const WITNESS_TYPEHASH = keccak256(toHex("Witness(address to,uint256 validAfter)"));
    78	export function witnessHash(to, validAfter) {
    79	    return keccak256(encodeAbiParameters([{ type: "bytes32" }, { type: "address" }, { type: "uint256" }], [WITNESS_TYPEHASH, to, validAfter]));
    80	}
    81	/**
    82	 * Broadcast the payment on-chain from the facilitator wallet and wait for
    83	 * inclusion. Reverts (wrong signature, replayed nonce, insufficient balance)
    84	 * surface as thrown errors — the caller answers 402.
    85	 */
    86	export async function settlePayment(d, cfg, clients) {
    87	    let to;
    88	    let data;
    89	    if (d.rail === "eip3009") {
    90	        const rail = cfg.rails.find((r) => r.rail === "eip3009");
    91	        if (!rail)
    92	            throw new Error("settle: no eip3009 rail configured");
    93	        const a = d.authorization;
    94	        to = rail.token.address;
    95	        data = encodeFunctionData({
    96	            abi: EIP3009_ABI,
    97	            functionName: "transferWithAuthorization",
    98	            args: [a.from, a.to, BigInt(a.value), BigInt(a.validAfter), BigInt(a.validBefore), a.nonce, d.signature],
    99	        });
   100	    }
   101	    else {
   102	        const p = d.permit;
   103	        const permit = {
   104	            permitted: { token: p.permitted.token, amount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount) },
   105	            nonce: BigInt(p.nonce),
   106	            deadline: BigInt(p.deadline),
   107	        };
   108	        const transferDetails = { to: cfg.payTo, requestedAmount: BigInt(p.permitted.amount) };
   109	        to = PERMIT2_ADDRESS;
   110	        data =
   111	            d.rail === "permit2-witness"
   112	                ? encodeFunctionData({
   113	                    abi: PERMIT2_ABI,
   114	                    functionName: "permitWitnessTransferFrom",
   115	                    args: [
   116	                        permit,
   117	                        transferDetails,
   118	                        d.payer,
   119	                        witnessHash(p.witness.to, BigInt(p.witness.validAfter)),
   120	                        WITNESS_TYPE_STRING,
   121	                        d.signature,
   122	                    ],
   123	                })
   124	                : encodeFunctionData({
   125	                    abi: PERMIT2_ABI,
   126	                    functionName: "permitTransferFrom",
   127	                    args: [permit, transferDetails, d.payer, d.signature],
   128	                });
   129	    }
   130	    const account = clients.wallet.account;
   131	    if (!account)
   132	        throw new Error("settle: facilitator wallet client has no account");
   133	    const txHash = await clients.wallet.sendTransaction({ account, to, data, chain: clients.wallet.chain });
   134	    const receipt = await clients.public.waitForTransactionReceipt({ hash: txHash });
   135	    if (receipt.status !== "success") {
   136	        throw new Error(`settle: transaction ${txHash} reverted`);
   137	    }
   138	    return { txHash };
   139	}

codex
- **HIGH** — [apps/agents/src/fund.ts:65](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/fund.ts:65), [apps/agents/src/chassis.ts:46](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/chassis.ts:46), [apps/agents/src/runner.ts:40](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/runner.ts:40) — Mainnet agent and facilitator private keys remain extractable plaintext JSON and are loaded into the same internet-facing runner process, so one process or deployment-account compromise exposes every wallet. **Fix:** Move each key to an isolated KMS/HSM or policy-enforced remote signer and rotate all current keys.

- **HIGH** — [apps/web/src/lib/session-store.ts:34](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/web/src/lib/session-store.ts:34), [packages/session-kit/tests/persist.test.ts:15](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/packages/session-kit/tests/persist.test.ts:15) — The complete serialized session, including `signer._privateKey`, is persisted in `localStorage`, allowing any same-origin script compromise to steal active spending authority. **Fix:** Use a non-exportable session key and store only passkey/WebCrypto-wrapped ciphertext outside `localStorage`.

- **HIGH** — [apps/agents/src/chassis.ts:33](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/chassis.ts:33) — Missing, truncated, or malformed state is silently replaced with `{}`, while in-place writes can be interrupted, clearing halt flags and action counters after a crash. **Fix:** Validate state and fail closed on load errors, using `0600` atomic fsync-and-rename writes.

- **HIGH** — [apps/agents/src/agents/lp-range.ts:364](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/agents/lp-range.ts:364), [apps/agents/src/agents/lp-range.ts:425](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/agents/lp-range.ts:425) — LP mint and withdrawal both set token minimums to zero, permitting sandwiches that force attacker-selected token compositions during entry or exit. **Fix:** Enforce TWAP-derived nonzero token minimums, short deadlines, and private transaction submission.

- **HIGH** — [apps/agents/src/baseline-swap.ts:62](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/baseline-swap.ts:62) — The operator-controlled real-wallet swap accepts `amountOutMinimum: 0`, allowing an arbitrary input amount to be sandwiched for negligible output. **Fix:** Obtain a fresh quote and enforce a nonzero slippage-bounded minimum before submission.

- **HIGH** — [packages/agent-index/src/sources/registry-viem.ts:31](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/packages/agent-index/src/sources/registry-viem.ts:31) — Attacker-controlled on-chain `tokenURI` values are fetched server-side with redirects and no scheme, host, or IP restrictions, enabling SSRF into loopback, private networks, and metadata services. **Fix:** Allowlist schemes and hosts, reject private/reserved resolved IPs before every redirect, and cap response size.

- **HIGH** — [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:28](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:28), [.gitignore:11](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/.gitignore:11) — Under zsh, `"$HOST:agripinaa/wallets/"` applies the `:a` modifier and becomes a local ignored path, duplicating wallet secrets while leaving stale hot keys on the VM. **Fix:** Use `"${HOST}:agripinaa/wallets/"`, sync an explicit key allowlist, pin the SSH host key, and verify remote wallet addresses.

- **HIGH** — [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:26](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:26) — `git reset --hard origin/main` overwrites tracked live state containing halts, counters, pending orders, and LP position IDs, allowing stale state to resume trading after restart. **Fix:** Stop the runner and keep atomically backed-up runtime state in a validated directory outside the checkout.

- **HIGH** — [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:20](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:20) — An unprivileged local user can pre-create writable `/tmp/cf.deb` and replace it between `curl` and privileged `dpkg`, executing a malicious maintainer script as root. **Fix:** Download a pinned package into a root-owned `mktemp` directory and verify its signature or digest before installation.

- **MEDIUM** — [packages/session-kit/src/persist.ts:36](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/packages/session-kit/src/persist.ts:36), [packages/spikes/scripts/spike-b.ts:67](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/packages/spikes/scripts/spike-b.ts:67) — Session JSON containing `signer._privateKey` is created with default permissions, and the generated `wallets/spike-b-session.json` is currently mode `0644`. **Fix:** Create session files atomically with `flag: "wx"` and `mode: 0o600`, rejecting symlink targets.

- **MEDIUM** — [apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:447](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:447) — Order submission is immediately recorded as a fill and advances cooldown and crossed-level state without confirming settlement, while the unfilled signed order remains executable. **Fix:** Persist submitted UIDs as pending and update fill state only after authoritative settlement confirmation.

- **MEDIUM** — [apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:244](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:244), [apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:408](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/agents/grid.ts:408) — Cooldown and rate-limit checks return before trend and loss breakers, so unsafe conditions can avoid a persistent halt while signed orders remain live. **Fix:** Evaluate hard breakers first and cancel every pending order synchronously when halting.

- **MEDIUM** — [apps/web/src/components/SessionCard.tsx:64](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/web/src/components/SessionCard.tsx:64) — The revocation result status is ignored and the session is marked invalid locally even when the SDK returns a failed or unconfirmed revocation. **Fix:** Mark revocation only after a confirmed result and an on-chain invalidity check.

- **MEDIUM** — [apps/agents/src/x402-server.ts:71](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/agents/src/x402-server.ts:71) — Payment is settled before status generation, so a later RPC or serialization failure returns HTTP 500 after charging the payer, whose authorization cannot be replayed to retrieve the response. **Fix:** Precompute or cache status before settlement and persist an idempotent payment-receipt-to-response mapping.

- **MEDIUM** — [apps/web/src/app/api/index/agents/route.ts:17](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/apps/web/src/app/api/index/agents/route.ts:17), [packages/agent-index/src/sources/merged.ts:43](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/packages/agent-index/src/sources/merged.ts:43) — Arbitrary raw cursor strings become distinct unbounded cache keys even when `parseInt` maps them to the same upstream page, enabling memory/cache growth and API-quota exhaustion. **Fix:** Require canonical bounded decimal cursors and limits, key caches by parsed values, and enforce LRU/TTL and rate limits.

- **MEDIUM** — [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:45](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:45) — `systemctl enable --now` leaves already-active units running, so deployed security fixes do not replace the vulnerable agent or x402 processes. **Fix:** Explicitly restart both units and verify their new PIDs and start timestamps.

- **MEDIUM** — [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:10](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:10), [ops/deploy-aleph.sh:42](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/deploy-aleph.sh:42) — The public tunnel and hot-wallet runner share `$RUSER`; a tunnel compromise can therefore read every wallet, and deployment through `root@host` gives it full root privileges. **Fix:** Reject UID 0 and run the tunnel and runner as separate hardened users with mutually isolated filesystem access.

- **MEDIUM** — [ops/set-x402-endpoint.sh:11](/Users/hodlmedia/agripinaa/ops/set-x402-endpoint.sh:11) — Fixed `/tmp/m.json` follows attacker-created symlinks, allowing a local user to overwrite any deployer-writable file, including a wallet JSON. **Fix:** Use an adjacent `mktemp` file under `umask 077`, reject symlinks, and install it atomically.
